summary.en: The UN biodiversity conference COP17 has opened in Armenia, and the country is attracting international attention. However, routine domestic political tensions continue, including the nationalisation of the electricity grid, relations with the EU, opposition-church tensions, and claims of politically motivated dismissals. With no clear crisis or major positive breakthrough, the score remains neutral.

en: Opening of the UN biodiversity conference COP17 in Yerevan
Nationalisation of the electricity grid (ENA) and arbitration dispute
Reports on the possible consequences of withdrawal from the EU
Tension between opposition and government, church and dismissal claims
Uncertainty over the peace agenda with Azerbaijan

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic and diplomatic items (new Air Serbia flights, flower exports, the TRIPP copper deal) with serious political strain. Police detained 14 after searches at an opposition office, an EU rapporteur urged easing pressure on the Church, and an EAEU report warned of a 69% gas price rise if membership were suspended.

en: Police detentions after searches at opposition office in Stepanavan
EAEU report warning of 69% gas price rise if membership suspended
EU rapporteur urging easing of pressure on the Church

summary.en: The period is dominated by economic and political strain: threatened 69% gas price rises and possible EAEU membership suspension, planned power outages, and opposition arrests ahead of Stepanavan elections with vote-buying and electoral-violation allegations. Offsetting positives include TRIPP progress (US stake and Armenian veto rights) and a well-attended tourism festival, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.

en: Threatened 69% gas price increase and EAEU suspension costs
Opposition arrests and detentions ahead of Stepanavan elections
Vote-buying and electoral-violation allegations against officials

summary.en: The period is dominated by political tension: CSTO and EAEU membership threats, opposition detentions and house arrests, and allegations of election interference around municipal polls. Positives include Armenia approving the TRIPP route agreement and a 1.5x rise in exports to the EU, but no violence or institutional collapse is reported.

en: CSTO and EAEU membership threats against Armenia
Detentions and house arrests of opposition candidates and supporters
Allegations of unlawful election interference ahead of municipal votes

summary.en: The period mixes routine government activity, such as investment committee approvals, US border-security equipment and the TRIPP transit discussion, with heightened political tension. Tension centres on possible CSTO exit, a snap-election dispute, detentions of opposition supporters and a border incident. GDELT tone (-0.58) is slightly better than the world average, so the net picture is roughly ordinary with a tense political backdrop.

en: Possible CSTO membership decision scheduled for 11 November
Detentions of Samvel Karapetyan supporters and opposition confrontation
US border-security equipment delivery and TRIPP transit debate

summary.en: Pre-election tensions dominate, with several opposition candidates and council members detained and talk of early elections and a constitutional crisis. Economic and social strain shows in World Bank poverty figures, power cuts and gas price warnings, partly offset by cultural and sporting successes and a fatal road accident.

en: Opposition candidates and council members detained ahead of local elections
Talk of early elections and a constitutional crisis
World Bank poverty figures and electricity cuts

summary.en: Local government elections were held peacefully on 25 October, with high turnout and some observer-reported violations and uneven competition. Yerevan's hosting of the UN biodiversity COP17 and positive international coverage add to a mildly positive day, offset by scheduled power cuts and fatal traffic accidents.

en: Local self-government elections held with high turnout
COP17 biodiversity summit hosted in Yerevan
Observers reported violations and uneven competition in elections

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: diplomacy with the EU, Azerbaijan and COP17, post-election political rhetoric, and a diplomatic spat with Russia over a governor's remarks. Civil-society criticism of a legislative package and tension over EAEU membership add some strain, and GDELT tone is slightly more negative than the world average, but no acute crisis appears.

en: Post-election dispute over opposition and alleged pressure on institutions
Diplomatic row with Russian embassy over governor's remarks
Positive cooperation: EU joint working group, Azerbaijan environmental projects

summary.en: Armenia's day was dominated by political strain: a G7 report on foreign interference in its elections, Russian calls to expel it from the CSTO, and opposition resistance to the TRIPP deal. Economic signals were also cautious, with a central bank warning and scheduled power cuts, though no crackdown or violence was clearly reported.

en: G7 report on foreign interference targeting Armenia's elections
Calls in Russian media to expel Armenia from the CSTO
Central bank warning on accumulating economic risks; scheduled power outages

summary.en: Armenia's period mixes a notable institutional step, parliament ratifying the US-backed TRIPP framework agreement, with sharp tensions with Russia over CSTO and EAEU membership, a parliamentary brawl, and reports of an 8% export decline and a record trade deficit. Taken together this is a politically tense but largely routine day, so the score sits near the neutral baseline.

en: Parliament ratified the US-backed TRIPP agreement with 63 votes
Foreign ministry rules out CSTO return; Russian officials escalate rhetoric
Brawl between ruling and opposition deputies in parliament

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: COP17 events, the US-backed TRIPP route approval and planned constitutional change, offset by a parliamentary brawl, a fatal ground collapse in Yerevan, and talk of early elections. The minor earthquake and the negative news tone do not on their own justify a lower score.

en: US-backed TRIPP route project approved by the government
Parliamentary brawl between deputies during a session
Fatal ground collapse in Yerevan near Salty Lake

summary.en: A mostly routine day: new residence and biometric passport rules, an EU review of the Armenia-Turkey border crossing, and flooding in Yerevan and Kotayk. Political tension showed up in a parliamentary brawl and a postponed church-related court case, and GDELT tone (-0.49) is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Flooding in Yerevan and Kotayk Province from heavy rain
Parliamentary brawl between majority and opposition
EU review of Armenia-Turkey border crossing work

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, anchored by the successful close of the COP17 biodiversity conference in Yerevan with the adopted Yerevan Pathway. Political friction (referendum debates, a parliamentary brawl, Moscow rejecting a new ambassador) and a reported Azerbaijani positional build-up are offset by a news tone that is less negative than the world average.

en: COP17 in Yerevan concluded with the Yerevan Pathway adopted
Domestic political friction over referendum and parliamentary brawl
Reported Azerbaijani force reinforcements near Lake Sevan area

summary.en: Armenia's period was positive overall, anchored by the COP17 presidency and the adoption of the Yerevan Pathway, plus preparatory steps on the TRIPP transit route and border handover to the border service. Routine frictions included scheduled power cuts, a rejected appeal to annul Stepanavan election results, and a Russian denial of an ambassador-nomination dispute.

en: Yerevan Pathway adopted at COP17 biodiversity summit
Preparatory work started on TRIPP railway and highway project
Border control being transferred to the border guard service

summary.en: The period looks routine: government steps on border control and investment, alongside ordinary domestic friction such as opposition clashes, vandalism, power cuts and a temporary airport schedule cut. Positive economic and institutional items roughly offset the mixed political tone.

en: Plan to transfer full border control to Armenian guards
UAE leads foreign investment; direct flights rise
Opposition-government tension over public pressure threats

summary.en: The day mixed positive EU-related developments (a possible 2027–2028 EU application, new EU trade preferences for Armenian goods) with police searches of opposition leaders' homes, which raise institutional-pressure concerns. Planned power cuts and a sharp cold snap add to the strain, and the negative news tone is more pronounced than the world average.

en: Searches of Karapetyan family and Strong Armenia leaders' homes
Planned power outages across multiple regions and Yerevan districts
Pashinyan's EU membership application timeline and EU trade preferences

summary.en: The period is dominated by court orders re-detaining opposition leader Samvel Karapetyan and extending Gagik Tsarukyan's detention, alongside criminal proceedings against 36 people and CSTO pressure over Armenia's membership. Positive items, such as the EU tax cooperation deal and the opposition's unity initiative, are minor by comparison, so the score sits in the serious-pressure range.

en: Samvel Karapetyan re-arrested for a month; second detention in six months
Tsarukyan detention extended by three months amid opposition pressure
Criminal proceedings against 36 people, including a former presidential administration head

summary.en: Armenia's news over the period is dominated by the arrest of opposition billionaire Karapetyan, with opposition figures alleging persecution, alongside Russian trade restrictions and EAEU/CSTO tensions. Scheduled electricity cuts across Yerevan and all regions add to the strain, though there is no violence or crisis, and some diplomatic and investment news is mildly positive.

en: Arrest of opposition billionaire Karapetyan and accusations of political persecution
Russian market restrictions and tensions over EAEU and CSTO membership
Scheduled electricity outages in Yerevan and all ten regions

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with some constructive developments: US, Armenian and Azerbaijani technical groups were set up for the TRIPP corridor, and Armenia expressed hope for diplomatic relations with Turkey. Tensions over CSTO membership and unpaid fees, plus opposition consolidation, add friction, but there is no crisis. GDELT tone (-0.40) is milder than the world average.

en: TRIPP corridor technical groups established with US and Azerbaijan
Armenia expresses optimism about diplomatic relations with Turkey
CSTO membership friction and possible suspension of voting rights

summary.en: The period mixes peace-track progress, including TRIPP working groups launched with the US and Azerbaijan and talk of EU candidacy, with domestic political strain: the arrest of opposition figure Karapetyan, opposition protests announced against constitutional change, and EU concern over selective prosecution. Tone is more negative than the world average, but no violent crackdown or crisis is reported, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Opposition announces protests against constitutional change; Karapetyan arrested
EU-raised concerns over selective prosecution could strain EU ties
TRIPP working groups launched, moving toward technical planning

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Russian officials pressing Armenia on EU versus EAEU membership, a modest opposition street protest met with rhetoric rather than a crackdown, and scheduled power cuts. The US-Armenia-Azerbaijan planning group for the Trump Peace Route and a $14M AI investment plan are modest positives, and the negative tone is only slightly worse than the world average.

en: US, Armenia and Azerbaijan launch planning group for peace route
Russian officials urge Armenia to hold EU referendum
Opposition street protests in Yerevan, with government accusations

summary.en: The period was marked by the death in custody of an opposition mayoral candidate, which raises concerns about political pressure and institutions, alongside a constitutional debate and CSTO tensions with Russia. Weather disruptions, power cuts, and new Iran trade and transit committees add mixed routine news, and GDELT tone is clearly more negative than the world average.
summary.tr: Dönem, muhalefet belediye başkanlığı adayının gözaltında ölmesiyle damgasını vurdu; bu olay siyasi baskı ve kurumlar konusunda kaygı doğuruyor. Buna anayasa tartışması ile Rusya'yla KGAÖ (CSTO) gerilimleri eşlik etti. Hava koşullarından kaynaklanan aksamalar, elektrik kesintileri ve İran'la yeni ticaret ve transit komiteleri karışık nitelikte rutin haberler ekledi; GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasına kıyasla belirgin biçimde daha olumsuz.
summary.es: El período estuvo marcado por la muerte bajo custodia de un candidato opositor a la alcaldía, lo que suscita preocupación por la presión política y las instituciones, junto con un debate constitucional y tensiones en la OTSC con Rusia. Las perturbaciones meteorológicas, los cortes de electricidad y los nuevos comités comerciales y de tránsito con Irán añaden noticias rutinarias de signo mixto, y el tono de GDELT es claramente más negativo que la media mundial.
summary.fr: La période a été marquée par le décès en détention d'un candidat d'opposition à la mairie, ce qui suscite des inquiétudes quant aux pressions politiques et aux institutions, parallèlement à un débat constitutionnel et à des tensions au sein de l'OTSC avec la Russie. Les perturbations météorologiques, les coupures de courant et les nouveaux comités commerciaux et de transit avec l'Iran ajoutent des informations de routine aux tendances contrastées, et le ton de GDELT est nettement plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum war vom Tod eines oppositionellen Bürgermeisterkandidaten in Haft geprägt, was Bedenken hinsichtlich politischen Drucks und der Institutionen aufwirft, begleitet von einer Verfassungsdebatte und Spannungen mit Russland innerhalb der OVKS. Wetterbedingte Störungen, Stromausfälle sowie neue Handels- und Transitausschüsse mit dem Iran bilden gemischte Routinemeldungen, und der GDELT-Ton ist deutlich negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: O período foi marcado pela morte sob custódia de um candidato da oposição à prefeitura, o que levanta preocupações sobre pressão política e instituições, juntamente com um debate constitucional e tensões na OTSC com a Rússia. Interrupções causadas pelo tempo, quedas de energia e novos comitês comerciais e de trânsito com o Irã acrescentam notícias de rotina de tom misto, e o tom do GDELT é claramente mais negativo que a média mundial.
summary.ja: 今回の期間は、野党の市長候補が拘留中に死亡したことで特徴づけられ、政治的圧力と諸制度に対する懸念が生じています。これに加え、憲法をめぐる議論や、ロシアとの集団安全保障条約機構（CSTO）をめぐる緊張もありました。悪天候による混乱、停電、イランとの貿易・交通に関する新たな委員会の設置など、日常的なニュースも混在しています。GDELTのトーンは世界平均と比べて明らかに否定的です。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 야당 시장 후보가 구금 중 사망한 사건으로 특징지어졌으며, 이는 정치적 압력과 제도에 대한 우려를 불러일으키고 있습니다. 헌법 논쟁과 러시아와의 집단안보조약기구(CSTO) 관련 긴장도 있었습니다. 기상 악화로 인한 차질, 정전, 이란과의 무역 및 교통에 관한 새로운 위원회 설치 등 일상적인 뉴스도 함께 보도되었습니다. GDELT의 논조는 세계 평균보다 뚜렷이 부정적입니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में एक विपक्षी मेयर उम्मीदवार की हिरासत में मृत्यु प्रमुख रही, जिससे राजनीतिक दबाव और संस्थाओं को लेकर चिंताएँ उठी हैं। साथ ही संविधान पर बहस और रूस के साथ सामूहिक सुरक्षा संधि संगठन (CSTO) को लेकर तनाव भी रहा। मौसम से जुड़ी बाधाएँ, बिजली कटौती और ईरान के साथ व्यापार और परिवहन पर नई समितियों जैसी सामान्य खबरें भी मिली-जुली रहीं। GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत की तुलना में स्पष्ट रूप से अधिक नकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος σημαδεύτηκε από τον θάνατο υποψήφιου δημάρχου της αντιπολίτευσης υπό κράτηση, γεγονός που εγείρει ανησυχίες για πολιτικές πιέσεις και θεσμούς, παράλληλα με συνταγματική συζήτηση και εντάσεις με τη Ρωσία στο πλαίσιο του ΟΣΣΑ. Καιρικές διαταραχές, διακοπές ρεύματος και νέες επιτροπές για το εμπόριο και τις μεταφορές με το Ιράν προσθέτουν μικτές καθημερινές ειδήσεις, ενώ ο τόνος στο GDELT είναι σαφώς πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.
summary.it: Il periodo è stato segnato dalla morte in custodia di un candidato sindaco dell'opposizione, che solleva preoccupazioni su pressioni politiche e istituzioni, insieme a un dibattito costituzionale e a tensioni con la Russia nell'ambito dell'OTSC. Disagi meteorologici, interruzioni di corrente e nuovi comitati commerciali e di transito con l'Iran aggiungono notizie di routine contrastanti, e il tono di GDELT è nettamente più negativo della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Период ознаменовался смертью в заключении кандидата в мэры от оппозиции, что вызывает опасения относительно политического давления и институтов, а также конституционными дебатами и напряжённостью с Россией в рамках ОДКБ. Погодные сбои, отключения электроэнергии и новые комитеты по торговле и транзиту с Ираном добавляют разнородные рутинные новости, а тон GDELT явно более негативен, чем среднемировой.
summary.ar: شهدت الفترة وفاة مرشح معارض لمنصب رئيس البلدية أثناء احتجازه، مما يثير مخاوف بشأن الضغوط السياسية والمؤسسات، إلى جانب نقاش دستوري وتوترات مع روسيا في إطار منظمة معاهدة الأمن الجماعي. وتضيف الاضطرابات الجوية وانقطاع الكهرباء ولجان التجارة والعبور الجديدة مع إيران أخبارًا روتينية متباينة، كما أن نبرة GDELT أكثر سلبية بوضوح من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: این دوره با مرگ یک نامزد شهرداری از اپوزیسیون در بازداشت مشخص شد که نگرانی‌ها درباره فشار سیاسی و نهادها را برمی‌انگیزد، و همچنین بحث قانون اساسی و تنش با روسیا در چارچوب سازمان پیمان امنیت جمعی. اختلال‌های آب‌وهوایی، قطعی برق و کمیته‌های جدید تجاری و ترانزیتی با ایران، اخبار روزمره‌ی متفاوتی به این مجموعه افزوده‌اند و لحن GDELT به‌وضوح منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 该时期以反对派市长候选人在羁押期间死亡为标志，引发对政治压力和机构的担忧，同时还有宪法辩论，以及亚美尼亚与俄罗斯在集体安全条约组织框架下的紧张关系。天气干扰、停电以及与伊朗新设的贸易和过境委员会带来了好坏参半的常规新闻，GDELT的语气明显比世界平均水平更为负面。

summary.en: War continues in Sudan. Drone attacks in Kordofan, Darfur, Khartoum and Abyei killed more than 100 civilians within 24 hours, including three children. A record parallel-market dollar rate and an increase in the customs dollar rate are deepening the economic collapse; the UN condemned the attacks.

en: Drone attacks in Kordofan, Darfur and Khartoum killed more than 100 civilians
An attack on a market in Abyei killed dozens of people and raised tensions with South Sudan
Drone attacks near Khartoum Airport; three children were killed and services were disrupted
The customs dollar rate rose to 5631 pounds, and the parallel-market exchange rate hit a record
Clashes in the Blue Nile and the continuing army-RSF war

summary.en: Sudan's period is dominated by mass drone strikes killing over 150 people at an Abyei market and more than 100 across Kordofan, Darfur and Khartoum, alongside child deaths, a severe bread shortage and famine warnings. Peace talks returning to Geneva are the only positive thread, which does not offset the ongoing mass violence.

en: Drone strike on Abyei market kills at least 153 people
Over 100 killed in drone attacks across Kordofan, Darfur, Khartoum
UN condemns drone strikes; warns of disrupted services nationwide

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues with intensive drone strikes, including a reported market strike in Abyei killing at least 153, and UN peace talks ended without progress. Currency collapse past 10,000 per dollar and hunger reports deepen the humanitarian catastrophe, with only minor positives such as reopened exam windows and a revived oil corporation.

en: Drone strike on Abyei market reportedly kills at least 153
UN peace talks end without progress amid deepening war
Pound falls past 10,000 per dollar; hunger crisis widens

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war is producing a major humanitarian crisis: 19.5 million people face food insecurity, drone strikes continue, and reports allege RSF attacks on hospitals in El-Fasher. Ceasefire talks in Geneva failed, and inflation is rising, with the dollar at SDG 10,300, though the army's recapture of Blue Nile areas is a minor counterpoint.

en: Ceasefire talks in Geneva failed again
19.5 million facing food insecurity amid violence
Reports of RSF deliberately targeting hospitals in El-Fasher

summary.en: Sudan's ongoing war continues with drone strikes killing at least 306 people in three weeks, reports of hospital attacks, an alleged massacre in Abyei, and a looming famine risk worsened by drought and aid shortfalls. Protests in army-held areas and market paralysis add to the picture, with only minor positives such as an army base retaken and press union recognition.

en: Drone strikes killed at least 306 people in three weeks
Famine risk warnings amid drought and declining aid
Alleged Abyei massacre and RSF attacks on hospitals

summary.en: Sudan's war is ongoing, with drone strikes causing mass casualties, reported massacres, and a strike on a senior RSF leader's residence. Modest positives, including RSF officer defections, army field gains, and renewed Quad diplomacy in Geneva, do not offset the widespread violence and humanitarian strain.

en: Drone attacks killed 306 people in October, per UN rights chief
Army strike on RSF leader's residence and reported commander deaths
Reported massacres and Amnesty torture allegations in El Fasher

summary.en: Sudan's war continues with famine warnings for 19.5 million people, drone strikes reported to have killed 306 in three weeks, and protests in Atbara. Diplomatic activity, including UN and Arab League efforts and expected dialogue steps, offers only a faint positive signal.

Drone strikes reportedly killed 306 people in three weeks
Protests in Atbara on 25 October anniversary

summary.en: Sudan's 24 hours were dominated by continued war: drone strikes killing 21 in Nyala, power stations hit causing mass outages across several states, and famine warnings from major powers, with the anniversary of the El Fasher atrocities recalling mass violence. Limited positives such as a proposed one-month humanitarian truce, aid pledges and a government removal of customs on basic foods do not offset the severity.

Famine warnings from US and allies; atrocities in El Fasher persist
UK sanctions on 15 commanders; US proposes one-month humanitarian truce

summary.en: Sudan's war continued over the last 24 hours with a drone strike on a South Darfur market reportedly killing over 100 people, drone attacks cutting power across Khartoum and other states, and Western governments warning of famine risk. No positive developments of note appear; the only offsetting item is a minor measure exempting basic foods from customs.

Drone attacks on power stations cause widespread blackouts in several states
US, EU and 30 countries warn of famine risk

Famine warnings, rising bread prices and UN calls for an arms embargo point to a severe humanitarian crisis.

Drone strikes on power stations and fuel depots cutting electricity

A UN envoy's expectation of RSF talks within weeks and Egypt-Sudan water cooperation are modest positives.

Sanctions and leaked reports on foreign mercenary involvement add to the sense of a deepening humanitarian and conflict crisis.

Positive signals, such as the arrest of an ICC-wanted figure and RSF defectors arriving in Khartoum, do not offset the ongoing humanitarian crisis.

summary.en: Sudan's war continues, with a drone strike in Blue Nile reportedly killing nine civilians, fires at oil fields, teacher strikes, and a 15.4 million-person aid need. Partial positives include Khartoum's gradual return to normal life, an RSF commander's defection, and the arrest of Ahmed Haroun, which is contested.
summary.it: La guerra in Sudan prosegue: un attacco di drone nel Nilo Azzurro avrebbe ucciso nove civili, si sono verificati incendi nei giacimenti petroliferi, gli insegnanti hanno scioperato e 15,4 milioni di persone necessitano di aiuti umanitari. Tra i segnali parzialmente positivi figurano il graduale ritorno alla normalità della vita a Khartoum, la defezione di un comandante delle RSF e l'arresto di Ahmed Haroun, che è contestato.
summary.ru: Война в Судане продолжается: по сообщениям, удар дрона в Голубом Ниле унес жизни девяти мирных жителей, на нефтяных месторождениях возникли пожары, учителя объявили забастовку, а 15,4 миллиона человек нуждаются в гуманитарной помощи. Частично обнадеживающие признаки включают постепенное возвращение Хартума к нормальной жизни, переход командира Сил быстрого реагирования (СБР) на сторону противника и арест Ахмеда Харуна, который оспаривается.
summary.ar: تستمر الحرب في السودان، إذ أفادت التقارير بمقتل تسعة مدنيين في غارة بطائرة مسيّرة في النيل الأزرق، واندلاع حرائق في حقول النفط، وإضراب المعلمين، وحاجة 15.4 مليون شخص إلى المساعدة الإنسانية. ومن الإيجابيات الجزئية عودة الحياة في الخرطوم إلى طبيعتها تدريجياً، وانشقاق قائد في قوات الدعم السريع، واعتقال أحمد هارون، وهو أمر محل خلاف.
summary.fa: جنگ در سودان ادامه دارد؛ بنا بر گزارش‌ها، حمله پهپادی در نیل آبی نه غیرنظامی را کشته، در میادین نفتی آتش‌سوزی رخ داده، معلمان اعتصاب کرده‌اند و 15.4 میلیون نفر به کمک‌های بشردوستانه نیاز دارند. از نشانه‌های مثبت نسبی می‌توان به بازگشت تدریجی زندگی عادی به خرطوم، جدا شدن یکی از فرماندهان نیروهای پشتیبانی سریع و بازداشت احمد هارون اشاره کرد که مورد مناقشه است.
summary.zh: 苏丹战事仍在继续：据报道，青尼罗州遭无人机袭击造成九名平民死亡；油田发生火灾；教师罢工；1540万人需要人道主义援助。部分积极迹象包括喀土穆生活逐步恢复正常、一名快速支援部队指挥官叛逃，以及艾哈迈德·哈伦被捕（该事件存在争议）。
summary.ja: スーダンの戦争は続いており、ブルーナイル州でのドローン攻撃により民間人9人が死亡したと報じられているほか、油田での火災、教師のストライキ、1,540万人が人道支援を必要としている状況が続いている。一部には前向きな動きもあり、ハルツームでは日常生活が徐々に戻りつつあり、RSF(即応支援部隊)の司令官が離反し、アフメド・ハルーンが逮捕されたが、この逮捕は争われている。
summary.ko: 수단의 전쟁은 계속되고 있으며, 블루나일주에서 드론 공격으로 민간인 9명이 사망했다고 보도되었고, 유전 화재와 교사 파업도 이어지고 있습니다. 1,540만 명이 인도적 지원을 필요로 하는 상황입니다. 일부 긍정적인 변화로는 하르툼에서 일상생활이 점차 정상화되고 있는 점, RSF 사령관의 이탈, 그리고 아흐메드 하룬의 체포가 있으나 이 체포는 논란이 되고 있습니다.
summary.hi: सूडान में युद्ध जारी है, ब्लू नाइल में एक ड्रोन हमले में कथित तौर पर नौ नागरिक मारे गए, तेल क्षेत्रों में आग लगी, शिक्षकों ने हड़ताल की, और 1.54 करोड़ लोगों को सहायता की आवश्यकता है। आंशिक सकारात्मक बातों में खार्तूम में धीरे-धीरे सामान्य जीवन की वापसी, एक RSF कमांडर का पाला बदलना, और अहमद हारून की गिरफ्तारी शामिल है, जो विवादित है।
summary.el: Ο πόλεμος στο Σουδάν συνεχίζεται, με αναφορές ότι επιδρομή drone στο Μπλε Νείλο σκότωσε εννέα αμάχους, πυρκαγιές σε πετρελαιοπηγές και απεργίες εκπαιδευτικών, ενώ 15,4 εκατομμύρια άνθρωποι χρειάζονται ανθρωπιστική βοήθεια. Μερικά θετικά στοιχεία περιλαμβάνουν τη σταδιακή επιστροφή της καθημερινότητας στο Χαρτούμ, την αυτομόληση ενός διοικητή των RSF και τη σύλληψη του Αχμέντ Χαρούν, η οποία αμφισβητείται.
summary.tr: Sudan'daki savaş sürüyor; Mavi Nil eyaletinde bir insansız hava aracı saldırısında dokuz sivilin öldüğü bildiriliyor, petrol sahalarında yangınlar çıkıyor, öğretmenler grev yapıyor ve 15,4 milyon kişinin insani yardıma ihtiyacı var. Kısmi olumlu gelişmeler arasında Hartum'un normal yaşama kademeli dönüşü, bir HDK komutanının firarı ve Ahmed Haroun'un tutuklanması yer alıyor; ancak tutuklama tartışmalı.
summary.es: La guerra en Sudán continúa: según se informa, un ataque con drones en el Nilo Azul mató a nueve civiles, se registran incendios en campos petroleros y huelgas de maestros, y 15,4 millones de personas necesitan ayuda humanitaria. Entre los avances parciales figuran el retorno gradual a la vida normal en Jartum, la deserción de un comandante de las FAR y el arresto de Ahmed Haroun, que está en disputa.
summary.fr: La guerre au Soudan se poursuit : selon les informations, une frappe de drone dans le Nil Bleu aurait tué neuf civils, des incendies touchent des champs pétroliers, des enseignants sont en grève et 15,4 millions de personnes ont besoin d'aide humanitaire. Parmi les évolutions partielles positives figurent le retour progressif à la vie normale à Khartoum, la défection d'un commandant des FSR et l'arrestation d'Ahmed Haroun, qui est contestée.
summary.de: Der Krieg im Sudan geht weiter: Ein Drohnenangriff im Blauen Nil soll neun Zivilisten getötet haben, auf Ölfeldern brechen Brände aus, Lehrer streiken, und 15,4 Millionen Menschen benötigen humanitäre Hilfe. Teilweise positive Entwicklungen sind die schrittweise Rückkehr zum normalen Leben in Khartum, die Abspaltung eines RSF-Kommandeurs und die umstrittene Festnahme von Ahmed Haroun.
summary.pt: A guerra no Sudão continua: um ataque com drone no Nilo Azul teria matado nove civis, há incêndios em campos de petróleo, greves de professores e 15,4 milhões de pessoas precisam de ajuda humanitária. Entre os avanços parciais estão o retorno gradual à vida normal em Cartum, a deserção de um comandante das FAR e a prisão de Ahmed Haroun, que é contestada.

summary.ja: ニュージーランドの平常の一日。選挙後の余波の分析と、地域の生活・スポーツ関連の話題が中心となった。株式市場は上昇し(NZX 50は当日+1.30%、週間で+3.22%)、NZドルはわずかに買われた。軽微なマイナス材料として、気象警報や景気低迷に関する言及があった。
summary.ko: 뉴질랜드의 평범한 하루였다. 선거 이후의 여파 분석과 지역 생활 및 스포츠 관련 소식이 주를 이루었다. 증시는 상승했고(NZX 50 당일 +1.30%, 주간 +3.22%), 뉴질랜드 달러는 완만한 지지를 받았다. 경미한 부정적 요인으로 기상 경보와 경기 침체 관련 언급이 있었다.
summary.hi: न्यूज़ीलैंड में एक सामान्य दिन रहा, जिसमें चुनाव के बाद के प्रभाव के विश्लेषण और स्थानीय जीवनशैली व खेल से जुड़ी खबरें हावी रहीं। बाज़ार में तेज़ी रही (NZX 50 दिन में +1.30%, सप्ताह में +3.22%) और NZD को हल्का समर्थन मिला, जबकि मौसम चेतावनियों और आर्थिक मंदी के उल्लेख मामूली नकारात्मक पहलू रहे।
summary.el: Μια συνηθισμένη μέρα στη Νέα Ζηλανδία, με κυρίαρχες τις αναλύσεις για τις επιπτώσεις μετά τις εκλογές και ειδήσεις για την τοπική καθημερινότητα και τον αθλητισμό. Οι αγορές ανέβηκαν (NZX 50 +1,30% την ημέρα, +3,22% την εβδομάδα) και το NZD σημείωσε ήπια άνοδο, ενώ ως μικρά αρνητικά στοιχεία αναφέρθηκαν προειδοποιήσεις καιρού και ανησυχίες για οικονομική κάμψη.
summary.tr: Yeni Zelanda'da seçim sonrası etkilere dair analizler ile yerel yaşam tarzı ve spor haberlerinin ağırlıkta olduğu olağan bir gün. Piyasalar yükseldi (NZX 50 gün içinde %1,30, hafta boyunca %3,22 arttı) ve NZD hafif destek gördü; hava durumu uyarıları ve ekonomik durgunluk ifadeleri küçük olumsuz etkenler olarak yer aldı.
summary.es: Un día habitual en Nueva Zelanda, dominado por el análisis de las secuelas postelectorales y por noticias locales de estilo de vida y deportes. Los mercados subieron (NZX 50 +1,30 % en la jornada, +3,22 % en la semana) y el NZD registró un leve apoyo, con algunas menciones a alertas meteorológicas y a una desaceleración económica como factores negativos menores.
summary.fr: Une journée ordinaire en Nouvelle-Zélande, dominée par l'analyse des répercussions post-électorales et par des sujets locaux sur le mode de vie et le sport. Les marchés ont progressé (NZX 50 en hausse de 1,30 % sur la journée et de 3,22 % sur la semaine) et le NZD a bénéficié d'un léger soutien, tandis que quelques alertes météorologiques et mentions de ralentissement économique ont constitué des facteurs négatifs mineurs.
summary.de: Ein routinemäßiger Tag in Neuseeland, geprägt von Analysen zu den Nachwirkungen der Wahl sowie lokalen Lifestyle- und Sportberichten. Die Märkte legten zu (NZX 50 am Tag +1,30 %, in der Woche +3,22 %), und der NZD verzeichnete eine leichte Unterstützung; Wetterwarnungen und Erwähnungen einer Konjunkturflaute bildeten geringfügige negative Faktoren.
summary.pt: Um dia de rotina na Nova Zelândia, dominado pela análise das repercussões pós-eleitorais e por notícias locais de estilo de vida e desporto. Os mercados subiram (NZX 50 +1,30% no dia, +3,22% na semana) e o NZD registou ligeiro apoio, com algumas referências a alertas meteorológicos e a uma desaceleração económica como fatores negativos menores.

en: NZX 50 gained 1.30% on the day and 3.22% over the week
Mild NZD support after the election, per FX commentary
Severe thunderstorm and flood watches across the North Island
it: L'NZX 50 ha guadagnato l'1,30% nella giornata e il 3,22% nel corso della settimana

summary.en: Indonesia is experiencing its worst forest fire season since 2015. The fires have burned about two million hectares, smoke has spread, and 2,600 flights were disrupted. The stock market fell 18% in a month, one of its sharpest declines since 1998, and faces a possible MSCI downgrade. Today's 5,65% rebound does not reverse this picture. Protests are also taking place on Prabowo's second anniversary in office, with more than 9.000 security personnel deployed and falling public support.

en: The worst forest fire and smoke crisis since 2015, burning about two million hectares
A record two-day stock market collapse and MSCI pressure; an 18% monthly loss, with a partial rebound today
Protests on Prabowo's second anniversary, heavy security measures and declining public support
Suspension of foreign aid offers for the fires and tensions with neighbouring countries
KPK corruption investigations that also cover BNPB

summary.en: Indonesia faces several serious pressures at once: student protests over living costs and forest fires, a worsening haze crisis with Singapore's enforcement action, and a sharp equity sell-off (down about 11% in a week) tied to MSCI classification concerns. Positive items such as EU drought aid and a rediscovered primate are minor by comparison.

en: Student protests over living costs and fires; 9,505 security personnel deployed
Haze crisis: Singapore expands crackdown; 2,600+ flights disrupted
IDX down 10.78% week and 16.95% month amid MSCI dispute

summary.en: Indonesia faces a stock market rout of about 14% over a month after an MSCI downgrade threat, student protests over living costs and forest fires, fuel and power shortages in parts of the country, and a ferry fire. Partial offsets include a one-day market rebound, Danantara's plan to deploy capital, and improving fuel supply in Bali.

en: Student protests over living costs and forest fires spread nationwide
Market rout after MSCI downgrade threat; Prabowo rejects intimidation
Forest fire haze causing health harm; fuel and power shortages in Kaltim

summary.en: The period is dominated by a widening haze crisis that has disrupted thousands of flights, plus an MSCI downgrade risk that has pushed the IDX down about 15% over the month. Partial offsets include a one-week stock rebound, a $22.94B investment expo tally and routine economic and investment news.

en: Widening haze crisis; thousands of flights affected
MSCI downgrade risk and a 14.7% monthly fall in the IDX
Gas export halt debate and regional tensions ahead of ASEAN summit

summary.en: The period is mostly routine local news, but a severe haze crisis is sparking student protests and fires in Papua and South Sumatra. Gas export cuts to Singapore and an MSCI-related market concern add economic strain, though the stock index rebounded over the past week and the overall tone is not strongly negative.

en: Worst haze in over a decade sparks student protests
Gas exports to Singapore cut to prioritise domestic demand
MSCI report criticised by minister; index down 14.7% in a month

summary.en: Indonesia's period is dominated by a worsening haze crisis, with student and public protests, a cut in gas exports to Singapore, and drought warnings from El Nino. Market stress is also visible after the MSCI announcement, though the stock index rose over the past day and week, and most other coverage is routine.

en: Haze crisis triggers protests and tourism cancellations across the region
Gas export cut to Singapore prioritises domestic demand
MSCI announcement stirs market stress; authorities moving to stabilise

summary.en: Mixed day: wildfire hotspots fell by more than half and the stock index rebounded over the week, but the index is down 14% over the month after an MSCI-triggered rout, and a gas export dispute with Singapore and haze costs weigh on the outlook. A deadly clash in Bandung and an ongoing corruption trial add to the negatives, so the picture is close to an ordinary period.

en: Fire hotspots fell by more than half to 147
IDX down 14% over the month after MSCI-triggered rout
Gas export cuts to Singapore spark diplomatic friction

summary.en: The period mixes routine local news with several serious stresses: the IDX fell 2.48% on the day and 16% over the month, the rupiah weakened to 18,140 per dollar, and wildfire haze is hitting Sumatra and Kalimantan. A diplomatic row with Singapore over gas exports and haze, plus concerns about rule of law, add to the pressure, though first rains are bringing some relief.

en: IDX down 16% over the month and 2.48% on the day
Rupiah weakened to 18,140 per US dollar
Wildfire haze crisis; first rains bring partial relief

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Youth Pledge commemorations, investment announcements such as a US$500 million Batam semiconductor project, and a Singapore-Indonesia haze task force. Offsetting this are a diplomatic spat with Singapore, student protests in Jakarta, and a 14% monthly fall in the stock index.

en: Singapore-Indonesia spat over haze, gas and internet cable threats
Student demonstrations in Jakarta and detention of a student union head
Joint haze task force and US$500M Batam semiconductor project

summary.en: Indonesia faces large student and public protests over haze, wildfires, graft and living costs, with security forces being deployed in advance. The IDX fell 3.49% on the day and 16.72% over the month, signalling market stress, though bilateral haze agreements and a landmark ruling on civilian trials of soldiers offset some of the negatives.

en: Large protests over haze, graft and living costs; security buildup
IDX down 16.72% over one month and 3.49% in one day
Singapore-Indonesia agreements on haze and energy cooperation

summary.en: The 24-hour news flow is mostly routine local coverage, but it is dominated by serious strains: the IDX has fallen 16.7% over a month amid MSCI concerns, rupiah pressure is noted, and a wildfire-haze crisis is linked to a study estimating 3,560 deaths. A Yogyakarta unrest episode with 116 victims adds to the strain, partly offset by growth and infrastructure items.

en: IDX down 16.7% in a month, MSCI concerns weighing on investors
Study links September wildfire smoke to 3,560 deaths
20 companies named as suspects in forest fire crackdown

summary.en: Indonesia's period is dominated by serious problems: a deadly fire-haze crisis with reports of over 3,000 deaths, floods in North Sumatra, and a sharp stock market slide (down 16.7% over a month). Partial offsets include Eni's gas production start and routine government and business news, but the overall picture is clearly negative.

en: Fire pollution reportedly killed over 3,000 people in September
IDX down 16.7% in a month and 7% in a week
Haze and wildfires across five provinces; floods in North Sumatra

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: domestic media report investment milestones and ordinary policy news, and rains are reported to be easing the wildfire crisis. Offsetting this, the IDX has fallen 16.7% over a month and foreign outlets report smog linked to thousands of deaths.

en: IDX down 16.7% over one month and 7% over one week
Wildfire smog and reported deaths, though hotspots fell to 96
Rains arriving to ease fire crisis; domestic investment reported at Rp2,000 trillion

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with several concerns: the IDX fell about 15.6% over the month, MSCI warned about the economy, and student protests are gaining momentum with little government response. A court ruling against the vice president's school certificate and a fatal landslide add to the strain, partly offset by investment announcements and falling wildfire hotspots.

en: IDX down 15.57% over one month and 5.14% over one week
Student protests gaining momentum with little government response
Supreme Court annulled vice president's high school certificate

summary.en: The period combines serious stress signals: the IDX fell 3.78% in a day and 18.76% over a month, with an MSCI warning, and wildfires have scorched 1.9 million hectares, causing regional haze frustration. Floods and a landslide added humanitarian strain, partly offset by routine gas supply and manufacturing investment news.

en: IDX down 3.78% in one day, 18.76% in a month
Wildfires scorch 1.9 million hectares; regional haze frustration
MSCI warning on Indonesia's market standing

summary.en: Indonesia's period is dominated by a serious institutional crisis: three police generals, including a former police chief, were detained over an alleged wiretap of President Prabowo, and over 20,000 troops were deployed to Jakarta. Markets are under strain, with the IDX down 19.6% over a month and rupiah weakness concerns, though manufacturing PMI hit a strong 54.0 and export orders rose.

en: Generals detained over alleged wiretapping of the president
Over 20,000 troops deployed to Jakarta amid probe
IDX down 19.6% in a month; rupiah pressure concerns

summary.en: Indonesia's period is dominated by a wiretapping scandal involving generals' arrests and a heavy troop deployment in Jakarta, with foreign media reporting high tension. Compounding this, the most intense wildfires in 11 years are spreading across several islands, and the stock index is down about 19% over the month, though routine governance and trade news continued.

en: Thousands of troops deployed in Jakarta after generals' arrests over wiretapping
Most intense wildfires in 11 years across Sumatra, Borneo and Papua
IDX down 18.77% over one month despite a one-day rebound

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and positive economic news (Q3 GDP at 5.47%, Alibaba Cloud's second data center) with stress signals: a wiretapping scandal involving the president, a rift between Prabowo and Jokowi, Borneo forest fires needing foreign aid, and a 17.8% monthly fall in the IDX. On balance this is a near-ordinary day with a slightly negative lean.

en: Presidential wiretapping scandal and the resulting political rupture
Q3 GDP growth of 5.47% and strong East Java growth
Forest fires in Borneo with Australian military support

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic news (5.87% manufacturing growth, new investment commitments, falling brawl cases) with negative stories: protests over data centres and a wiretap scandal, a helicopter crash with a missing crew member, and haze-related health and fire problems. The IDX fell 17.84% over the month, though it was flat over the week, so the day is roughly ordinary with some strain.

en: Manufacturing output grew 5.87%, led by furniture
Data-centre water shortage protests and wiretap scandal coverage
Haze: over 400,000 respiratory infections; fires still active

summary.en: The day mixes routine news with some negatives: a firefighting helicopter crash that killed a crew member amid wildfires and haze, and a mosque attack whose suspect has been named. Foreign investment commitments and a mild one-day stock gain offset this, though the one-month fall of about 17% in the index is a notable concern.

en: Firefighting helicopter crash kills crew member amid wildfires
Investment commitments of $138m from Europe and $385m from the UK
IDX down about 17% over the past month

summary.en: The period mixes routine Hero's Day coverage with several serious problems: a wildfire haze crisis with over 400,000 respiratory cases, fatal firefighting helicopter crashes, a wave of cyberattacks on banks, and flooding in Aceh and Bali. The Vice President's reported intent to step down adds political strain, though the stock market rebounded over the week and GDELT tone is slightly positive.
summary.it: Il periodo combina la normale copertura del Giorno dell'Eroe con diversi problemi seri: una crisi di foschia dovuta agli incendi boschivi con oltre 400.000 casi di malattie respiratorie, incidenti mortali di elicotteri impiegati nelle operazioni antincendio, un'ondata di attacchi informatici contro le banche e alluvioni ad Aceh e Bali. La presunta intenzione del Vicepresidente di dimettersi aggiunge tensione politica, sebbene il mercato azionario si sia ripreso nel corso della settimana e il tono di GDELT sia leggermente positivo.
summary.ru: Период сочетает обычное освещение Дня героев с несколькими серьёзными проблемами: кризис задымления от лесных пожаров с более чем 400 000 случаями респираторных заболеваний, смертельные катастрофы вертолётов, задействованных в тушении пожаров, волну кибератак на банки и наводнения в Ачехе и на Бали. Сообщаемое намерение вице-президента уйти в отставку добавляет политической напряжённости, хотя фондовый рынок за неделю восстановился, а тональность GDELT слегка положительная.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين التغطية الروتينية ليوم البطل وعدد من المشكلات الخطيرة: أزمة ضباب دخاني ناجم عن حرائق الغابات أدت إلى أكثر من 400,000 حالة من أمراض الجهاز التنفسي، وتحطم مروحيات قاتل خلال عمليات إطفاء الحرائق، وموجة من الهجمات الإلكترونية على البنوك، وفيضانات في آتشيه وبالي. ويضيف ما ذُكر عن نية نائب الرئيس الاستقالة ضغطاً سياسياً، على الرغم من تعافي سوق الأسهم خلال الأسبوع وكون نبرة GDELT إيجابية بشكل طفيف.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از پوشش معمول روز قهرمان با چند مشکل جدی است: بحران مه دودی ناشی از آتش‌سوزی جنگل‌ها با بیش از 400,000 مورد بیماری تنفسی، سقوط مرگبار بالگردهای آتش‌نشانی در کالیمانتان، موجی از حملات سایبری به بانک‌ها و سیل در آچه و بالی. قصد گزارش‌شده معاون رئیس‌جمهور برای استعفا فشار سیاسی را افزایش می‌دهد، هرچند بازار سهام در طول هفته بهبود یافت و لحن GDELT اندکی مثبت است.
summary.zh: 这一时期既有例行的英雄日报道，也有若干严重问题：野火烟霾危机导致超过400,000例呼吸道疾病病例，灭火直升机发生致命坠机事故，银行遭遇网络攻击浪潮，以及亚齐和巴厘岛发生洪灾。据报道副总统有意辞职，增加了政治压力，不过股市在本周出现反弹，GDELT语气略微偏正面。
summary.tr: Dönem, Kahramanlar Günü'ne ilişkin rutin haberleri birkaç ciddi sorunla bir arada sunuyor: 400.000'den fazla solunum yolu hastalığı vakasına yol açan orman yangını dumanı krizi, ölümcül yangınla mücadele helikopter kazaları, bankalara yönelik siber saldırı dalgası ve Aceh ile Bali'deki sel felaketleri. Başkan Yardımcısının görevinden çekilme niyetinin bildirilmesi siyasi baskıyı artırsa da borsa hafta boyunca toparlandı ve GDELT tonu hafifçe olumlu.
summary.es: El periodo combina la cobertura habitual del Día de los Héroes con varios problemas graves: una crisis por la neblina de los incendios forestales con más de 400.000 casos respiratorios, accidentes mortales de helicópteros de extinción de incendios, una oleada de ciberataques contra bancos e inundaciones en Aceh y Bali. La supuesta intención del vicepresidente de dimitir añade tensión política, aunque la bolsa se recuperó durante la semana y el tono de GDELT es ligeramente positivo.
summary.fr: La période mêle la couverture habituelle de la Journée des héros à plusieurs problèmes graves : une crise de brume liée aux feux de forêt ayant causé plus de 400 000 cas de maladies respiratoires, des accidents mortels d'hélicoptères engagés dans la lutte contre les incendies, une vague de cyberattaques contre les banques et des inondations à Aceh et à Bali. L'intention rapportée du vice-président de démissionner ajoute une pression politique, bien que la Bourse ait rebondi au cours de la semaine et que le ton de GDELT soit légèrement positif.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet die übliche Berichterstattung zum Heldentag mit mehreren ernsten Problemen: eine Krise durch Dunst von Waldbränden mit über 400.000 Fällen von Atemwegserkrankungen, tödliche Hubschrauberabstürze bei Löscheinsätzen, eine Welle von Cyberangriffen auf Banken sowie Überschwemmungen in Aceh und Bali. Die berichtete Absicht des Vizepräsidenten, zurückzutreten, verschärft den politischen Druck, doch der Aktienmarkt erholte sich im Laufe der Woche und der GDELT-Tonwert ist leicht positiv.
summary.pt: O período combina a cobertura rotineira do Dia do Herói com vários problemas sérios: uma crise de névoa causada por incêndios florestais, com mais de 400.000 casos de doenças respiratórias, acidentes fatais com helicópteros de combate a incêndios, uma onda de ataques cibernéticos a bancos e inundações em Aceh e Bali. A intenção relatada do vice-presidente de renunciar acrescenta pressão política, embora o mercado de ações tenha se recuperado ao longo da semana e o tom do GDELT seja levemente positivo.
summary.ja: この期間には、英雄の日の定例報道に加え、いくつかの深刻な問題が含まれている。山火事によるヘイズ危機では40万人を超える呼吸器疾患の症例が出ており、消火活動中のヘリコプター墜落事故で死者が出ている。銀行へのサイバー攻撃が相次ぎ、アチェとバリでは洪水も発生した。副大統領が辞任する意向と報じられたことで政治的な緊張も高まっているが、株式市場は週を通じて反発し、GDELTのトーンはわずかに肯定的である。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 영웅의 날 관련 일상적인 보도와 함께 여러 심각한 문제가 겹쳤다. 산불로 인한 연무 위기로 40만 명이 넘는 호흡기 질환 환자가 발생했고, 칼리만탄의 진화 작업 중 헬리콥터 추락 사고로 사망자가 나왔다. 은행을 겨냥한 사이버 공격이 급증했으며 아체와 발리에서는 홍수가 발생했다. 부통령의 사임 의향이 보도되면서 정치적 긴장도 더해졌지만, 주식시장은 한 주 동안 반등했고 GDELT 어조는 약간 긍정적이다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में हीरोज़ डे की नियमित कवरेज के साथ कई गंभीर समस्याएँ भी शामिल हैं: जंगल की आग से उत्पन्न धुंध संकट में 4 लाख से अधिक श्वसन रोग के मामले सामने आए, अग्निशमन अभियानों के दौरान हेलीकॉप्टर दुर्घटनाओं में लोगों की मौत हुई, बैंकों पर साइबर हमलों की लहर आई, और आचेह तथा बाली में बाढ़ आई। उपराष्ट्रपति के पद छोड़ने के कथित इरादे से राजनीतिक दबाव बढ़ा है, हालांकि सप्ताह भर शेयर बाज़ार में सुधार आया और GDELT का स्वर थोड़ा सकारात्मक रहा।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει την συνήθη κάλυψη της Ημέρας των Ηρώων με αρκετά σοβαρά προβλήματα: μια κρίση αιθαλομίχλης από πυρκαγιές δασών με πάνω από 400.000 περιστατικά αναπνευστικών παθήσεων, θανατηφόρες συντριβές ελικοπτέρων σε επιχειρήσεις κατάσβεσης πυρκαγιών, κύμα κυberεπιθέσεων σε τράπεζες και πλημμύρες στο Ατσέ και στο Μπαλί. Η αναφερόμενη πρόθεση του Αντιπροέδρου να παραιτηθεί προσθέτει πολιτική πίεση, ωστόσο το χρηματιστήριο ανέκαμψε μέσα στην εβδομάδα και ο τόνος του GDELT είναι ελαφρώς θετικός.

summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 흐름이었다. IMF 실무단의 활동 개시, 정상 운영 중인 국경 검문소, 시위 이후 철회된 학교 폐쇄, 그리고 통상적인 치안 및 범죄인 인도 관련 소식이 있었다. EU와의 관계를 둘러싼 갈등, 정당 해산 소송, 전직 총리에 대한 비공개 재판, 계속되는 시위를 통해 정치적 긴장은 지속되고 있으며, GDELT 어조는 뚜렷하게 부정적이다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य रही: IMF मिशन की शुरुआत, सीमा चौकी का सामान्य रूप से संचालन, विरोध प्रदर्शनों के बाद स्कूल बंद करने के फ़ैसले का पलटना, और सामान्य पुलिस कार्रवाई तथा प्रत्यर्पण से जुड़ी ख़बरें। EU के साथ संबंधों पर विवाद, किसी पार्टी पर प्रतिबंध संबंधी मुकदमा, एक पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री की बंद-दरवाज़ा सुनवाई और जारी विरोध प्रदर्शनों के ज़रिए राजनीतिक तनाव बना हुआ है, और GDELT का लहजा स्पष्ट रूप से नकारात्मक है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος ήταν κυρίως ρουτινική: έναρξη της αποστολής του ΔΝΤ, κανονική λειτουργία του συνοριακού σταθμού ελέγχου, ανάκληση του κλεισίματος σχολείου μετά από διαμαρτυρίες, και συνηθισμένα νέα για την αστυνόμευση και την έκδοση εκζητουμένων. Η πολιτική ένταση συνεχίζεται μέσα από τη διαφορά για τις σχέσεις με την ΕΕ, μια δικαστική υπόθεση για απαγόρευση κόμματος, τη δίκη κεκλεισμένων των θυρών του πρώην πρωθυπουργού και τις συνεχιζόμενες διαμαρτυρίες, ενώ ο τόνος των δεδομένων GDELT είναι έντονα αρνητικός.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde olağan seyrediyor: IMF heyetinin çalışmalarına başlaması, sınır kontrol noktasının normal çalışması, protestoların ardından geri alınan bir okul kapatma kararı ve sıradan asayiş ve iade haberleri. AB ilişkileri üzerindeki anlaşmazlık, bir parti kapatma davası, bir eski başbakanın kapalı kapılar ardında yargılanması ve süregelen protestolar üzerinden siyasi gerginlik sürüyor; GDELT tonu belirgin biçimde olumsuz.
summary.es: El período es mayormente rutinario: inicio de la misión del FMI, puesto fronterizo que funciona con normalidad, una clausura escolar revertida tras protestas, y noticias habituales de policía y extradición. La tensión política persiste por la disputa con la UE, una demanda para disolver un partido, el juicio a puerta cerrada de un ex primer ministro y las protestas en curso, y el tono de GDELT es marcadamente negativo.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : début de la mission du FMI, poste frontalier fonctionnant normalement, fermeture d'école annulée après des manifestations, et actualités ordinaires de police et d'extradition. Les tensions politiques persistent, avec le différend avec l'UE, une procédure visant l'interdiction d'un parti, le procès à huis clos d'un ancien Premier ministre et les manifestations en cours ; le ton de GDELT est nettement négatif.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig: Beginn der IWF-Mission, Grenzkontrollstelle arbeitet normal, eine nach Protesten zurückgenommene Schulschließung sowie übliche Polizei- und Auslieferungsmeldungen. Die politischen Spannungen bleiben bestehen – durch den Streit mit der EU, eine Klage auf Parteiverbot, den nichtöffentlichen Prozess gegen einen ehemaligen Premierminister und anhaltende Proteste; der GDELT-Ton ist deutlich negativ.
summary.pt: O período é majoritariamente rotineiro: início da missão do FMI, posto de fronteira operando normalmente, fechamento de escola revertido após protestos, e notícias comuns de policiamento e extradição. A tensão política persiste com a disputa com a UE, uma ação para banir um partido, o julgamento à porta fechada de um ex-primeiro-ministro e os protestos em curso; o tom do GDELT é acentuadamente negativo.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: avvio della missione del FMI, posto di frontiera che opera normalmente, una chiusura scolastica revocata dopo le proteste, e notizie ordinarie su polizia ed estradizioni. La tensione politica persiste tra la disputa sulle relazioni con l'UE, una causa per lo scioglimento di un partito, il processo a porte chiuse contro un ex premier e le proteste in corso, e il tono GDELT è nettamente negativo.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: начало миссии МВФ, пограничный пункт работает в штатном режиме, закрытие школы отменено после протестов, а также обычные новости о полицейской деятельности и экстрадиции. Политическое напряжение сохраняется из-за спора об отношениях с ЕС, иска о запрете партии, закрытого процесса над бывшим премьер-министром и продолжающихся протестов; тональность GDELT заметно негативная.

summary.fa: این دوره بیشتر عادی است: آغاز ماموریت صندوق بین‌المللی پول، کار عادی ایستگاه مرزی، لغو تعطیلی یک مدرسه پس از اعتراضات، و اخبار معمول پلیس و استرداد. فشار سیاسی ادامه دارد؛ از اختلاف بر سر روابط با اتحادیه اروپا، دعوای ممنوعیت یک حزب، محاکمه غیرعلنی یک نخست‌وزیر پیشین و اعتراضات جاری، و لحن GDELT به‌طور محسوسی منفی است.

summary.en: In the last 24 hours, the armed killing of former prosecutor and anti-corruption lawyer Juan Francisco Solórzano Foppa became the main story both at home and abroad. The UN Secretary-General called for an investigation, concerns about political crime resurfaced, and the withdrawal of detentions is weakening the credibility of the investigation. Rain damage in Petén and some investment news partly balance the picture, but the factor that determines the score is high-profile political violence and problems of institutional trust.

Withdrawal of detentions and damage to the credibility of the investigation over torture allegations
Request for a state of emergency in Guatemala department and security concerns

summary.ja: この期間は主にルーティンのニュースで構成されており、スポーツ、観光、ビジネス、地域の犯罪報道などが中心です。否定的な要素としては、サルストゥーン川周辺でのベリーズとの軍事侵入をめぐる紛争と、プロパンガス価格の40％上昇があります。一方、米国制裁に対する上訴の取り下げと新しい農業大臣の就任がこれを相殺しています。
summary.ko: 이 기간은 대부분 스포츠, 관광, 기업, 지역 범죄 보도 등 일상적인 뉴스로 구성되어 있습니다. 부정적인 요인으로는 사르스툰에서 벨리즈와 벌어진 군사 침입 분쟁과 프로판 가스 가격의 40% 상승이 있으며, 미국 제재에 대한 항소 철회와 새 농업부 장관 임명으로 일부 상쇄되었습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर नियमित समाचारों से भरी है: खेल, पर्यटन, व्यापार और स्थानीय अपराध रिपोर्ट। नकारात्मक पहलुओं में सरस्टून में कथित सैन्य घुसपैठ को लेकर बेलीज़ के साथ विवाद और प्रोपेन गैस की कीमतों में 40% की वृद्धि शामिल हैं, जिन्हें अमेरिकी प्रतिबंधों के विरुद्ध अपील की वापसी और एक नए कृषि मंत्री की नियुक्ति से संतुलित किया गया है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος αποτελείται κυρίως από συνήθη νέα: αθλητισμό, τουρισμό, επιχειρήσεις και τοπικά δελτία εγκληματικότητας. Τα αρνητικά περιλαμβάνουν μια διαφορά με το Μπελίζ για φερόμενη στρατιωτική είσοδο στο Sarstoon και αύξηση 40% στις τιμές του προπανίου, που αντισταθμίζονται από την απόσυρση έφεσης κατά κυρώσεων των ΗΠΑ και τον διορισμό νέου υπουργού Γεωργίας.
summary.it: Il periodo è caratterizzato per lo più da notizie di routine: sport, turismo, economia e cronaca locale. Tra gli aspetti negativi figurano una controversia con il Belize per una presunta incursione militare a Sarstoon e un aumento del 40% dei prezzi del gas propano, compensati dal ritiro di un ricorso contro le sanzioni statunitensi e dalla nomina di un nuovo ministro dell'agricoltura.
summary.ru: Период в основном характеризуется рутинными новостями: спорт, туризм, бизнес и сообщения о местной преступности. К негативным моментам относятся спор с Белизом из-за предполагаемого военного вторжения в Сарстун и рост цен на пропан на 40%, которые уравновешиваются отзывом апелляции против санкций США и назначением нового министра сельского хозяйства.
summary.ar: تتألف الفترة في معظمها من أخبار روتينية: الرياضة والسياحة والأعمال وتقارير الجريمة المحلية. ومن السلبيات النزاع مع بليز حول ادعاء توغل عسكري في سارستون، وارتفاع أسعار غاز البروبان بنسبة 40%، ويقابل ذلك سحب استئناف ضد العقوبات الأمريكية وتعيين وزير جديد للزراعة.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً شامل اخبار روزمره است: ورزش، گردشگری، اقتصاد و گزارش‌های جرم و جنایت محلی. از جنبه‌های منفی می‌توان به اختلاف با بلیز بر سر ادعای تجاوز نظامی در سارستون و افزایش ۴۰ درصدی قیمت گاز پروپان اشاره کرد که با پس گرفتن درخواست تجدیدنظر علیه تحریم‌های آمریکا و انتصاب وزیر جدید کشاورزی تا حدی متعادل می‌شود.

Entre los aspectos negativos figuran la disputa con Belice por una supuesta incursión militar en Sarstoon y un aumento del 40 % en el precio del propano, compensados por la retirada de una apelación contra las sanciones de EE. UU. y el nombramiento de un nuevo ministro de Agricultura.
summary.fr: La période est principalement composée d'actualités courantes : sport, tourisme, affaires et faits divers locaux. Les aspects négatifs incluent un différend avec le Belize au sujet d'une incursion militaire présumée à Sarstoon et une hausse de 40 % des prix du propane, compensés par le retrait d'un recours contre les sanctions américaines et la nomination d'un nouveau ministre de l'Agriculture.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum besteht überwiegend aus Routinenachrichten: Sport, Tourismus, Wirtschaft und lokale Kriminalberichte. summary.pt: O período é composto em grande parte por notícias de rotina: esportes, turismo, negócios e casos policiais locais. Os aspectos negativos incluem a disputa com Belize sobre uma suposta incursão militar em Sarstoon e um aumento de 40% nos preços do gás propano, compensados pela desistência de um recurso contra as sanções dos EUA e pela nomeação de um novo ministro da Agricultura.

summary.ja: 経済・投資関連の報道は日常的から穏やかに前向きな内容です(見本市、世界銀行の農業推進、輸出機会)。GDELTのトーンは世界平均を上回っています。一方で、野党が全国的な業務停止と「愛国的警告日」を呼びかけ、車列が阻止され、ボートの転覆で3人が死亡しました。ただし、暴力的な取り締まりは報告されていません。
summary.ko: 경제 및 투자 관련 보도는 일상적이거나 다소 긍정적입니다(무역 박람회, 세계은행의 농업 지원 확대, 수출 기회). GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 높습니다. 반면 야당이 전국적인 업무 중단과 '애국적 경고의 날'을 촉구했고, 차량 행렬이 차단되었으며, 보트 전복으로 3명이 사망했습니다. 다만 폭력적인 진압은 보고되지 않았습니다.
summary.hi: आर्थिक और निवेश से जुड़ी कवरेज सामान्य से लेकर हल्की सकारात्मक है (व्यापार मेला, विश्व बैंक का कृषि पर ज़ोर, निर्यात के अवसर), और GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से ऊपर है। इसके विपरीत, विपक्ष ने देशव्यापी बंद और 'देशभक्ति चेतावनी दिवस' का आह्वान किया, एक काफ़िले को रोका गया, और एक नाव पलटने से तीन लोगों की मौत हो गई, हालांकि किसी हिंसक दमन की खबर नहीं है।
summary.el: Η οικονομική και επενδυτική κάλυψη είναι συνήθης έως ήπια θετική (εμπορική έκθεση, η ώθηση της Παγκόσμιας Τράπεζας στη γεωργία, ευκαιρίες εξαγωγών), και ο τόνος του GDELT βρίσκεται πάνω από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο. Σε αντιστάθμιση, η αντιπολίτευση κάλεσε σε πανεθνική αποχή από εργασία και σε «ημέρα πατριωτικής προειδοποίησης», μια αυτοκινητοπομπή μπλοκαρίστηκε και η ανατροπή ενός σκάφους σκότωσε τρεις ανθρώπους, χωρίς ωστόσο να αναφέρεται βίαιη καταστολή.
summary.tr: Ekonomi ve yatırım haberleri rutin ila hafifçe olumlu seyrediyor (ticaret fuarı, Dünya Bankası'nın tarım girişimi, ihracat fırsatları) ve GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasının üzerinde. Buna karşılık muhalefet ülke çapında bir grev/kepenk kapatma ve 'vatansever uyarı günü' çağrısı yaptı, bir konvoy engellendi ve bir teknenin alabora olması üç kişinin ölümüne yol açtı; ancak şiddet içeren bir bastırma bildirilmemiştir.
summary.es: La cobertura económica y de inversiones es rutinaria o ligeramente positiva (feria comercial, impulso del Banco Mundial a la agricultura, oportunidades de exportación), y el tono de GDELT está por encima del promedio mundial. Como contrapeso, la oposición convocó a un paro nacional y a un 'día de advertencia patriótica', se bloqueó una caravana y el vuelco de una embarcación dejó tres muertos, aunque no se reporta una represión violenta.
summary.fr: La couverture économique et d'investissement est routinière à légèrement positive (salon commercial, initiative de la Banque mondiale pour l'agriculture, opportunités d'exportation), et le ton de GDELT est supérieur à la moyenne mondiale. En contrepoint, l'opposition a appelé à une grève générale nationale et à une « journée d'alerte patriotique », un convoi a été bloqué, et le chavirement d'une embarcation a fait trois morts, sans qu'aucune répression violente ne soit signalée.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung über Wirtschaft und Investitionen ist routinemäßig bis leicht positiv (Handelsmesse, Agrarinitiative der Weltbank, Exportchancen), und der GDELT-Tonwert liegt über dem weltweiten Durchschnitt. Dem gegenüber steht, dass die Opposition einen landesweiten Shutdown und einen „patriotischen Warntag“ ausgerufen hat, ein Konvoi blockiert wurde und das Kentern eines Bootes drei Todesopfer forderte; über ein gewaltsames Eingreifen wird jedoch nicht berichtet.
summary.pt: A cobertura econômica e de investimentos é rotineira a levemente positiva (feira comercial, iniciativa do Banco Mundial para a agricultura, oportunidades de exportação), e o tom do GDELT está acima da média mundial. Em contrapartida, a oposição convocou uma paralisação nacional e um 'dia de alerta patriótico', um comboio foi bloqueado e o naufrágio de uma embarcação matou três pessoas, embora não haja relatos de repressão violenta.
summary.it: La copertura economica e sugli investimenti è di routine o moderatamente positiva (fiera commerciale, impulso della Banca Mondiale all'agricoltura, opportunità di esportazione), e il tono di GDELT è superiore alla media mondiale. A compensare, l'opposizione ha indetto una chiusura nazionale e una 'giornata di avvertimento patriottico', un convoglio è stato bloccato e il ribaltamento di un'imbarcazione ha causato tre morti, sebbene non siano segnalate repressioni violente.
summary.ru: Освещение экономики и инвестиций носит рутинный или умеренно позитивный характер (торговая ярмарка, инициатива Всемирного банка в сфере сельского хозяйства, экспортные возможности), а тон GDELT выше среднемирового. Этому противостоят призыв оппозиции к всенациональной забастовке и «дню патриотического предупреждения», блокировка колонны и опрокидывание лодки, в результате которого погибли три человека, однако сообщений о насильственных подавлениях не поступало.
summary.ar: التغطية الاقتصادية والاستثمارية روتينية أو إيجابية بشكل معتدل (معرض تجاري، دفعة من البنك الدولي لقطاع الزراعة، فرص تصديرية)، وتونية GDELT أعلى من المتوسط العالمي. في المقابل، دعت المعارضة إلى إضراب وطني و«يوم تحذير وطني»، وتم منع قافلة من الوصول، وأدى انقلاب قارب إلى مقتل ثلاثة أشخاص، ولم يُبلَّغ عن قمع عنيف.
summary.fa: پوشش خبری اقتصادی و سرمایه‌گذاری عادی تا نسبتاً مثبت است (نمایشگاه تجاری، حمایت بانک جهانی از بخش کشاورزی، فرصت‌های صادراتی) و لحن GDELT بالاتر از میانگین جهانی است. در مقابل، اپوزیسیون خواستار تعطیلی سراسری و «روز هشدار میهنی» شده، یک کاروان مسدود شده و واژگونی یک قایق سه کشته برجای گذاشته است، هرچند گزارشی از سرکوب خشونت‌آمیز منتشر نشده است.

summary.en: The period mixes routine politics and party events with a significant cholera outbreak (over 2,850 cases in 13 districts), an Ebola alert in the south, and flooding around Lake Tanganyika. summary.tr: Dönem, rutin siyasi ve parti etkinliklerini; 13 ilçede 2.850'den fazla vakayla önemli bir kolera salgınını, güneyde bir Ebola uyarısını ve Tanganyika Gölü çevresindeki sel felaketini bir arada içermektedir. Bunları kısmen dengeleyen gelişmeler arasında cumhurbaşkanlığının Dünya Bankası ile görüşmesi, makroekonomik göstergelerin umut verici olarak nitelendirilmesi ve yeni bir rotavirüs aşısının uygulamaya konulması yer almaktadır.
summary.es: El período combina la política rutinaria y los actos de partido con un brote significativo de cólera (más de 2.850 casos en 13 distritos), una alerta de ébola en el sur y inundaciones en torno al lago Tanganica. En parte, esto se compensa con la reunión de la presidencia con el Banco Mundial, cifras macroeconómicas descritas como alentadoras y la introducción de una nueva vacuna contra el rotavirus.
summary.fr: La période mêle politique courante et événements partisans à une épidémie importante de choléra (plus de 2 850 cas dans 13 districts), une alerte à Ebola dans le sud et des inondations autour du lac Tanganyika. En partie compensé par ces éléments, la présidence a rencontré la Banque mondiale, les chiffres macroéconomiques ont été décrits comme encourageants et un nouveau vaccin contre le rotavirus a été introduit.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet routinemäßige politische und parteiliche Veranstaltungen mit einem bedeutenden Choleraausbruch (über 2.850 Fälle in 13 Distrikten), einer Ebola-Warnung im Süden und Überschwemmungen rund um den Tanganjikasee. Teilweise ausgeglichen wird dies dadurch, dass die Präsidentschaft mit der Weltbank zusammentraf, makroökonomische Zahlen als ermutigend beschrieben wurden und ein neuer Rotavirus-Impfstoff eingeführt wurde.
summary.pt: O período combina política de rotina e eventos partidários com um surto significativo de cólera (mais de 2.850 casos em 13 distritos), um alerta de ebola no sul e inundações em torno do Lago Tanganyika. Em parte compensando isso, a presidência reuniu-se com o Banco Mundial, os números macroeconômicos foram descritos como encorajadores e uma nova vacina contra o rotavírus foi introduzida.
summary.ja: この期間は、定例の政治活動や党の行事と、重大なコレラの流行（13の郡で2,850件超の症例）、南部でのエボラ警報、タンガニーカ湖周辺の洪水が入り混じっています。一方で、大統領府は世界銀行と会談し、マクロ経済指標は好ましいものと評価され、新しいロタウイルスワクチンが導入されました。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 일상적인 정치 활동과 정당 행사가 있었던 한편, 13개 지구에서 2,850건이 넘는 사례가 보고된 대규모 콜레라 발생, 남부 지역의 에볼라 경보, 탕가니카 호수 주변의 홍수가 함께 있었습니다. 이와 상쇄되는 소식으로는 대통령실이 세계은행과 만났고, 거시경제 지표가 고무적인 것으로 평가되었으며, 새로운 로타바이러스 백신이 도입되었습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में नियमित राजनीतिक और पार्टी गतिविधियों के साथ कई गंभीर घटनाएँ भी शामिल हैं, जिनमें 13 जिलों में 2,850 से अधिक मामलों वाला हैजा (कॉलरा) का प्रकोप, दक्षिण में इबोला चेतावनी और तांगानिका झील के आसपास बाढ़ शामिल हैं। इसके आंशिक संतुलन के रूप में, राष्ट्रपति कार्यालय ने विश्व बैंक से मुलाकात की, समष्टि आर्थिक आंकड़ों को उत्साहजनक बताया गया, और एक नया रोटावायरस टीका शुरू किया गया।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει τυπική πολιτική δραστηριότητα και κομματικές εκδηλώσεις με σημαντική επιδημία χολέρας (πάνω από 2.850 κρούσματα σε 13 περιφέρειες), συναγερμό για Έμπολα στο νότο και πλημμύρες γύρω από τη λίμνη Ταγκανίκα. Εν μέρει αντισταθμιστικά, η Προεδρία συναντήθηκε με την Παγκόσμια Τράπεζα, τα μακροοικονομικά στοιχεία χαρακτηρίστηκαν ενθαρρυντικά και εισήχθη ένα νέο εμβόλιο κατά του ροταϊού.
summary.it: Il periodo unisce politica di routine ed eventi di partito a un significativo focolaio di colera (oltre 2.850 casi in 13 distretti), un allerta per Ebola nel sud e inondazioni intorno al Lago Tanganica. In parte compensano questo aspetti positivi: la presidenza ha incontrato la Banca Mondiale, i dati macroeconomici sono stati descritti come incoraggianti ed è stato introdotto un nuovo vaccino contro il rotavirus.

Отчасти этому противовесом служат встреча президентуры со Всемирным банком, описание макроэкономических показателей как обнадеживающих и введение новой вакцины против ротавируса.

Les signalements d'une détérioration de la situation sécuritaire l'emportent sur les rares faits routiniers, ce qui place la situation dans la catégorie des problèmes graves sans atteindre la guerre ni l'effondrement de l'État.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum wird von politischer Gewalt bestimmt: Brandanschläge, primitive Bombenexplosionen in Dhaka und anderen Distrikten, ein lebendig verbrannter Busfahrer sowie Einsätze der BGB inmitten von Unruhen unter Textilarbeitern. Berichte über eine sich verschlechternde Sicherheitslage überwiegen die wenigen Routinemeldungen, was die Lage deutlich in den Bereich ernster Probleme einordnet, ohne Krieg oder Staatszerfall zu erreichen.
summary.pt: O período é dominado pela violência política: ataques incendiários, explosões de bombas caseiras em Dhaka e outros distritos, um motorista de ônibus queimado vivo e destacamentos do BGB em meio à agitação dos trabalhadores têxteis. Os relatos de deterioração da situação de segurança superam os poucos itens rotineiros, o que coloca a situação em território de problemas sérios sem chegar à guerra ou ao colapso do Estado.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato dalla violenza politica: attentati incendiari, esplosioni di ordigni rudimentali a Dacca e in altri distretti, un autista di autobus bruciato vivo e dispiegamenti del BGB in mezzo ai disordini dei lavoratori del settore tessile. Le segnalazioni di un deterioramento della situazione di sicurezza prevalgono sulle poche notizie di routine, il che colloca la situazione ben oltre i problemi seri senza però raggiungere la guerra o il collasso dello Stato.
summary.ru: Период характеризуется политическим насилием: поджоги, взрывы самодельных бомб в Дакке и других округах, сожжённый заживо водитель автобуса и развёртывание BGB на фоне волнений рабочих текстильной промышленности. Сообщения об ухудшении ситуации с безопасностью перевешивают немногочисленные рутинные события, что относит ситуацию к категории серьёзных проблем, но не до уровня войны или распада государства.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة أعمال العنف السياسي: هجمات حرق متعمد وتفجيرات بعبوات بدائية في دكا ومناطق أخرى، وإحراق سائق حافلة حيًا، ونشر قوات حرس الحدود البنغلاديشي وسط اضطرابات عمال صناعة الملابس. وتفوق التقارير عن تدهور الوضع الأمني العناصر الروتينية القليلة، مما يضع الوضع في خانة المشكلات الخطيرة دون أن يبلغ حد الحرب أو انهيار الدولة.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر خشونت سیاسی است: حملات آتش‌زنی، انفجارهای بمب‌های دست‌ساز در داکا و دیگر ناحیه‌ها، سوزاندن زنده یک راننده اتوبوس و استقرار BGB در میان ناآرامی کارگران پوشاک. گزارش‌های وخامت اوضاع امنیتی بر شمار اندک موارد عادی می‌چربد، که این وضعیت را در قلمرو مشکلات جدی قرار می‌دهد، بی‌آنکه به جنگ یا فروپاشی دولت برسد.
summary.zh: 该时期以政治暴力为主：纵火袭击、在达卡及其他地区发生的简易炸弹爆炸、一名公交车司机被活活烧死，以及在服装工人骚乱期间边境卫队（BGB）的部署。关于安全局势恶化的报道多于少数例行事项，使局势处于严重问题的范畴，但尚未达到战争或国家崩溃的程度。
summary.ja: 今期は政治的暴力が中心となっており、放火攻撃、ダッカをはじめとする各県での粗末な爆弾による爆発、バスの運転手が焼死した事件、そして縫製労働者の抗議行動を受けたBGBの展開が報じられている。治安状況の悪化に関する報道が、わずかな定例事項を上回っており、戦争や国家崩壊には至らないものの、深刻な問題が生じている範囲に十分該当する。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 정치적 폭력이 지배적이다. 방화 공격, 다카를 비롯한 여러 県에서 발생한 조잡한 폭탄 폭발, 버스 기사가 산 채로 불에 탄 사건, 그리고 의류 노동자 소요에 따른 BGB 배치가 보고되었다. 치안 상황 악화에 관한 보도가 소수의 일상적 사안을 압도하고 있어 심각한 문제 범주에 해당하지만, 전쟁이나 국가 붕괴 수준에는 이르지 않았다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में राजनीतिक हिंसा प्रमुख रही है: आगजनी के हमले, ढाका और अन्य ज़िलों में देसी बमों के विस्फोट, एक बस ड्राइवर को ज़िंदा जलाया जाना, और गारमेंट श्रमिकों की अशांति के बीच BGB की तैनाती। सुरक्षा स्थिति बिगड़ने की रिपोर्टें कुछ नियमित समाचारों पर भारी हैं, जिससे यह स्थिति गंभीर समस्याओं की श्रेणी में आती है, हालांकि यह युद्ध या राज्य के पतन तक नहीं पहुँचती।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από πολιτική βία: εμπρηστικές επιθέσεις, πρόχειρες βομβιστικές εκρήξεις στη Ντάκα και σε άλλες περιφέρειες, ένας οδηγός λεωφορείου που κάηκε ζωντανός, και αναπτύξεις της BGB εν μέσω αναταραχής των εργατών της ένδυσης. Οι αναφορές για επιδείνωση της κατάστασης ασφαλείας υπερτερούν των λίγων συνήθων ειδήσεων, γεγονός που την τοποθετεί σαφώς στην κατηγορία των σοβαρών προβλημάτων, χωρίς ωστόσο να φτάνει σε επίπεδο πολέμου ή κατάρρευσης του κράτους.

Негативные сообщения ограничиваются гибелью двух трудовых мигрантов из Бангладеш, спором о платежах российских туристов и дракой во время дайвинга; ни одно из них не указывает на более широкий кризис.
summary.ar: تتألف الفترة في معظمها من تغطية روتينية للسياحة: رحلات جوية جديدة، وتعيينات في الفنادق، وافتتاح منتجعات. وتقتصر الأخبار السلبية على وفاة عاملين مهاجرين من بنغلاديش اثنين، ونزاع حول مدفوعات السياح الروس، واشتباك أثناء الغوص، ولا يشير أي منها إلى أزمة أوسع.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً شامل پوشش معمول گردشگری است: پروازهای جدید، انتصاب‌های هتلی و افتتاح استراحتگاه‌ها. موارد منفی به مرگ دو کارگر مهاجر بنگلادشی، اختلاف بر سر پرداخت‌های گردشگران روسی و یک درگیری در غواصی محدود می‌شود و هیچ‌یک نشانه‌ای از بحران گسترده‌تر نیست.
summary.zh: 这一时期的报道大多是例行的旅游新闻：新航线、酒店任命和度假村开业。负面消息仅限于两名孟加拉国农民工死亡、一起关于俄罗斯游客付款的纠纷以及一起潜水时的冲突，均不表明存在更广泛的危机。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin turizm haberlerinden oluşuyor: yeni uçuşlar, otel randevuları ve tatil beldesi açılışları. Olumsuz haberler, iki Bangladeşli göçmen işçinin ölümü, bir Rus turist ödemeleri üzerindeki anlaşmazlık ve bir dalış kavgasıyla sınırlı; hiçbiri daha geniş bir krizin işareti değil.
summary.es: El período consiste en su mayoría en cobertura turística rutinaria: nuevos vuelos, citas en hoteles y lanzamientos de complejos turísticos. Los hechos negativos se limitan a la muerte de dos trabajadores migrantes bangladesíes, una disputa sobre los pagos de turistas rusos y una riña durante una inmersión, ninguno de los cuales indica una crisis más amplia.
summary.fr: La période est essentiellement consacrée à une couverture touristique de routine : nouveaux vols, rendez-vous hôteliers et lancements de complexes touristiques. Les éléments négatifs se limitent à la mort de deux travailleurs migrants bangladais, à un différend concernant les paiements de touristes russes et à une altercation lors d'une plongée, sans signe d'une crise plus large.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum besteht überwiegend aus routinemäßiger Tourismusberichterstattung: neue Flüge, Hotelbuchungen und Eröffnungen von Ferienanlagen. Negative Meldungen beschränken sich auf den Tod von zwei bangladeschischen Wanderarbeitern, einen Streit über Zahlungen russischer Touristen und eine Auseinandersetzung beim Tauchen; keine deutet auf eine umfassendere Krise hin.
summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, cobertura turística de rotina: novos voos, compromissos em hotéis e lançamentos de resorts. Os itens negativos limitam-se à morte de dois trabalhadores migrantes bangladeshis, a uma disputa sobre pagamentos de turistas russos e a um desentendimento num mergulho, nenhum sinalizando uma crise mais ampla.
