summary.en: In Haiti, gangs carried out their largest attack yet against the newly deployed international Gang Suppression Force, with at least 4-5 Salvadoran soldiers missing or kidnapped. BINUH recorded more than 1,100 deaths in two months, gangs are launching new attacks in Artibonite, and the UN Security Council notes that elections remain suspended. Routine news such as school openings, cultural events and candidate statements does not change the picture; widespread violence and the collapse of state capacity keep the score very low.

en: Gangs' largest attack on the international force, with Salvadoran soldiers missing
More than 1,100 deaths and 440 injured in two months, according to BINUH data
Gang attack on Petite-Rivière in Artibonite
Elections suspended over security concerns, stalling the political process
Football-related tensions with the Dominican Republic (secondary)

summary.en: Gangs ambushed a foreign-led security force, leaving four Salvadoran soldiers missing and prompting a US embassy warning and more Guatemalan troops. Partial positives, such as 2,000+ new police officers integrated and continued police operations in Kenscoff, do not offset the violence, and the election calendar remains unresolved.

en: Gang ambush on foreign GSF troops; four Salvadoran soldiers missing
Guatemala sending additional troops amid escalating attacks
2,000+ new police officers integrated into the PNH

summary.en: Haiti's period was dominated by gang violence: an attack on foreign troops described as the largest since the new force began operating, and the kidnapping of Salvadoran soldiers followed by a announced military rescue operation. Elections have been postponed and a suspected cyberattack has disrupted banks, with only minor positive items such as a tax-code notice and a corporate loyalty launch.

en: Gang attack on foreign troops, biggest since new force began
Abduction of Salvadoran soldiers and military rescue operation
Elections postponed amid gang pressure on security

summary.en: Violent gang fighting and the kidnapping of four Salvadoran soldiers dominate the period, with a military rescue mission launched and the Dominican border militarized. Some routine positive items (a diplomatic post, cultural and institutional launches) and weather alerts do not offset the serious security pressure.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers kidnapped by gangs; rescue mission launched
Violent combat reported near the Dominican border; border militarized
Foreign troop deployment approved by CARICOM amid gang violence

summary.en: Gang violence dominates the period: four Salvadoran soldiers were reported kidnapped, Salvadoran and other foreign troops were deployed to search for them, and 7,250 people were displaced by armed violence in Artibonite. Coverage also cites recent massacres in Kenscoff, and the negative news tone is well below the world average, while routine economic and cultural items are minor offsets.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers reported kidnapped by gangs; foreign troop deployment
7,250 people displaced by armed violence in Petite-Rivière de l'Artibonite
Reports of massacres in Kenscoff and calls for accountability

summary.en: Four Salvadoran soldiers operating in Haiti were ambushed and their bodies were found, prompting a major Salvadoran military deployment amid gang violence and regional tension. Other news includes a diphtheria resurgence and a crowded presidential election field, with few signs of institutional progress.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers ambushed by gangs and found dead
Major Salvadoran military operation and troop deployment into Haiti
Diphtheria cases rising in Haiti

summary.en: Haiti's period is dominated by gang-driven violence and displacement in Artibonite, orange security alerts in five departments, and Dominican Republic border reinforcements with two battalions. A dispute over remains possibly belonging to missing Salvadoran soldiers adds diplomatic tension, while electoral candidacy filings are routine.

en: Gang violence causing population displacement in Artibonite
Five departments under orange security alert
Dominican Republic deploying two battalions to border

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious security problems: the disappearance of four Salvadoran soldiers, foreign troop deployments, gang advances, self-defence groups forming, and a loud explosion in Port-au-Prince. Flooding, a critical press-freedom situation and very negative news tone (-1.93 vs. a world average of -0.52) add to the strain, with only the U-15 World Cup win as a bright spot.

en: Four Salvadoran soldiers disappeared; Bukele deploys elite troops
Self-defence groups formed to stop gang advances
Flooding and intempéries causing serious difficulties across zones

summary.en: Haiti's day was dominated by a gang ambush that left four Salvadoran UN-backed force members missing, prompting a rapid deployment of about 1,000 more troops, alongside deadly flooding and landslides with several deaths. Minor positives, such as a youth football win and a water-access project, do not offset the serious security and disaster problems.

en: Gang ambush leaves four Salvadoran force members missing; reports of deaths
Around 1,000 Salvadoran troops rushed in; security escalation
Heavy rains cause flooding, landslides, deaths and missing people

summary.en: Haiti's day was dominated by escalating gang violence and a military crisis: an ambush left Salvadoran soldiers missing, about 2,000 Salvadoran troops were deployed, and elections were postponed to July 2027. Nearly 6 million people face severe hunger, and flood deaths add to a major humanitarian strain.

en: Elections postponed again to July 2027 amid violence
Salvadoran troop deployment after ambush; four soldiers missing
Nearly 6 million facing severe hunger; famine worsening

summary.en: Haiti faces serious strain over the period: elections were postponed to July 2027, about 6 million people face severe hunger, floods are being reported, and gangs kidnapped four Salvadoran soldiers, prompting a deployment of over 2,000 foreign troops. Modest positives, such as an electrification plan, a city-centre stabilisation project and resumed US flights, do not offset the security and humanitarian picture.

en: Elections postponed to July 2027 after years of delays
Nearly 6 million people in severe hunger, per UN report
Over 2,000 Salvadoran troops deployed after soldiers were kidnapped by gangs

summary.en: The period is dominated by El Salvador's deployment of about 2,000 troops to Haiti after four soldiers went missing, alongside reports of record hunger and frequent telecom fibre cuts. Routine diplomatic and police-recruitment news is present but overshadowed by a foreign military intervention and sovereignty concerns.

en: Foreign military deployment of about 2,000 Salvadoran troops amid gang violence
Record hunger levels reported by multiple outlets
Abduction of four soldiers triggering a rescue operation

summary.en: Haiti's period mixes security steps, including 2,000 Salvadoran troops starting patrols and 1,189 new police graduating, with a postponed election calendar (first round moved to July 2027). Allegations that Salvadoran forces bombed civilians, and a negative news tone well below the world average, keep the score in the serious-problems range rather than crisis.

en: Election first round postponed to July 2027, straining institutions
2,000 Salvadoran troops deployed for street patrols against gangs
Allegations of civilian bombings by Salvadoran forces, denied by Bukele

summary.en: Foreign military operations against gangs, including a search for four missing soldiers and NGO allegations of civilian bombings, dominate the period, alongside ongoing insecurity that keeps tourism and travel suspended. Partial positives, such as American Airlines resuming flights to Cap-Haitien and regional logistics support for the international mission, do not offset the serious security and humanitarian concerns.

en: Salvadoran military offensive against gangs; civilian bombing allegations denied
NGO and MSF calls to protect civilians and medical facilities
Royal Caribbean extends cruise suspension to Haiti until 2028

summary.en: Haiti's period mixes serious security and humanitarian strain, including over 4,000 deaths January to October, a hunger crisis affecting about 6 million people, and intensifying gang clashes. Partial positives include the resumption of American Airlines flights, a 1,189-officer police graduation, and a gang leader's request for UN dialogue.

en: Over 4,000 killed January to October amid gang violence
Gang clashes intensify; leader requests UN-mediated dialogue
Nearly 6 million face severe food insecurity

summary.en: A Salvadoran-backed security operation against gangs in the Cul-de-Sac plain has produced clashes and reported deaths, and a gang leader is warning of reprisals and seeking UN mediation. Routine economic items, such as an airline's return and diaspora investment appeals, offer only minor offsetting positives.

en: Foreign-backed military operation against gangs in Cul-de-Sac plain
Reported deaths in clashes; gang leader warns of reprisals
Gang leader seeks UN mediation amid rising violence

summary.en: Haiti's period is dominated by a Salvadoran military deployment against gangs, with an ambush, reported deaths of Salvadoran troops, and intensifying clashes. Partial positives include announced election dates, the prime minister's public backing for the operation, and routine health and education news, but the security situation is clearly serious.

en: Gang ambush killed or left missing four Salvadoran troops; vehicle found burned
Salvadoran military deployment launched; clashes with gangs intensify
Haiti announces new election dates amid ongoing gang fighting

summary.en: Haiti's period is dominated by a Salvadoran military offensive against gangs, warnings of civilian bloodbath, and four missing Salvadoran soldiers whose burned vehicle was found. Food insecurity affects 5.94 million people and the tourism cruise stop at Labadee has been cancelled, while routine diplomacy and electoral preparations continue.

en: Salvadoran troop offensive against gangs with warnings of civilian harm
Four missing Salvadoran soldiers; burned vehicle found
5.94 million Haitians in food insecurity per CNSA

summary.en: Haiti's period was dominated by gang violence and a foreign military deployment, with gunfights persisting and four Salvadoran troops still missing. Partial positives included the reported killing of gang leader Mathias Saintil and an outreach offer from a powerful gang to the disarmament group, alongside routine administrative news.

en: Gang leader Mathias Saintil reported killed in police drone operation
Powerful gang reaches out to government disarmament group amid gunfights
Four Salvadoran troops still missing after gang ambush; burned vehicle found

summary.en: Haiti's period mixes security escalation, with Salvadoran troops operating against gangs and gang leader Mathias Saintil reported killed by drone strike, and some positive signals, including a prevention and recovery pact entering into force and a gang reaching out for peace. Foreign coverage flags risks of escalation and the death toll, and GDELT tone is strongly negative.

en: Gang leader Saintil reported killed in drone operation in Cité-Soleil
Prevention and recovery pact for Haiti entered into force
Foreign troop deployment raises escalation and civilian risk concerns

summary.en: Haiti's period is dominated by an intensified security offensive: a gang boss was reportedly killed in a drone strike, a gang has reportedly sought talks, and about 2,000 Salvadoran troops are joining operations. Ongoing gang violence, missing foreign nationals and street demands for a tougher campaign keep the score in the serious-problems range, though the World Bank reform plan and election preparations offer some counterweight.

en: Gang leader Mathias Saintil reportedly killed in drone strike or shooting
Gang reportedly seeks talks via letter to the UN
Salvadoran troop deployment of about 2,000 soldiers into Haiti

summary.en: Haiti's period is dominated by an ongoing security crisis: a Salvadoran military offensive against gangs with unclear rules and reports of civilian harm, a declared humanitarian emergency in Arcahaie, and continued kidnappings, partly offset by a freed kidnap victim and election-preparation steps. Institutions are functioning, but the gang conflict and foreign-troop controversy weigh heavily.
summary.it: Il periodo di Haiti è dominato da una crisi di sicurezza in corso: un'offensiva militare salvadoregna contro le bande con regole poco chiare e segnalazioni di danni ai civili, un'emergenza umanitaria dichiarata ad Arcahaie e rapimenti continui, in parte compensati dalla liberazione di una vittima di sequestro e dai passi compiuti in vista delle elezioni. Le istituzioni funzionano, ma il conflitto con le bande e la controversia sulle truppe straniere pesano molto.
summary.ru: Период на Гаити определяется продолжающимся кризисом безопасности: наступление сальвадорских военных против банд с неясными правилами и сообщениями о вреде мирным жителям, объявленная гуманитарная чрезвычайная ситуация в Арканье и продолжающиеся похищения, отчасти компенсируемые освобождением похищенной жертвы и шагами по подготовке выборов. Институты функционируют, однако конфликт с бандами и спор вокруг иностранных военных создают серьезное давление.
summary.ar: تتسم هذه الفترة في هايتي بأزمة أمنية مستمرة: هجوم عسكري سلفادوري على العصابات تكتنفه قواعد اشتباك غير واضحة وتقارير عن أضرار لحقت بالمدنيين، وإعلان حالة طوارئ إنسانية في أركاهي، واستمرار عمليات الاختطاف، ويخفف من وطأة ذلك تحرير ضحية اختطاف وخطوات التحضير للانتخابات. المؤسسات تعمل، لكن النزاع مع العصابات والجدل حول القوات الأجنبية يثقلان الوضع بشدة.
summary.fa: دوره کنونی هائیتی تحت تأثیر بحران امنیتی مداوم است: حمله نظامی ال‌سالوادور به باندها با قواعد نامشخص و گزارش‌هایی از آسیب به غیرنظامیان، اعلام وضعیت اضطراری بشردوستانه در آرکاهی، و ادامه آدم‌ربایی‌ها، که تا حدی با آزادی یک قربانی آدم‌ربایی و اقدامات آماده‌سازی انتخابات تعدیل می‌شود. نهادها فعال هستند، اما درگیری با باندها و جنجال درباره نیروهای خارجی فشار زیادی وارد می‌کند.
summary.zh: 海地近期局势主要受持续的安全危机主导：萨尔瓦多军队对帮派发动攻势，规则不明确，并有平民受害的报道；阿卡海被宣布进入人道主义紧急状态；绑架事件仍在持续。一名被绑架者获释以及选举筹备工作的推进在一定程度上起到缓解作用。机构仍在运转，但帮派冲突和外国军队争议构成沉重压力。
summary.tr: Haiti'deki dönem, süregen bir güvenlik krizi tarafından belirleniyor: belirsiz kurallara sahip ve sivillere zarar verildiğine dair haberler bulunan, çetelere karşı bir Salvador askeri harekâtı; Arcahaie'de ilan edilen insani acil durum ve devam eden kaçırmalar. Bunları kısmen dengeleyen ise kaçırılıp serbest bırakılan bir kurban ile seçim hazırlığı adımları. Kurumlar işlevini sürdürüyor, ancak çete çatışması ve yabancı asker tartışması ağır bir yük oluşturuyor.
summary.es: El periodo de Haití está dominado por una crisis de seguridad en curso: una ofensiva militar salvadoreña contra las pandillas, con reglas poco claras y denuncias de daños a civiles; una emergencia humanitaria declarada en Arcahaie y secuestros continuos. Lo compensan en parte la liberación de una víctima de secuestro y los pasos de preparación electoral. Las instituciones funcionan, pero el conflicto con las pandillas y la polémica por las tropas extranjeras pesan considerablemente.
summary.fr: La période en Haïti est dominée par une crise sécuritaire persistante : une offensive militaire salvadorienne contre les gangs, aux règles d'engagement peu claires et accompagnée de signalements de dommages causés aux civils, une urgence humanitaire déclarée à Arcahaie et des enlèvements qui se poursuivent. Ces faits sont en partie compensés par la libération d'une victime d'enlèvement et par des mesures de préparation des élections. Les institutions fonctionnent, mais le conflit avec les gangs et la controverse autour des troupes étrangères pèsent lourdement.
summary.de: Die Lage in Haiti wird von einer anhaltenden Sicherheitskrise bestimmt: eine salvadorianische Militäroffensive gegen Banden mit unklaren Einsatzregeln und Berichten über Schäden für Zivilisten, ein ausgerufener humanitärer Notstand in Arcahaie sowie anhaltende Entführungen. Teilweise ausgeglichen wird dies durch die Freilassung eines Entführungsopfers und Schritte zur Vorbereitung der Wahlen. Die Institutionen funktionieren, doch der Bandenkonflikt und die Kontroverse um ausländische Truppen belasten die Lage stark.
summary.pt: O período no Haiti é dominado por uma crise de segurança em curso: uma ofensiva militar salvadorenha contra gangues, com regras pouco claras e relatos de danos a civis, uma emergência humanitária declarada em Arcahaie e sequestros contínuos. Isso é compensado em parte pela libertação de uma vítima de sequestro e por medidas de preparação para as eleições. As instituições estão funcionando, mas o conflito com as gangues e a polêmica sobre tropas estrangeiras pesam muito.
summary.ja: ハイチの現在の情勢は、継続中の治安危機が中心となっています。ルールが不明確なまま行われているエルサルバドル軍によるギャングへの攻勢と、民間人への被害の報告、アルカエイでの人道的緊急事態の宣言、そして誘拐事件の継続が含まれます。一方で、誘拐された被害者の解放や選挙準備の措置も見られます。諸機関は機能しているものの、ギャングとの紛争や外国軍をめぐる論争が重くのしかかっています。
summary.ko: 아이티의 현재 상황은 지속되는 치안 위기가 지배하고 있습니다. 규칙이 명확하지 않은 엘살바도르군의 갱단 대상 공세와 민간인 피해 보고, 아르카이에 지역의 인도적 비상사태 선포, 계속되는 납치 사건이 그것입니다. 이에 일부 상쇄되는 요소로 납치 피해자의 석방과 선거 준비 조치가 있습니다. 제도는 작동하고 있으나, 갱단 분쟁과 외국군 관련 논란이 큰 부담으로 작용하고 있습니다.
summary.hi: हैती की वर्तमान स्थिति पर एक चल रहे सुरक्षा संकट का प्रभुत्व है: गिरोहों के विरुद्ध एल साल्वाडोर की सैन्य कार्रवाई, जिसके नियम स्पष्ट नहीं हैं और जिसमें नागरिकों को नुकसान पहुँचने की रिपोर्टें हैं; अरकाई में मानवीय आपातकाल की घोषणा; और अपहरण की घटनाएँ जारी हैं। इन्हें आंशिक रूप से एक अपहरण पीड़ित की रिहाई और चुनाव-तैयारी के कदमों से संतुलित किया गया है। संस्थाएँ काम कर रही हैं, लेकिन गिरोह संघर्ष और विदेशी सैनिकों से जुड़ा विवाद भारी दबाव बनाए हुए हैं।
summary.el: Η τρέχουσα περίοδος της Αϊτής κυριαρχείται από μια συνεχιζόμενη κρίση ασφάλειας: μια επίθεση του σαλβαδορικού στρατού εναντίον συμμοριών με ασαφείς κανόνες και αναφορές για βλάβη σε αμάχους, μια δηλωμένη ανθρωπιστική έκτακτη ανάγκη στην Αρκαγιέ και συνεχιζόμενες απαγωγές. Αυτά αντισταθμίζονται εν μέρει από την απελευθέρωση ενός απαχθέντα και από βήματα για την προετοιμασία των εκλογών. Οι θεσμοί λειτουργούν, however η σύγκρουση με τις συμμορίες και η διαμάχη για τα ξένα στρατεύματα βαρύνουν σημαντικά.

summary.en: The period is proceeding largely normally in Malaysia, but cross-border haze is putting pressure on health and education. The deregistration of the main opposition alliance, Perikatan Nasional, signals institutional and political tension ahead of the election. Positive developments such as ECRL ticket prices, the economic freedom score and investment news partly offset these effects. The stock market is down 4% on a monthly basis.

en: Haze from Indonesia: unhealthy air quality in 28 regions, measures for SPM examinations
Deregistration of the main opposition bloc, Perikatan Nasional, and political tension ahead of the election
ECRL passenger fares and preparations for commercial operation, investment and infrastructure news
Highest score on the economic freedom index since 1970
KLCI fell 3.96% over the last month

summary.en: The period is mostly routine business and social news: investment deals, cruise and tourism announcements, and a cross-border crackdown. Offsetting these are unhealthy haze readings in 22 districts and the de-registration of the main opposition bloc ahead of elections, which weighs on institutional confidence.

en: Deregistration of Perikatan Nasional ahead of elections
Unhealthy haze readings across 22 districts, hitting tourism
Large investment deals: DayOne financing and Keria industrial city

summary.en: The period is dominated by routine business, investment and cultural news (data centre, Dassault office, refinery JV, Watsons Plus launch) with a stable stock market. Negatives are limited to haze, a Sabah border security concern, drainage complaints and a Middle East crisis remark, so the day sits modestly above an ordinary period.

en: New data centre and Dassault office signal investment and digital economy growth
Precious metal refinery joint venture and Watsons Plus launch
Haze impacts and Sabah border security concerns weigh slightly

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance news with modest positives, including RM1.2bil for school repairs, flood mitigation pledges and a large investment approval in Kedah. Negatives include the closure of a Johor factory affecting about 300 workers, 54 Malaysians still missing in Nepal, and unhealthy air in 16 areas. The KLCI was flat, so the overall picture is close to an ordinary day.

en: RM1.2bil allocated for school repairs and upgrades nationwide
Kedah approved RM185.9bn in investments, projected 51,000+ jobs
Lee Biscuits closing Johor factory, about 300 workers affected

summary.en: A mostly routine day in Malaysia: haze pushed air quality into unhealthy ranges, Sarawak's assembly was set for dissolution ahead of an election, and the opposition PN survived a deregistration threat. Negative items (a factory closure with about 300 jobs lost, a school axe attack) are offset by a flat-to-slightly-up stock market and a news tone better than the world average.

en: Haze with unhealthy air quality readings in many areas
Sarawak state assembly dissolution paving way for election
PN survives deregistration for now; internal rifts noted

summary.en: A routine news day dominated by a haze episode that is easing (Johor schools reopening Oct 26) and a government-announced US$50bn tech investment, offset by coalition friction ahead of the Melaka election. Markets were flat and the tone was somewhat more negative than the world average.

en: US$50bn international tech investment announced by PM
Johor schools reopening as haze conditions improve
Haze still severe in Serian and Sarawak spots

summary.en: The period mixes major positive investment news, including a reported US$50 billion SoftBank AI and data-centre plan and Moody's praise for Malaysia's data-centre positioning, with localised harms from Kedah and Penang floods, a Penang landslide death, and haze-driven school closures and an Indonesian goods boycott. The GDELT tone (-0.05 versus a world average of -0.71) and a flat-to-slightly-down market point to a generally steady day with clear net-positive economic signals.

en: SoftBank reported US$50 billion Malaysia AI and data-centre investment plan
Moody's notes Malaysia well positioned as regional data-centre hub
Kedah and Penang flooding and landslide casualties; evacuee numbers rising

summary.en: The day was mostly routine, with clear positives in large foreign investment pledges (a reported US$50 billion SoftBank AI plan and a $7.7b Johor solar financing deal) and easing haze. Negatives included a death in police custody, renewed calls for oversight, a Penang construction accident and flood evacuees in Kedah.

en: Reported US$50 billion SoftBank AI and data centre investment plan
DBS, Maybank and IFC $7.7b Johor solar financing
Haze clearing in most areas, schools reopening in Johor

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with positive economic and social items: haze cleared nationwide, IPO fundraising led ASEAN, Fitch forecast Islamic finance growth, and tourism arrivals were strong. Negatives were limited to a fatal maritime enforcement accident, a party crisis in Negeri Sembilan and smuggling arrests, and the market was flat to slightly up.

en: Haze dissipated; air quality back to healthy levels nationwide
IPO fundraising of RM6.1bn leads ASEAN; Fitch sees Islamic finance growth
Sept trade and tourism arrivals (32.2m Jan-Sept) remain solid

summary.en: A routine news day with several constructive items: trade with BRICS up 20%, cruise arrivals in Penang up 14%, RTS Link progress, and a strengthened geopark status. Negatives include the Nepali worker recruitment halt, AI chip smuggling seizures and criminal defamation criticism, and the market was flat.

en: BRICS trade rose 20% to over RM480bil this year
Singapore cruise passengers up 14.25%, Penang seeks cruise homeport status
Gombak-Hulu Langat geopark status reaffirmed; RTS Link emergency drill

summary.en: The period is mostly positive: the first FA-50M jet was delivered, a US$600mil rare-earth refinery and a large floating solar project were announced, Penang's September exports rose 96.2%, and Anwar survived a budget vote with Bersatu support. Flood reports and calls for a probe into a deadly Penang landslide weigh on the picture, and the stock market was roughly flat.

en: First FA-50M fighter jet delivered from South Korea
US$600mil rare-earth refinery and floating solar construction announced
Penang September exports up 96.2%

summary.en: The period reads as a mostly routine day, with local government announcements, agricultural and tech-education developments, and a KLCI that rose 0.28% on the day. Negatives include worsening floods in Negeri Sembilan, a safety-driven work stoppage order, and 130 Malaysians arrested in a Pakistan-linked scam, but none signals a broader crisis.

en: Worsening floods in Negeri Sembilan, improving in Kedah
Penang budget measures: newlywed aid and tourism funding
Scam-network arrests involving 130 Malaysians

summary.en: The period shows routine governance and economic news: a planned US$600 million rare-earth plant, a regional push on social media regulation, and a peaceful Melaka state election campaign. Flood preparations and a seized AI-chip shipment are ordinary administrative matters, and the KLCI and news tone are slightly positive.

en: US$600 million US-backed rare-earth plant investment announced
Melaka election candidates confirmed with no clashes reported
Regional cooperation push on social media giants

summary.en: The period was largely routine: export and trade-surplus growth, delivery of the first FA-50M jets, and a modestly rising stock index, offset by deadly fires in Sabah's water villages and ordinary state-level political sparring. GDELT tone is less negative than the world average, supporting a mildly positive reading.

en: Trade surplus forecast to rise 15-20%; exports up 71.8% in Penang
First FA-50M fighter jets delivered to Malaysia's air force
Deadly Sabah water-village blazes expose housing safety gaps

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with several clearly positive economic signals: a record-size REIT IPO, large Johor-Singapore SEZ investment approvals, and a TotalEnergies gas stake deal. Concerns include the Utusan newspaper crisis, halal-check questions, data-centre worries and warnings about electronics-sector risk, and the market is flat.

en: IOI REIT RM2.1bil IPO, Malaysia's largest REIT listing
Johor-Singapore SEZ reports about US$21.8-28bil in approved investments
TotalEnergies to acquire 30% stake in two offshore gas fields

summary.en: The period is mostly routine with several positive business and institutional items: energy deals with TotalEnergies and PTTEP, an IPO prospectus, university rankings and a Michelin star. Negatives are limited to localized flash floods, a bridge collapse, road deaths and a critique of airport drug screening, and the stock market is flat.

en: TotalEnergies stake acquisition and PTTEP gas field accords
University rankings and Michelin star for a KL restaurant
Flash floods and a bridge collapse in Selangor

summary.en: The period was clearly positive, led by a US$15 billion Google data-centre investment that the PM and foreign media both reported, alongside 'resilient economy' coverage, a record ranking gain in financial inclusion, and a settlement restoring state funding. Minor negatives (poultry farm complaints, a murder charge, embezzlement denials) were routine and did not change the picture.

en: Google to invest US$15bn in data centres in 2027-2028
Official and media reports of economic resilience and expansion
Largest ranking gain in Global Financial Inclusion Index

summary.en: A largely routine day with several positive economic and infrastructure stories, including a Penang LRT contract award, Microsoft and Daiso expansions, and Port Klang growth plans. Offsetting concerns include monsoon flooding, a drug-trafficking warning and the Najib fine-for-house-arrest arrangement, and the KLCI was flat over the week.

en: Penang LRT cross-sea contract awarded worth RM2.69 billion
Microsoft expands cloud infrastructure; Daiso opens largest warehouse
Northeast Monsoon flooding and Johor flash-flood mitigation projects

summary.en: A mostly routine news day: Deepavali travel, a police leadership reshuffle, and a Selangor royal jubilee, plus some investment news. The main story is friction between the palace and the attorney-general over Najib's house-arrest order, which adds institutional tension, and the KLCI fell 1.18% on the day.

en: Najib house-arrest order halted, palace and attorney-general disagree
KLCI down 1.18% in one day, flat over the week
Routine Deepavali travel and police reshuffle coverage

summary.en: Routine state election campaigning in Malacca and Sarawak, investment and tech news, and minor incidents dominate the period. A public dispute between the King and the attorney-general over Najib's house arrest adds institutional friction, and the market fell 1.18% in one day, though the weekly and monthly moves are flat.

en: King and attorney-general dispute over Najib's house arrest order
Malacca and Sarawak state election campaigns under way
Routine investment and tech-training news; minor local incidents

summary.en: A mostly routine day dominated by Deepavali festivities, a Melaka by-election campaign, and a court decision allowing ex-PM Najib house arrest, with flood evacuations and cybersecurity incidents as the main negatives. The 5G coverage milestone and a flat KLCI point to a stable, slightly positive period.

en: Court approves Najib house arrest, a notable but non-crisis legal development
Selangor flood evacuees rise, a localised weather-related strain
5G coverage reaches 90%, nine months ahead of schedule

summary.en: A deadly water surge in Selangor (5 dead, 3 missing) and flood evacuations are the main negatives, but they are localized. Offsetting them are a US$1.85bn SoftBank/Grab AI infrastructure investment, a 10.7% rise in Q3 manufacturing sales, and routine governance and housing news, with GDELT tone slightly better than the world average.
summary.tr: Selangor'da ölümcül bir su taşkını (5 ölü, 3 kayıp) ve sel nedeniyle yapılan tahliyeler başlıca olumsuz gelişmeler, ancak bunlar yerel nitelikte. Bunları dengeleyen unsurlar arasında SoftBank/Grab'ın US$1.85bn tutarındaki yapay zekâ altyapı yatırımı, üçüncü çeyrekte imalat satışlarında %10.7'lik artış ve rutin yönetişim ile konut haberleri yer alıyor; GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasından biraz daha iyi.
summary.es: Una crecida de agua mortal en Selangor (5 muertos, 3 desaparecidos) y las evacuaciones por inundaciones son los principales aspectos negativos, aunque son de carácter localizado. Los compensan una inversión de US$1.85bn de SoftBank/Grab en infraestructura de IA, un aumento del 10.7% en las ventas manufactureras del tercer trimestre y noticias rutinarias sobre gobernanza y vivienda, con un tono de GDELT ligeramente mejor que la media mundial.
summary.fr: Une crue meurtrière à Selangor (5 morts, 3 disparus) et les évacuations liées aux inondations constituent les principaux éléments négatifs, mais ils restent localisés. Ils sont contrebalancés par un investissement de US$1.85bn de SoftBank/Grab dans les infrastructures d'IA, une hausse de 10.7 % des ventes manufacturières au troisième trimestre, et des informations courantes sur la gouvernance et le logement, le ton de GDELT étant légèrement meilleur que la moyenne mondiale.
summary.de: Eine tödliche Wasserflut in Selangor (5 Tote, 3 Vermisste) und Flutevakuierungen sind die wichtigsten negativen Nachrichten, sie bleiben jedoch lokal begrenzt. Ausgeglichen werden sie durch eine Investition von SoftBank/Grab in KI-Infrastruktur in Höhe von US$1.85bn, einen Anstieg der Industrieumsätze im dritten Quartal um 10.7 % sowie routinemäßige Meldungen zu Governance und Wohnungsbau; der GDELT-Tonwert liegt leicht über dem weltweiten Durchschnitt.
summary.pt: Uma enxurrada de água mortal em Selangor (5 mortos, 3 desaparecidos) e as evacuações por cheias são os principais aspetos negativos, mas são localizados. Compensam-nos um investimento de US$1.85bn da SoftBank/Grab em infraestrutura de IA, um aumento de 10.7% nas vendas da indústria transformadora no terceiro trimestre e notícias de rotina sobre governação e habitação, com o tom do GDELT ligeiramente melhor do que a média mundial.
summary.it: Un'ondata d'acqua mortale nel Selangor (5 morti, 3 dispersi) e le evacuazioni per le inondazioni sono i principali aspetti negativi, ma sono localizzati. A compensarli ci sono un investimento infrastrutturale per l'IA da 1,85 miliardi di dollari USA di SoftBank/Grab, un aumento del 10,7% delle vendite manifatturiere nel terzo trimestre e notizie di routine su governance e alloggi, con un tono GDELT leggermente migliore della media mondiale.
summary.ru: Смертоносный паводок в Селангоре (5 погибших, 3 пропавших без вести) и эвакуации из-за наводнений являются основными негативными факторами, однако они носят локальный характер. Их уравновешивают инвестиции SoftBank/Grab в инфраструктуру искусственного интеллекта на сумму 1,85 млрд долларов США, рост продаж в обрабатывающей промышленности на 10,7% в третьем квартале и типичные новости о государственном управлении и жилье; тон GDELT немного выше среднемирового.
summary.ar: تُعد موجة المياه المميتة في سيلانغور (5 قتلى و3 مفقودين) وعمليات إجلاء السكان بسبب الفيضانات أبرز الجوانب السلبية، لكنها محدودة جغرافياً. في المقابل، يأتي استثمار بقيمة 1.85 مليار دولار أمريكي من SoftBank وGrab في البنية التحتية للذكاء الاصطناعي، وارتفاع مبيعات التصنيع في الربع الثالث بنسبة 10.7%، إلى جانب أخبار روتينية عن الحوكمة والإسكان، مع نبرة GDELT أفضل قليلاً من المتوسط العالمي.
summary.fa: موج آب مرگبار در سلانگور (۵ کشته و ۳ مفقود) و تخلیه ساکنان به دلیل سیل، مهم‌ترین عوامل منفی هستند، اما محلی‌اند. در مقابل، سرمایه‌گذاری ۱٫۸۵ میلیارد دلاری آمریکایی SoftBank و Grab در زیرساخت‌های هوش مصنوعی، افزایش ۱۰٫۷ درصدی فروش بخش تولید در سه‌ماهه سوم، و اخبار معمول درباره حکمرانی و مسکن قرار دارند و لحن GDELT کمی بهتر از میانگین جهانی است.
summary.zh: 雪兰莪的一场致命洪水（5人死亡，3人失踪）及洪灾撤离是主要负面因素，但影响局限于局部地区。与之抵消的是软银与Grab公司18.5亿美元（1.85 billion US$）的人工智能基础设施投资、第三季度制造业销售额增长10.7%，以及常规的治理和住房新闻；GDELT语气略优于全球平均水平。
summary.ja: セランゴール州での死者5人・行方不明者3人を出した急激な増水と洪水による避難が主なマイナス材料ですが、影響は局地的です。これを相殺する材料としては、ソフトバンクとGrabによる18億5,000万米ドルのAIインフラ投資、第3四半期の製造業売上高10.7%増、そして通常のガバナンスや住宅関連のニュースがあり、GDELTのトーンは世界平均をわずかに上回っています。
summary.ko: 셀랑고르주의 급격한 물 불어남 사고(사망 5명, 실종 3명)와 홍수로 인한 대피가 주요 부정적 요인이지만, 그 영향은 국지적입니다. 이를 상쇄하는 요인으로는 소프트뱅크와 Grab의 18억 5천만 달러 규모 AI 인프라 투자, 3분기 제조업 매출 10.7% 증가, 그리고 일상적인 거버넌스 및 주택 관련 뉴스가 있으며, GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 약간 나은 수준입니다.
summary.hi: सेलांगोर में घातक जल-उफान (5 मौतें, 3 लापता) और बाढ़ के कारण हुई निकासी मुख्य नकारात्मक घटनाएँ हैं, लेकिन ये स्थानीय स्तर तक सीमित हैं। इनकी भरपाई करने वाले कारकों में सॉफ्टबैंक और Grab का 1.85 अरब अमेरिकी डॉलर का AI बुनियादी ढाँचा निवेश, तीसरी तिमाही में विनिर्माण बिक्री में 10.7% की वृद्धि, और नियमित शासन व आवास संबंधी समाचार शामिल हैं; GDELT का लहजा विश्व औसत से थोड़ा बेहतर है।
summary.el: Η θανατηφόρα ξαφνική άνοδος της στάθμης του νερού στο Σελανγκόρ (5 νεκροί, 3 αγνοούμενοι) και οι εκκενώσεις λόγω πλημμυρών αποτελούν τις κύριες αρνητικές εξελίξεις, ωστόσο έχουν τοπικό χαρακτήρα. Αντισταθμιστικά δρουν η επένδυση 1,85 δισ. δολαρίων ΗΠΑ των SoftBank και Grab σε υποδομές τεχνητής νοημοσύνης, η αύξηση 10,7% των πωλήσεων της βιομηχανίας στο τρίτο τρίμηνο και ρουτινικές ειδήσεις για διακυβέρνηση και στέγαση, με τον τόνο του GDELT ελαφρώς καλύτερο από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.

summary.ja: 今期のニュースはおおむね日常的なものから前向きなものでした。10月のインフレ率は4.2%に低下し、園芸作物の輸出は5億6900万ドルへと倍増しました。また、複数の投資および開発に関する取引が発表されました。主な否定的な出来事は、バスとトラックの衝突事故で、21人が死亡しました。これは深刻な悲劇ではあるものの、国家規模の危機ではありません。
summary.ko: 이번 기간의 뉴스는 대체로 일상적이거나 긍정적인 내용이었습니다. 10월 인플레이션은 4.2%로 완화되었고, 원예 작물 수출은 5억 6,900만 달러로 두 배 증가했으며, 여러 투자 및 개발 계약이 발표되었습니다. 주요 부정적 사건은 버스와 트럭의 충돌 사고로 21명이 사망한 것이었습니다. 이는 심각한 비극이지만 국가적 규모의 위기는 아닙니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में अधिकतर सामान्य से लेकर सकारात्मक समाचार रहे। अक्टूबर में मुद्रास्फीति घटकर 4.2% हो गई, बागवानी निर्यात दोगुना होकर $569 मिलियन हो गया, और कई निवेश व विकास सौदों की घोषणा हुई। मुख्य नकारात्मक घटना एक बस-ट्रक टक्कर थी, जिसमें 21 लोगों की मौत हुई। यह एक गंभीर त्रासदी है, लेकिन राष्ट्रीय स्तर का संकट नहीं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος ανέδειξε κυρίως ρουτινικές έως θετικές ειδήσεις: ο πληθωρισμός του Οκτωβρίου υποχώρησε στο 4,2%, οι εξαγωγές κηπευτικών διπλασιάστηκαν στα 569 εκατ. δολάρια και ανακοινώθηκαν διάφορες επενδυτικές και αναπτυξιακές συμφωνίες. Το κύριο αρνητικό γεγονός ήταν η σύγκρουση λεωφορείου με φορτηγό, που σκότωσε 21 ανθρώπους. Πρόκειται για σοβαρή τραγωδία, όχι όμως για κρίση εθνικής κλίμακας.
summary.it: Il periodo presenta notizie per lo più di routine o positive: l'inflazione di ottobre è scesa al 4,2%, le esportazioni ortofrutticole sono raddoppiate fino a $569m e sono stati annunciati diversi accordi di investimento e sviluppo. L'evento negativo principale è stato uno scontro tra un autobus e un camion che ha causato 21 morti: si tratta di una tragedia grave, ma non di una crisi su scala nazionale.
summary.ru: За этот период в основном преобладают рутинные или позитивные новости: инфляция в октябре снизилась до 4.2%, экспорт садоводческой продукции удвоился и достиг $569m, а также было объявлено о нескольких инвестиционных и развивающих соглашениях. Основным негативным событием стало столкновение автобуса и грузовика, в результате которого погибли 21 человек; это серьёзная трагедия, но не кризис общенационального масштаба.

summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً اخبار عادی تا مثبت را دربر دارد: تورم در ماه اکتبر به 4.2% کاهش یافت، صادرات محصولات باغبانی دو برابر شد و به $569m رسید، و چند توافق سرمایه‌گذاری و توسعه اعلام شد. رویداد منفی اصلی برخورد اتوبوس با کامیون بود که 21 نفر را کشت؛ این فاجعه‌ای جدی است، اما بحرانی در سطح ملی نیست.

summary.en: Gabon passed the last 24 hours without a major crisis, on an ordinary news agenda: the debt debate and the IMF's review of its debt audit findings, traffic caused by the PK12 overpass, and a health campaign against measles and maternal deaths stood out. Duterte davalarına ilişkin süren siyasi tartışmalar ve savunma bakanının istifası yönündeki çağrılar gerilimi artırıyor; tayfun yağmurları ve ölümcül bir pusu olumsuz ancak yerel etkiler.
summary.es: El periodo es en su mayoría rutinario: los preparativos de la cumbre de la ASEAN, los acuerdos de inversión y cooperación en seguridad y el registro de votantes para 2028 coexisten con un débil dato del PIB del tercer trimestre, del 2.1%, el más lento desde 2009 excluyendo la pandemia. Las disputas políticas en curso por los casos de Duterte y los llamados a la renuncia del secretario de Defensa añaden tensión, mientras que las lluvias de los tifones y una emboscada mortal son negativas, pero localizadas.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : les préparatifs du sommet de l'ASEAN, les accords d'investissement et de coopération en matière de sécurité, ainsi que l'inscription sur les listes électorales pour 2028, coexistent avec un chiffre du PIB du troisième trimestre décevant, à 2.1 %, le plus faible depuis 2009 hors pandémie. Les querelles politiques en cours autour des affaires Duterte et les appels à la démission du secrétaire à la Défense ajoutent des tensions, tandis que les pluies liées aux typhons et une embuscade meurtrière, négatives, restent localisées.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft größtenteils routinemäßig: Vorbereitungen auf den ASEAN-Gipfel, Investitions- und Sicherheitskooperationsabkommen sowie die Wählerregistrierung für 2028 stehen neben einem schwachen BIP-Wert für das dritte Quartal von 2,1 %, dem niedrigsten seit 2009 ohne Berücksichtigung der Pandemie. Anhaltende politische Streitigkeiten um die Verfahren gegen Duterte und Forderungen nach dem Rücktritt des Verteidigungsministers verschärfen die Spannungen, während Taifunregen und ein tödlicher Hinterhalt negativ, aber lokal begrenzt sind.
summary.pt: O período é, em grande parte, rotineiro: preparativos para a cimeira da ASEAN, acordos de investimento e cooperação em segurança e o registo de eleitores para 2028 convivem com um fraco resultado do PIB do terceiro trimestre, de 2,1%, o mais lento desde 2009, excluindo a pandemia. As disputas políticas em curso sobre os processos contra Duterte e os apelos à demissão do secretário da Defesa aumentam a tensão, enquanto as chuvas de tufão e uma emboscada mortal são negativas, mas localizadas.
summary.ja: 今回の期間は概ね定例的な動きで、ASEAN首脳会議の準備、投資および安全保障協力の合意、2028年に向けた有権者登録が進む一方、第3四半期の国内総生産(GDP)成長率は2.1%にとどまり、パンデミックを除けば2009年以来の低さとなりました。ドゥテルテ氏の訴訟をめぐる政治的対立や国防長官の辞任要求が緊張を高めています。台風による大雨や死者を出した待ち伏せ攻撃は、いずれも否定的な出来事ですが、影響は局地的です。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 흐름입니다. ASEAN 정상회의 준비, 투자 및 안보 협력 합의, 2028년 선거를 위한 유권자 등록이 이어지고 있습니다. 반면 3분기 GDP 성장률은 2.1%로 팬데믹을 제외하면 2009년 이후 가장 낮은 수준입니다. 두테르테 사건을 둘러싼 정치적 갈등과 국방장관 사임 요구가 긴장을 높이고 있습니다. 태풍으로 인한 폭우와 사망자를 낸 매복 공격은 부정적이지만 지역적인 사안입니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर नियमित घटनाक्रम वाली है: आसियान शिखर सम्मेलन की तैयारियाँ, निवेश और सुरक्षा सहयोग के समझौते, तथा 2028 के लिए मतदाता पंजीकरण चल रहे हैं। इसके साथ ही तीसरी तिमाही की जीडीपी वृद्धि दर 2.1% रही, जो महामारी को छोड़कर 2009 के बाद की सबसे धीमी दर है। दुतेर्ते मामलों को लेकर चल रही राजनीतिक खींचतान और रक्षा सचिव के इस्तीफ़े की माँग तनाव बढ़ा रही है। तूफ़ानी बारिश और एक घातक घात हमला नकारात्मक हैं, लेकिन स्थानीय स्तर तक सीमित हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτινική: προετοιμασίες για τη σύνοδο κορυφής της ASEAN, συμφωνίες επενδυτικής και αμυντικής συνεργασίας και εγγραφή ψηφοφόρων για το 2028 συνυπάρχουν με έναν αδύναμο ρυθμό ανάπτυξης του ΑΕΠ στο γ' τρίμηνο, 2,1%, το χαμηλότερο από το 2009 εκτός της πανδημίας. Οι συνεχιζόμενες πολιτικές διαμάχες για τις υποθέσεις Duterte και τα αιτήματα παραίτησης του υπουργού Άμυνας αυξάνουν την ένταση. Οι τυφωνικές βροχές και μια θανατηφόρα ενέδρα είναι αρνητικές, αλλά τοπικού χαρακτήρα.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: i preparativi per il vertice ASEAN, accordi di cooperazione in materia di investimenti e sicurezza e la registrazione degli elettori per il 2028 si affiancano a un debole dato del PIL del terzo trimestre, pari al 2,1%, il più lento dal 2009 escludendo la pandemia. Le controversie politiche in corso sui procedimenti contro Duterte e le richieste di dimissioni del ministro della Difesa aumentano la tensione, mentre le piogge causate dal tifone e un'imboscata mortale sono negative ma localizzate.
summary.ru: Период в основном обычный: подготовка к саммиту АСЕАН, соглашения о сотрудничестве в области инвестиций и безопасности и регистрация избирателей на 2028 год соседствуют со слабыми данными о ВВП за третий квартал — 2,1%, самым медленным ростом с 2009 года без учёта пандемии. Продолжающиеся политические споры вокруг дел Дутерте и призывы к отставке министра обороны добавляют напряжённости, а дожди от тайфуна и смертельная засада носят негативный, но локальный характер.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: فالاستعدادات لقمة الآسيان، واتفاقيات التعاون في الاستثمار والأمن، وتسجيل الناخبين لعام 2028، تترافق مع أرقام ضعيفة للناتج المحلي الإجمالي للربع الثالث بنسبة 2.1%، وهي الأبطأ منذ عام 2009 باستثناء فترة الجائحة. وتضيف الخلافات السياسية المستمرة حول قضايا دوتيرتي والدعوات لاستقالة وزير الدفاع مزيداً من التوتر، بينما تبقى أمطار الإعصار وكمين المسلحين الذي أودى بحياة أشخاص عوامل سلبية لكنها محلية النطاق.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است: آماده‌سازی برای نشست آسه‌آن، توافق‌های همکاری در زمینه سرمایه‌گذاری و امنیت، و ثبت‌نام رأی‌دهندگان برای سال ۲۰۲۸ در کنار آمار ضعیف تولید ناخالص داخلی سه‌ماههٔ سوم با رشد ۲٫۱ درصد قرار دارد که کندترین رشد از سال ۲۰۰۹ به‌جز دوران همه‌گیری است. اختلافات سیاسی ادامه‌دار درباره پرونده‌های دوترته و درخواست‌ها برای استعفای وزیر دفاع بر تنش‌ها می‌افزاید، در حالی که بارش‌های ناشی از طوفان و کمین مرگبار منفی اما محلی هستند.

summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine, con un mix di notizie istituzionali positive (il Montenegro assume la presidenza del Consiglio d'Europa, un progetto scientifico da 30 milioni di euro) e normali cronache di criminalità e scandali (una fuga di notizie sullo scandalo Telecom, una rissa mortale a Kolašin, un accoltellamento a Kotor). Il tono GDELT è più negativo della media mondiale, ma i titoli non mostrano una crisi acuta, quindi il punteggio si colloca moderatamente sopra la neutralità.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: сочетание позитивных институциональных новостей (Черногория принимает председательство в Совете Европы, научный проект стоимостью 30 млн евро) и обычных криминальных и скандальных историй (утечка информации по делу Telecom, смертельная драка в Колашине, ножевое ранение в Котор е). Тон GDELT более негативен, чем в среднем по миру, однако заголовки не указывают на острый кризис, поэтому оценка умеренно выше нейтральной.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها، وتتضمن مزيجًا من الأخبار المؤسسية الإيجابية (تولّي الجبل الأسود رئاسة مجلس أوروبا، ومشروع علمي بقيمة 30 مليون يورو) وقصص جنائية وفضائح اعتيادية (تسريب في قضية تيليكوم، وشجار قاتل في كولاشين، وطعن في كوتور). ونغمة GDELT أكثر سلبية من المتوسط العالمي، لكن العناوين لا تُظهر أزمة حادة، لذلك تقع الدرجة أعلى من الحياد بقدر معتدل.
summary.fa: این دوره بیشتر روال‌معمول است و ترکیبی از اخبار مثبت نهادی (برعهده گرفتن ریاست شورای اروپا توسط مونته‌نگرو، یک پروژه علمی ۳۰ میلیون یورویی) و اخبار عادی جنایی و رسوایی (افشای اطلاعات پرونده تلکام، درگیری مرگبار در کولاشین، و چاقوکشی در کوتور) را شامل می‌شود. لحن GDELT منفی‌تر از میانگین جهانی است، اما تیترها بحران حادی را نشان نمی‌دهند، بنابراین امتیاز اندکی بالاتر از خنثی قرار می‌گیرد.
summary.zh: 这一时期大体属于常规新闻，既有积极的机构新闻（黑山接任欧洲委员会主席国，一项价值3000万欧元的科学项目），也有普通的犯罪和丑闻报道（Telecom丑闻泄露，科拉欣一起致命斗殴，科托尔一起刺伤事件）。GDELT的情绪基调比全球平均水平更为负面，但标题并未显示出急性危机，因此评分略高于中性。
summary.ja: この期間は概ね日常的な出来事が中心で、モンテネグロの欧州評議会議長国就任や€30Mの科学プロジェクトといった制度面の前向きな報道と、Telecom疑惑の流出、コラシンでの死者を伴う乱闘、コトルでの刺傷事件といった一般的な犯罪・スキャンダル報道が混在している。GDELTのトーンは世界平均よりネガティブだが、見出しに急迫した危機は見られないため、スコアは中立をやや上回る水準にとどまっている。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 사건들로 이루어져 있으며, 몬테네그로의 유럽평의회 의장국 취임과 €30M 규모의 과학 프로젝트 같은 긍정적인 제도 관련 소식과, Telecom 스캔들 유출, 콜라신에서 발생한 사망 사건을 동반한 몸싸움, 코토르의 칼부림 사건 등 통상적인 범죄 및 스캔들 보도가 뒤섞여 있다. GDELT 어조는 세계 평균보다 부정적이지만, 헤드라인에서 급박한 위기는 드러나지 않아 점수는 중립보다 약간 높은 수준에 머문다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य घटनाओं से भरी है, जिसमें मोंटेनेग्रो द्वारा यूरोप की परिषद की अध्यक्षता संभालना और €30M का विज्ञान प्रोजेक्ट जैसी सकारात्मक संस्थागत खबरें, तथा Telecom मामले का लीक, कोलाशिन में घातक मारपीट और कोतोर में चाकूबाज़ी जैसी आम अपराध और घोटाले की खबरें शामिल हैं। GDELT का स्वर विश्व औसत से अधिक नकारात्मक है, लेकिन सुर्खियों में कोई तीव्र संकट नहीं दिखता, इसलिए स्कोर तटस्थ से थोड़ा ऊपर रहता है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι ως επί το πλείστον συνηθισμένη, με ένα μείγμα θετικών θεσμικών ειδήσεων (η ανάληψη της προεδρίας του Συμβουλίου της Ευρώπης από το Μαυροβούνιο και ένα επιστημονικό πρόγραμμα αξίας €30M) και συνηθισμένων ειδήσεων για εγκλήματα και σκάνδαλα (διαρροή από την υπόθεση Telecom, θανατηφόρος καβγάς στο Κολασίν, μαχαίρωμα στο Κότορ). Ο τόνος του GDELT είναι πιο αρνητικός από τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο, ωστόσο οι τίτλοι δεν δείχνουν οξεία κρίση, οπότε το σκορ βρίσκεται μετρίως πάνω από το ουδέτερο.
summary.tr: Dönem çoğunlukla olağan seyirde; kurumsal olumlu haberler (Karadağ'ın Avrupa Konseyi dönem başkanlığını üstlenmesi, 30 milyon avroluk bir bilim projesi) ile sıradan suç ve skandal haberleri (Telecom skandalının sızdırılması, Kolašin'de ölümle sonuçlanan kavga, Kotor'da bıçaklama) bir arada. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasından daha olumsuz, ancak başlıklar akut bir kriz göstermiyor; bu nedenle skor nötrün biraz üzerinde kalıyor.
summary.es: El periodo es en su mayor parte rutinario, con una mezcla de noticias institucionales positivas (Montenegro asume la presidencia del Consejo de Europa, un proyecto científico de 30 M€) e historias habituales de delincuencia y escándalos (filtración del caso Telecom, una reyerta mortal en Kolašin, una puñalada en Kotor). El tono de GDELT es más negativo que la media mundial, pero los titulares no muestran una crisis aguda, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa modestamente por encima de neutral.
summary.fr: La période est en grande partie routinière, mêlant des nouvelles institutionnelles positives (le Monténégro prend la présidence du Conseil de l'Europe, un projet scientifique de 30 M€) et des faits divers et scandales ordinaires (fuite dans l'affaire Telecom, une rixe mortelle à Kolašin, un coup de couteau à Kotor). Le ton GDELT est plus négatif que la moyenne mondiale, mais les gros titres ne montrent aucune crise aiguë, si bien que le score se situe modérément au-dessus du neutre.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft größtenteils routinemäßig und mischt positive institutionelle Nachrichten (Montenegro übernimmt den Vorsitz des Europarats, ein Wissenschaftsprojekt im Wert von 30 Mio. €) mit gewöhnlichen Kriminal- und Skandalgeschichten (Durchsickern von Details der Telecom-Affäre, eine tödliche Schlägerei in Kolašin, ein Messerangriff in Kotor). Der GDELT-Ton ist negativer als der weltweite Durchschnitt, doch die Schlagzeilen zeigen keine akute Krise, sodass der Wert nur moderat über dem neutralen Bereich liegt.
summary.pt: O período é, na maior parte, rotineiro, com uma mistura de notícias institucionais positivas (o Montenegro assume a presidência do Conselho da Europa, um projeto científico de 30 M€) e histórias comuns de crime e escândalo (fuga de informação sobre o caso Telecom, uma briga mortal em Kolašin, uma facada em Kotor). O tom do GDELT é mais negativo do que a média mundial, mas as manchetes não mostram uma crise aguda, pelo que a pontuação fica modestamente acima do neutro.

summary.zh: 此期间总体属于常规状况：DAX指数上涨、企业交易和总统提名，但同时有关于反犹主义的警告以及购买力下降的报道。GDELT语气比全球平均水平更为负面，但新闻标题并未描述任何危机。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin seyrediyor: yükselen DAX, kurumsal anlaşmalar ve bir cumhurbaşkanlığı adaylığı öne çıkarken, antisemitizm konusundaki uyarılar ve satın alma gücü kaybına ilişkin haberler bu tabloyu dengeliyor. GDELT tonu dünya ortalamasının daha olumsuz, ancak manşetler herhangi bir krizi tanımlamıyor.
summary.es: El periodo es en su mayoría rutinario: un DAX al alza, acuerdos corporativos y una nominación presidencial, contrarrestados por advertencias sobre antisemitismo e informes de pérdida de poder adquisitivo. El tono de GDELT es más negativo que el promedio mundial, pero los titulares no describen ninguna crisis.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : un DAX en hausse, des accords d'entreprises et une nomination présidentielle, contrebalancés par des mises en garde sur l'antisémitisme et des informations faisant état d'une perte de pouvoir d'achat. summary.ja: 今期は、マルタがECOFIN（経済・財務相理事会）で提案されたEUのたばこ税引き上げをブロックしたという報道が繰り返され、これが中心となりました。12月に後続協議が予定された、日常的な政策上の拒否権行使です。その他の話題は小規模なもの（ルーマニア国籍者に対する判決、リビアの身柄引き渡しに関する保証、ライフスタイル記事など）で、報道のトーンは世界平均と一致していました。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 몰타가 ECOFIN(경제·재무장관이사회)에서 제안된 EU 담배세 인상안을 차단했다는 보도가 반복적으로 이어지며 주를 이뤘습니다. 이는 12월 후속 논의가 예정된, 일상적인 정책상 거부권 행사입니다. 그 밖의 기사들은 사소한 내용(루마니아 국적자에 대한 판결, 리비아의 송환 보장, 생활 기사 등)이었으며, 보도 어조는 세계 평균과 일치했습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में मुख्य रूप से यह बार-बार की रिपोर्टें रहीं कि माल्टा ने ECOFIN में यूरोपीय संघ की तंबाकू कर वृद्धि के प्रस्ताव को अवरुद्ध कर दिया। यह एक नियमित नीतिगत वीटो था, जिसके बाद दिसंबर में आगे की चर्चा तय है। अन्य खबरें मामूली थीं (रोमानियाई नागरिकों के लिए एक अदालती फैसला, लीबिया के प्रत्यर्पण का आश्वासन, जीवनशैली की कहानियाँ), और उनका लहजा विश्व औसत के अनुरूप था।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχήθηκε από επαναλαμβανόμενες αναφορές ότι η Μάλτα μπλόκαρε στο ECOFIN την προτεινόμενη αύξηση του φόρου καπνού της ΕΕ, μια συνηθισμένη πολιτική αρνησικυρία με επακόλουθο τον Δεκέμβριο. Τα υπόλοιπα θέματα ήταν δευτερεύοντα (μια δικαστική απόφαση για Ρουμάνους υπηκόους, διαβεβαίωση για έκδοση από τη Λιβύη, ρεπορτάζ τρόπου ζωής), και ο τόνος ήταν σύμφωνος με τον παγκόσμιο μέσο όρο.

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: corporate CSR and ESG awards, a stock-market forecast that is cautious but profit-confident, and a royal-led wellness summit. Offsetting these are a flood alert for 16 provinces, a crackdown on toxic-waste factories, and a fatal clash with security forces, so the score sits modestly above an ordinary day.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: premi aziendali per CSR ed ESG, una previsione di borsa cauta ma fiduciosa sugli utili, e un vertice sul benessere presieduto da un membro della famiglia reale. A controbilanciare ci sono un allerta alluvioni per 16 province, una repressione contro le fabbriche di rifiuti tossici e uno scontro mortale con le forze di sicurezza, per cui il punteggio si colloca leggermente sopra una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный: корпоративные награды в области КСО и ESG, прогноз фондового рынка, осторожный, но уверенный в прибыли, и саммит по вопросам благополучия под руководством представителя королевской семьи. Этому противостоят предупреждение о наводнении для 16 провинций, пресечение деятельности заводов по производству токсичных отходов и смертельное столкновение с силами безопасности, поэтому оценка немного выше, чем в обычный день.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها: جوائز الشركات للمسؤولية الاجتماعية والحوكمة البيئية والاجتماعية (ESG)، وتوقعات لسوق الأسهم حذرة لكنها واثقة من الأرباح، وقمة للرفاه برعاية ملكية. وفي المقابل، هناك تحذير من الفيضانات في 16 محافظة، وحملة ضد مصانع النفايات السامة، واشتباك مميت مع قوات الأمن، ولذلك يقع المؤشر أعلى بقليل من يوم عادي.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً عادی است: جوایز شرکتی مسئولیت اجتماعی و ESG، پیش‌بینی بازار سهام که محتاطانه اما با اعتماد به سود است، و اجلاس سلامت با حضور خاندان سلطنتی. در مقابل، هشدار سیل برای 16 استان، سرکوب کارخانه‌های زباله سمی و درگیری مرگبار با نیروهای امنیتی قرار دارد، بنابراین امتیاز اندکی بالاتر از یک روز معمولی است.
summary.zh: 这一时期大多属于常规情况：企业社会责任和ESG奖项、谨慎但对利润有信心的股市预测，以及由王室成员主持的健康峰会。与之相抵的是16个省的洪水预警、对有毒废物工厂的整治，以及与安全部队的致命冲突，因此评分略高于普通日子。
summary.ja: この期間は大半が定例的な内容である。企業のCSR・ESG表彰、慎重だが利益に自信を示す株式市場の見通し、王室主導のウェルネス・サミットなどだ。一方で、16県への洪水警報、有害廃棄物工場の取り締まり、治安部隊との死者を出した衝突が相殺要因となっており、そのためスコアは通常の一日よりわずかに高い水準にとどまる。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 내용으로 구성되어 있다. 기업의 CSR 및 ESG 시상, 신중하지만 수익에 자신감을 보이는 증시 전망, 왕실 주도의 웰니스 정상회의 등이다. 이에 맞서는 요인으로는 16개 주에 대한 홍수 경보, 유해 폐기물 공장에 대한 단속, 보안군과의 치명적인 충돌이 있어, 점수는 평범한 하루보다 다소 높은 수준이다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर नियमित घटनाओं से भरी है: कॉर्पोरेट CSR और ESG पुरस्कार, शेयर बाज़ार का सतर्क लेकिन मुनाफ़े को लेकर आश्वस्त पूर्वानुमान, और एक शाही नेतृत्व वाला वेलनेस शिखर सम्मेलन। इन्हें संतुलित करने वाली घटनाओं में 16 प्रांतों के लिए बाढ़ चेतावनी, विषैले अपशिष्ट कारखानों पर कार्रवाई, और सुरक्षा बलों के साथ घातक मुठभेड़ शामिल हैं, इसलिए स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से थोड़ा ऊपर है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτινική: βραβεύσεις εταιρικής κοινωνικής ευθύνης (CSR) και ESG, πρόβλεψη για το χρηματιστήριο που είναι επιφυλακτική αλλά αισιόδοξη για τα κέρδη, και μια σύνοδος ευεξίας υπό την αιγίδα του βασιλικού οίκου. Αντισταθμιστικά, υπάρχουν προειδοποίηση πλημμύρας για 16 επαρχίες, εκστρατεία κατά παράνομων εργοστασίων τοξικών αποβλήτων και θανατηφόρα σύγκρουση με δυνάμεις ασφαλείας, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται μετρίως πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin seyrediyor: kurumsal KSS ve ESG ödülleri, temkinli ama kâr beklentisi taşıyan bir borsa tahmini ve kraliyet himayesindeki bir sağlıklı yaşam zirvesi. Bunların etkisini dengeleyen ise 16 il için sel uyarısı, zehirli atık fabrikalarına yönelik operasyon ve güvenlik güçleriyle yaşanan ölümcül bir çatışma; bu nedenle skor sıradan bir günün biraz üzerinde seyrediyor.
summary.es: El periodo es en su mayoría rutinario: premios corporativos de RSC y ESG, una previsión bursátil cauta pero confiada en los beneficios, y una cumbre de bienestar presidida por la realeza. Compensan estos aspectos una alerta de inundaciones para 16 provincias, una represión contra fábricas de residuos tóxicos y un enfrentamiento mortal con las fuerzas de seguridad, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa modestamente por encima de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière : prix RSE et ESG d'entreprises, prévision boursière prudente mais confiante quant aux bénéfices, et sommet sur le bien-être présidé par la famille royale. Ces éléments sont contrebalancés par une alerte aux inondations dans 16 provinces, une répression contre des usines de déchets toxiques et un affrontement mortel avec les forces de sécurité, ce qui place le score légèrement au-dessus d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft größtenteils routinemäßig: CSR- und ESG-Auszeichnungen von Unternehmen, eine vorsichtige, aber gewinnzuversichtliche Börsenprognose und ein vom Königshaus geleiteter Wellness-Gipfel. Dem gegenüber stehen eine Hochwasserwarnung für 16 Provinzen, ein Vorgehen gegen giftige Abfallfabriken und ein tödlicher Zusammenstoß mit Sicherheitskräften, sodass der Wert leicht über einem gewöhnlichen Tag liegt.
summary.pt: O período é majoritariamente rotineiro: prémios corporativos de RSC e ESG, uma previsão do mercado de ações cautelosa mas confiante nos lucros, e uma cimeira de bem-estar presidida pela realeza. Contrabalançam estes aspetos um alerta de cheias para 16 províncias, uma repressão a fábricas de resíduos tóxicos e um confronto mortal com as forças de segurança, pelo que a pontuação fica moderadamente acima de um dia comum.

summary.en: Bolivia had an ordinary day: a historic rapprochement with Chile and the start of work by new regional prosecutors in the judiciary are positive developments. However, the arrest of a senator on terrorism charges, calls for actions by supporters of Evo Morales, organized crime threats, and violent incidents in the southwest in which children were killed are pulling the balance down. Overall, the situation is close to normal, with slight tension.

en: Chilean President Kast's first state visit in 71 years and agreements on fighting crime and a fiber optic corridor
Arrest of Senator Nilton Condori on terrorism charges and political tension
Alleged threats against the family of Marset following his extradition, according to President Paz
Violent incidents in the southwest in which 4 children and 1 adult died
Funding initiatives for judicial reform and the start of work by nine regional prosecutors

summary.en: The day mixed a fuel (LPG) shortage that triggered blockades and a fatal shooting, plus a public feud between the president and vice president over leaked audios and reports of depleting gas reserves. Positive signals were limited to a Mutún steel-plant dispute settlement and the appointment of nine prosecutors, so the overall picture is one of serious strain rather than crisis.

en: LPG shortage causing blockades and conflicts, with two killings in Warnes
Vice president publicly exposing audios, deepening crisis with the president
Mutún steel plant disputes resolved between ESM and Sinosteel

summary.en: The period mixes serious strains, including teacher protests with police dispersal in La Paz, irregular LPG supply, a warning of a 100% cement price rise, and a fatal shooting near Viru Viru airport. Offsetting these are a Chilean state visit, progress on an ethics law, and fintech and investment news, so the day reads as roughly routine with some stress.

en: Police dispersal of protesting teachers in La Paz
Irregular LPG gas supply in La Paz and El Alto
Builders warn of 100% cement price increase

summary.en: The period is dominated by US visa restrictions on current and former officials across the judiciary, prosecutors and legislature, plus customs corruption cases and a judicial resignation, which add pressure on institutions. Offsetting this are routine positives such as a sanitation program, a new Ecuador trade commission and Spanish security cooperation, while the teachers' strike, bread and cement price rises and narco violence add friction.

en: US visa restrictions on judicial, prosecutorial and legislative officials
Santa Cruz judicial tribunal president resigns after visa restriction
Customs officials implicated in bribery and contraband cases

summary.en: Bolivia's last 24 hours mixed economic and institutional strain (a 0.2% ECLAC growth forecast, households cutting food spending to repay loans, a threatened indefinite teachers' strike, and US visa restrictions tied to judicial and prosecutorial officials) with some diplomatic and integration progress with Chile and Ecuador. Drought and flood alerts add pressure, but there is no violent crackdown or crisis-level event, so the score sits in the serious-pressure range without reaching it.

en: ECLAC cuts Bolivia growth forecast to 0.2%
Teachers threaten indefinite strike after national 24-hour stoppage
US visa restrictions hit judicial and prosecutorial officials

summary.en: Bolivia's period mixes positive financial and security news, including reserves near $4 billion, $492 million in IDB credits and large drug seizures, with strain from US visa bans on officials, 109 social conflicts in Q3 and a drought killing livestock. Net, it reads as an ordinary day with a somewhat negative tilt, supported by the strongly negative GDELT tone.

en: IDB approves $492.2 million in loans for Bolivia
Reserves near $4 billion, though liquid dollars remain scarce
US visa bans and blacklist hitting current and former officials

summary.en: Bolivia's 53-day social conflict, attacks on journalists, fuel-price and cost-of-living pressure, and renewed armed-struggle warnings dominate the period. Some routine positives (a bread-price negotiation, an illegal-mining raid, the Starlink launch) and a less negative news tone than the world average keep the score from falling lower.

en: 53-day conflict continuing, with SIP alarm over attacks on press
Fuel hikes, IMF austerity and cost-of-living complaints from unions
Evo Morales warns armed struggle could return

summary.en: The period mixes routine positives, including a bread-price agreement, the Bono Juancito Pinto payment, and diplomatic and trade rapprochement with Chile, Peru, Brazil and Ecuador. Negatives include a high-profile murder, organized-crime concerns, and Evo Morales warning of armed struggle, with a more negative GDELT tone than the world average.

Chile proposes restoring ambassadors; Lula call with Paz
Bono Juancito Pinto payments begin nationwide

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and trade news (a CAF loan decree, a Peru border crossing, conservation funding) with stress signals: a shift to gas imports, a poverty warning, a bread-price standoff, an EU corruption inquiry, and a prison hostage situation. GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, so the score sits modestly below an ordinary day.

Cacerolazo protest against hunger and reports of falling gas exports

summary.en: Bolivia's day was dominated by economic strain: the World Bank sees recession through 2027, a 2027 budget projects two-digit inflation and a 6.7% deficit, and the energy minister admitted gas reserves are insufficient. Offsetting items include a new investment law seen as improving legal certainty, a World Bank loan, and routine local measures, while GDELT tone is clearly more negative than the world average.

Positive signals include export figures nearing the 2022 record and the government describing the blockades as handled through dialogue, but the negative press tone and unresolved disputes keep the score near neutral.

en: Anniversary coverage of economic adjustments, energy crisis and political tensions
Exports nearly matching 2022 record despite 53 days of blockades
Record drug seizure of 283 tons reported by authorities

summary.en: The period is dominated by contentious politics: teacher and cooperative protests, mayors demanding revenue sharing, a contested mining code, hired-killing (sicariato) fears, and a Supreme Court president who fled and is sought by Interpol. Sharp drops in government approval and a diplomatic asylum case add strain, though there is no sign of a crackdown or institutional breakdown.
summary.it: Il periodo è dominato da una politica molto conflittuale: proteste di insegnanti e cooperative, sindaci che chiedono una ripartizione delle entrate, un contestato codice minerario, timori per gli omicidi su commissione e un presidente della Corte Suprema fuggito e ricercato dall'Interpol. Il forte calo dell'approvazione del governo e un caso di asilo diplomatico aumentano le tensioni, ma non vi sono segnali di repressione o di crollo istituzionale.
summary.ru: Период определяется острой политической борьбой: протесты учителей и кооперативов, требования мэров о распределении доходов, спорный горнодобывающий кодекс, опасения по поводу заказных убийств и председатель Верховного суда, который скрылся и разыскивается Интерполом. Резкое падение одобрения правительства и дело о дипломатическом убежище усиливают напряжение, однако признаков репрессий или институционального кризиса не наблюдается.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة سياسات شديدة الخلاف: احتجاجات المعلمين والتعاونيات، ومطالبات العمد بتقاسم الإيرادات، وقانون تعدين مثير للجدل، ومخاوف من جرائم القتل المأجور، ورئيس المحكمة العليا الذي فرّ ويُطلب من الإنتربول توقيفه. وتزيد الانخفاضات الحادة في تأييد الحكومة وقضية اللجوء الدبلوماسي من الضغوط، غير أنه لا توجد مؤشرات على حملة قمع أو انهيار مؤسسي.
summary.fa: این دوره را سیاست‌های بحث‌برانگیز تحت‌الشعاع قرار داده است: اعتراضات معلمان و تعاونی‌ها، درخواست شهرداران برای تقسیم درآمدها، قانون معدن مورد مناقشه، نگرانی از قتل‌های سفارشی، و رئیس دیوان عالی کشور که گریخته و اینترپل خواستار دستگیری او شده است. کاهش شدید میزان رضایت از دولت و یک پرونده پناهندگی دیپلماتیک بر فشارها افزوده‌اند، اما نشانه‌ای از سرکوب یا فروپاشی نهادی دیده نمی‌شود.
summary.zh: 本时期以激烈的政治争议为主：教师和合作社抗议、市长要求分享财政收入、有争议的采矿法规、雇凶杀人的担忧，以及一名逃亡的最高法院院长被国际刑警组织通缉。政府支持率大幅下降和一起外交庇护案件加剧了压力，但目前没有镇压或体制崩溃的迹象。
summary.tr: Dönemde çekişmeli siyaset öne çıkıyor: öğretmen ve kooperatif protestoları, gelir paylaşımı talep eden belediye başkanları, tartışmalı bir madencilik yasası, kiralık katillik (sicariato) korkusu ve kaçarak Interpol tarafından aranan bir Yargıtay başkanı. Hükümetin onay oranlarındaki keskin düşüş ve diplomatik sığınma davası gerilimi artırıyor; ancak bir baskı dalgası ya da kurumsal çöküş belirtisi görülmüyor.
summary.es: El período está dominado por una política muy disputada: protestas de docentes y cooperativas, alcaldes que exigen el reparto de ingresos, un código minero controvertido, temores por el sicariato y un presidente de la Corte Suprema que huyó y es buscado por Interpol. Las fuertes caídas en la aprobación del gobierno y un caso de asilo diplomático añaden tensión, aunque no hay señales de represión ni de colapso institucional.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par une politique très conflictuelle : manifestations d'enseignants et de coopératives, maires exigeant un partage des recettes, code minier controversé, craintes de sicariato (assassinats à gages) et président de la Cour suprême en fuite, recherché par Interpol. La forte baisse de la cote de popularité du gouvernement et une affaire d'asile diplomatique ajoutent de la tension, mais rien n'indique une répression ni un effondrement institutionnel.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum wird von umstrittener Politik bestimmt: Proteste von Lehrkräften und Genossenschaften, Bürgermeister, die eine Einnahmenteilung fordern, ein umstrittenes Bergbaugesetz, Sorgen vor Auftragsmorden (sicariato) und ein Präsident des Obersten Gerichtshofs, der geflohen ist und von Interpol gesucht wird. Starke Rückgänge bei der Zustimmung zur Regierung und ein diplomatischer Asylfall verschärfen die Lage, doch es gibt keine Anzeichen für ein hartes Durchgreifen oder einen institutionellen Zusammenbruch.
summary.pt: O período é dominado por uma política muito disputada: protestos de professores e cooperativas, prefeitos exigindo repartição de receitas, um código de mineração controverso, temores de sicariato (assassinatos por encomenda) e um presidente da Suprema Corte que fugiu e é procurado pela Interpol. As fortes quedas na aprovação do governo e um caso de asilo diplomático aumentam a tensão, embora não haja sinais de repressão nem de colapso institucional.
summary.ja: 今期は政治的対立が中心となっている。教師と協同組合による抗議、税収配分を求める市長たち、争点となっている鉱業法、「シカリアト」(請負殺人)への懸念、そして国外へ逃亡し、インターポールから捜索されている最高裁判所長官がいる。政府支持率の急落と外交的庇護をめぐる案件が緊張を高めているが、取り締まりや制度の崩壊の兆候は見られない。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 논쟁적인 정치가 지배하고 있다: 교사 및 협동조합의 항의, 세입 배분을 요구하는 시장들, 논란이 되는 광업법, 청부살인(sicariato) 우려, 그리고 도피 중이며 인터폴의 수배를 받고 있는 대법원장. 정부 지지율의 급락과 외교적 망명 사건이 긴장을 더하고 있으나, 단속이나 제도적 붕괴의 조짐은 없다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि पर विवादास्पद राजनीति हावी है: शिक्षकों और सहकारी समितियों के विरोध प्रदर्शन, राजस्व साझाकरण की मांग करते महापौर, एक विवादित खनन संहिता, किराए पर हत्या (sicariato) का भय, और सर्वोच्च न्यायालय के एक अध्यक्ष जो भाग निकले हैं और जिनकी इंटरपोल को तलाश है। सरकार की स्वीकृति में तीव्र गिरावट और एक राजनयिक शरण मामला तनाव बढ़ा रहे हैं, हालांकि दमन या संस्थागत टूट का कोई संकेत नहीं है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από αμφισβητούμενη πολιτική: διαμαρτυρίες δασκάλων και συνεταιρισμών, δήμαρχοι που ζητούν κατανομή εσόδων, ένας αμφισβητούμενος κώδικας μεταλλείων, φόβοι για μισθοφορική δολοφονία (sicariato), και ένας πρόεδρος του Ανωτάτου Δικαστηρίου που διέφυγε και αναζητείται από την Interpol. Οι απότομες πτώσεις της κυβερνητικής έγκρισης και μια υπόθεση διπλωματικού ασύλου προσθέτουν πίεση, ωστόσο δεν υπάρχει ένδειξη καταστολής ή θεσμικής κατάρρευσης.

summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin Hint siyaseti ve haberlerinden oluşuyor; Delhi'nin 'çok kötü' hava kalitesi, bir iPhone fabrikasında üç işçinin ölümü ve Diwali havai fişek yaralanmaları olumsuz bir tablo çiziyor. summary.es: El periodo está compuesto en gran medida por política y noticias rutinarias de la India, con un matiz negativo debido a la calidad del aire "muy mala" en Delhi, la muerte de tres trabajadores en una fábrica de iPhone y heridos por fuegos artificiales de Diwali. Las fuertes ganancias bursátiles del último mes, el aumento de la producción de té y las aprobaciones de OPV de la SEBI compensan parcialmente estos aspectos.
summary.fr: La période est en grande partie composée de politique et d'actualités indiennes courantes, avec une tonalité négative due à la qualité de l'air « très mauvaise » à Delhi, à la mort de trois ouvriers dans une usine d'iPhone et aux blessures liées aux feux d'artifice de Diwali. Les fortes hausses boursières du dernier mois, la progression de la production de thé et les autorisations d'introductions en bourse de la SEBI compensent en partie ces éléments.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum besteht weitgehend aus routinemäßiger indischer Politik und Nachrichten, mit einer negativen Tendenz durch die »sehr schlechte« Luftqualität in Delhi, drei Todesfälle unter Arbeitern in einer iPhone-Fabrik und Verletzungen durch Diwali-Feuerwerk. Starke Kursgewinne im vergangenen Monat, ein Anstieg der Teeproduktion und SEBI-Genehmigungen für Börsengänge gleichen dies teilweise aus.
summary.pt: O período é em grande parte composto por política e notícias rotineiras da Índia, com tom negativo devido à qualidade do ar "muito ruim" em Delhi, à morte de três trabalhadores em uma fábrica de iPhone e a ferimentos causados por fogos de artifício do Diwali. Os fortes ganhos do mercado no último mês, o crescimento da produção de chá e as aprovações de IPOs pela SEBI compensam parcialmente esses fatores.
summary.ja: この期間は概ね日常的なインドの政治とニュースで、デリーの「非常に悪い」大気質、iPhone工場での労働者3人の死亡、ディワリ期間中の花火によるけがなどがマイナス材料となりました。一方、過去1か月の市場の大幅上昇、茶の生産量の増加、SEBIによるIPO承認が、これらをある程度相殺しました。
summary.ko: 이 기간은 대체로 일상적인 인도 정치 및 뉴스였으며, 델리의 '매우 나쁨' 수준의 대기질, 아이폰 공장 노동자 3명 사망, 디왈리 폭죽 관련 부상 등으로 부정적인 분위기였습니다. 지난 한 달간의 강한 시장 상승, 차 생산량 증가, SEBI의 IPO 승인은 이를 어느 정도 상쇄했습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि मुख्यतः भारत की नियमित राजनीति और समाचारों से भरी रही, जिसमें दिल्ली की 'बहुत खराब' वायु गुणवत्ता, एक iPhone कारखाने में तीन कामगारों की मौत और दिवाली के पटाखों से हुई चोटों ने नकारात्मक रुख दिया। पिछले एक महीने में बाजार में मज़बूत तेज़ी, चाय उत्पादन में वृद्धि और SEBI की IPO मंज़ूरियों ने इनमें से कुछ प्रभाव को संतुलित किया।
summary.el: Η περίοδος ήταν σε μεγάλο βαθμό συνηθισμένη ινδική πολιτική και ειδήσεις, με αρνητική τάση λόγω της «πολύ κακής» ποιότητας αέρα στο Δελχί, των τριών θανάτων εργατών σε εργοστάσιο iPhone και των τραυματισμών από πυροτεχνήματα του Ντιβάλι. Οι ισχυρές κέρδη της αγοράς τον τελευταίο μήνα, η αύξηση της παραγωγής τσαγιού και οι εγκρίσεις IPO της SEBI αντιστάθμισαν εν μέρει αυτά.
summary.it: Il periodo è in gran parte caratterizzato dalla routine della politica e delle notizie indiane, con una tendenza negativa dovuta alla qualità dell'aria "molto scarsa" a Delhi, alla morte di tre lavoratori in uno stabilimento di componenti per iPhone e ai feriti causati dai fuochi d'artificio di Diwali. I forti guadagni di mercato registrati nell'ultimo mese, la crescita della produzione di tè e le approvazioni SEBI per le IPO compensano in parte questi fattori.
summary.ru: Период в основном характеризуется обычными новостями и политикой Индии с негативным оттенком из-за «очень плохого» качества воздуха в Дели, гибели трёх рабочих на заводе по производству деталей для iPhone и травм от фейерверков на Дивали. Сильный рост рынков за последний месяц, рост производства чая и одобрения SEBI на IPO отчасти компенсируют эти факторы.
summary.ar: تغلب على الفترة السياسة والأخبار الهندية الروتينية، معميل سلبي بسبب جودة الهواء "السيئة للغاية" في دلهي، ووفاة ثلاثة عمال في مصنع لقطع هواتف آيفون، والإصابات الناجمة عن ألعاب الاحتفال بمهرجان ديوالي. وتخفف مكاسب السوق القوية خلال الشهر الماضي، ونمو إنتاج الشاي، وموافقات هيئة الأوراق المالية والبورصات الهندية (SEBI) على الطروحات العامة الأولية، من حدة هذه العوامل إلى حد ما.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً شامل اخبار و سیاست روتین هند است که با گرایشی منفی همراه است؛ از جمله کیفیت هوای «بسیار بد» در دهلی، مرگ سه کارگر در یک کارخانه قطعات آیفون و آسیب‌دیدگی ناشی از فشفشه‌های دیوالی. رشد قوی بازار در ماه گذشته، افزایش تولید چای و تأییدیه‌های SEBI برای عرضه‌های عمومی اولیه (IPO) تا حدی این عوامل را خنثی می‌کنند.
summary.zh: 该时期的新闻基本为印度的日常政治与时事，整体偏负面，原因包括德里“非常差”的空气质量、一家iPhone工厂三名工人死亡，以及排灯节烟花造成的伤害。过去一个月市场强劲上涨、茶叶产量增长以及印度证券交易委员会（SEBI）批准首次公开募股（IPO），在一定程度上抵消了这些负面因素。
