summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 기자(Giza) 인근의 치명적인 열차 충돌 사고(사망 7명, 부상 100명 이상)와 긍정적인 경제·투자 소식이 함께 보도되었다. 긍정적인 소식에는 근원 인플레이션율이 13.1%로 둔화된 점, 4,200만 달러 규모의 해상 가스 계약, 관광 및 비즈니스 확대 계획이 포함된다. 해외 보도에서는 정치범 관련 보고와 사형 집행 위험도 제기되었으나, 전반적으로는 평범한 하루에 가까우며 다소 긍정적인 흐름을 보인다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में गीज़ा के पास एक घातक ट्रेन टक्कर (7 मौतें, 100 से अधिक घायल) और सकारात्मक आर्थिक एवं निवेश समाचार दोनों शामिल हैं, जिनमें अक्टूबर में कोर मुद्रास्फीति का 13.1% तक नरम पड़ना, 4.2 करोड़ अमेरिकी डॉलर का अपतटीय गैस सौदा, तथा पर्यटन और व्यापार विस्तार की योजनाएँ शामिल हैं। विदेशी कवरेज में राजनीतिक कैदियों और फांसी के जोखिम संबंधी रिपोर्टों का भी उल्लेख है, किंतु कुल मिलाकर तस्वीर एक सामान्य दिन के करीब है, जिसमें हल्का सकारात्मक झुकाव है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει μια θανατηφόρα σύγκρουση τρένων κοντά στη Γκίζα (7 νεκροί, πάνω από 100 τραυματίες) με θετικές οικονομικές και επενδυτικές ειδήσεις, όπως η υποχώρηση του πληθωρισμού πυρήνα στο 13,1%, μια συμφωνία για υπεράκτιο φυσικό αέριο αξίας 42 εκατομμυρίων δολαρίων ΗΠΑ και σχέδια επέκτασης του τουρισμού και των επιχειρήσεων. Ξένα μέσα ενημέρωσης επισημαίνουν επίσης αναφορές για πολιτικούς κρατούμενους και κίνδυνο εκτέλεσης, however η συνολική εικόνα είναι κοντά σε μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα με ελαφρώς θετική τάση.
summary.tr: Dönem, Giza yakınlarında yaşanan ölümcül bir tren kazasını (7 ölü, 100'den fazla yaralı) olumlu ekonomik ve yatırım haberleriyle birlikte içeriyor; bunlar arasında çekirdek enflasyonun %13,1'e gerilemesi, 42 milyon ABD doları tutarında bir açık deniz gazı anlaşması ile turizm ve iş dünyası genişleme planları yer alıyor. Yabancı haber kaynakları ayrıca siyasi mahkumlara ilişkin haberler ile bir idam riskine dikkat çekiyor, ancak genel tablo hafif olumlu bir eğilimle sıradan bir güne yakın.
summary.es: El período combina una colisión mortal de trenes cerca de Giza (7 muertos y más de 100 heridos) con noticias económicas y de inversión positivas, entre ellas la desaceleración de la inflación subyacente al 13,1 %, un acuerdo de gas marino por 42 millones de dólares estadounidenses y planes de expansión del turismo y de los negocios. La prensa extranjera también señala informes sobre presos políticos y un riesgo de ejecución, pero el panorama general es cercano a un día ordinario con una ligera tendencia positiva.
summary.fr: La période mêle une collision ferroviaire mortelle près de Gizeh (7 morts, plus de 100 blessés) à des nouvelles économiques et d'investissement positives, notamment le recul de l'inflation sous-jacente à 13,1 %, un accord gazier offshore de 42 millions de dollars américains et des projets d'expansion du tourisme et des affaires. La presse étrangère signale également des informations sur des prisonniers politiques et un risque d'exécution, mais le tableau global correspond à une journée ordinaire avec une légère tendance positive.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet einen tödlichen Zugzusammenstoß nahe Gizeh (7 Tote, über 100 Verletzte) mit positiven Wirtschafts- und Investitionsmeldungen, darunter den Rückgang der Kerninflation auf 13,1 %, einen Offshore-Gasvertrag über 42 Millionen US-Dollar sowie Pläne zum Ausbau von Tourismus und Geschäftstätigkeit. Ausländische Berichterstattung weist außerdem auf Berichte über politische Gefangene und ein Hinrichtungsrisiko hin, doch insgesamt ähnelt das Bild einem gewöhnlichen Tag mit leicht positiver Tendenz.
summary.pt: O período combina uma colisão fatal de trens perto de Gizé (7 mortos e mais de 100 feridos) com notícias econômicas e de investimento positivas, incluindo a desaceleração da inflação subjacente para 13,1%, um acordo de gás offshore de US$ 42 milhões e planos de expansão do turismo e dos negócios. A cobertura estrangeira também aponta relatos de presos políticos e um risco de execução, mas o quadro geral se aproxima de um dia comum com leve tendência positiva.
summary.it: Il periodo combina uno scontro ferroviario mortale vicino a Giza (7 morti, oltre 100 feriti) con notizie economiche e di investimento positive, tra cui il calo dell'inflazione core al 13,1%, un accordo sul gas offshore da 42 milioni di dollari USA e piani di espansione del turismo e delle attività commerciali. La copertura straniera segnala anche notizie su prigionieri politici e un rischio di esecuzione, ma il quadro complessivo è quello di una giornata ordinaria con una lieve tendenza positiva.
summary.ru: Период сочетает смертельное столкновение поездов близ Гизы (7 погибших, более 100 раненых) с позитивными экономическими и инвестиционными новостями, включая снижение базовой инфляции до 13,1%, сделку по офшорному газу на 42 млн долларов США и планы расширения туризма и бизнеса. Зарубежные источники также сообщают о политических заключенных и риске казни, однако общая картина близка к обычному дню с небольшим позитивным уклоном.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين حادث تصادم قطارات قاتل قرب الجيزة (7 قتلى وأكثر من 100 مصاب) وأخبار اقتصادية واستثمارية إيجابية، تشمل تراجع التضخم الأساسي إلى 13.1%، وصفقة غاز بحرية بقيمة 42 مليون دولار أمريكي، وخطط لتوسيع السياحة والأنشطة التجارية. كما تشير التغطية الأجنبية إلى تقارير عن سجناء سياسيين ومخاطر تنفيذ حكم بالإعدام، لكن الصورة العامة قريبة من يوم عادي مع ميل إيجابي طفيف.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از یک برخورد مرگبار قطار در نزدیکی جیزه (۷ کشته و بیش از ۱۰۰ زخمی) با اخبار اقتصادی و سرمایه‌گذاری مثبت است، از جمله کاهش تورم هسته‌ای به ۱۳٫۱ درصد، قرارداد گاز فراساحلی به ارزش ۴۲ میلیون دلار آمریکا و برنامه‌های گسترش گردشگری و فعالیت‌های تجاری. رسانه‌های خارجی همچنین به گزارش‌هایی درباره زندانیان سیاسی و خطر اعدام اشاره می‌کنند، اما تصویر کلی به یک روز عادی با گرایش مثبت اندک نزدیک است.
summary.zh: 该时期既有吉萨附近一起致命列车相撞事故（7人死亡，100余人受伤），也有积极的经济和投资消息，包括核心通胀率降至13.1%、一项价值4200万美元的海上天然气协议，以及旅游和商业扩张计划。外国媒体还提及有关政治犯和执行死刑风险的报道，但总体情况接近普通的一天，略偏积极。

summary.en: Iran is effectively at war with the United States. Claims of an attack on the Konarak naval base, tension in the Strait of Hormuz, a downed drone, and warnings that the war could reignite stand out. The country is becoming more economically isolated through a blockade, sanctions, and the closure of neighboring borders, and GDELT tone is also far more negative than the world average. Diplomatic contacts with Russia and Pakistan are a limited balancing factor, but negotiations are stalled.

en: Claims of a US attack on the Konarak naval base and warnings of a return to war
Tension in the Strait of Hormuz, blocked oil exports, and threats against undersea internet cables
Sanctions, blockades, and shrinking border trade with Pakistan and Turkey
Deadlocked negotiations and reports that Israel is preparing to strike alone
Diplomatic contacts with Russia (Lavrov visit) and Pakistan (Munir visit)

summary.en: Iran is in a state of unresolved US-Iran war and blockade tension, with Hormuz tanker strikes, mines, drone shootdowns, threats against undersea cables, and talk of possible new strikes dominating coverage. Peace-mediation efforts via Pakistan exist but are deadlocked, and the period is marked by severe security threats rather than clear recovery.

en: Tanker strikes and mines reported in Strait of Hormuz
US-Iran peace talks deadlocked; Iran rules out talks
Threats of US strike on Pickaxe Mountain and retaliation vows

summary.en: Iran faces an active war-like confrontation: a US naval blockade, Iranian naval attacks on ships, a Saudi airport attack, and reports of planned renewed US-Israeli strikes, with some diplomacy continuing. Combined with a sharply negative news tone and economic strain from the blockade and border closures, the period is a severe crisis.

en: Reports of planned fresh US-Israeli strikes and Iranian threats
IRGC attacks on multiple ships amid blockade
Blockade halting shadow tanker exports; border trade restrictions

summary.en: Iran is in an active US-Israel confrontation: tankers reportedly hit in the Strait of Hormuz, new strike plans under discussion, and sanctions tightening on the economy with currency controls. Diplomacy (Pakistani mediation, Putin's comments) continues but offers little offsetting relief, so the day reads as a war-level crisis.

en: Tankers and ships reportedly hit or mined in Strait of Hormuz
New US-Israel strike plans being developed against Iran
Dollar purchases capped at $1,000/day amid sanctions pressure

summary.en: Iran faces intense renewed-conflict risk: US threats of another military operation, reported Iranian plots against US diplomats, embassy staffing cuts, and plans to target Gulf undersea cables. Partial offsets include European readiness for nuclear talks, reported oil export recovery, and a planned presidential trip to Moscow, but the overall picture points to serious strain on the economy and internal repression.

en: Trump threatens another military operation against Iran
US intelligence warns of Iranian plots against American diplomats
Reports of planned strikes on Gulf undersea internet cables

summary.en: Iran is in a tense standoff with the US, with tanker blasts and mines reported near Hormuz, renewed US strike threats, and armed unrest in Sistan-Baluchestan. The only clear positive is the reopening of the Pakistan border crossing after a week-long trade halt, which does not offset the security situation.

en: Tanker blasts and naval mines reported near Strait of Hormuz
Trump hints at renewed US strikes on Iran
Armed clashes and resistance attacks reported in Sistan-Baluchestan and elsewhere

summary.en: The period is dominated by fears of renewed war after reported tanker attacks in Hormuz, an explosion at a Tabriz radar site, and public signs of anxiety such as food stockpiling. Diplomatic activity (Qatari mediation, regional security delegations) and the rescue of Iranian sailors partly offset this, but the overall picture is serious tension.

en: Reported attacks on seven oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz
Fears of a return to full-scale war with the US and Israel
Explosion reported at a radar facility in Tabriz

summary.en: Iran faces a serious security crisis, with reports of US forces ready for strikes within 96 hours and an energy and political strain. Regional diplomacy is moving forward, with Saudi, Pakistani and Turkish officials holding security talks in Tehran, a reported Qatari effort toward a five-day US-Iran deal, and an agreement to keep talking.

en: US strike readiness reported within 96 hours of Trump order
Saudi, Pakistani, Turkish security talks held in Tehran
Reported Qatari effort toward five-day US-Iran agreement

summary.en: Iran is in an unresolved war-and-crisis period: US officials warn of a renewed 'intense' strike campaign, a ceasefire has reportedly broken down, and Hormuz control is contested. Domestic stress is also high, with armed clashes in Khash, protests against death sentences, a five-year sentence for filmmaker Jafar Panahi, and warnings of large job losses. Mediation by Qatar and the Gulf states offers some de-escalation, which keeps the score above the war band.

en: US warns Gulf allies of possible intense renewed war with Iran
Ceasefire called a waste of time; Iran slams broken commitments
Armed clashes intensify in Khash; protests against death sentences

summary.en: Iran is in a 'neither war nor peace' state, with renewed US strike threats, a reported drone shootdown and a costly ongoing conflict. Diplomacy is active through mediators and a Vance outreach, but the threat of renewed war dominates the period.

en: Renewed US strike threats after midterms amid stalled war
Diplomatic outreach via mediators and Vance letter
IRGC reports US drone shot down near Hormuz

summary.en: Iran is in an active conflict with the US: strikes have resumed, Qeshm Island and a naval base were hit, and a tanker was attacked in Hormuz. Executions are rising and the economy is under blockade-related strain, which outweighs the tentative peace outreach through Vance's letter and Qatari mediation.

en: US strikes resume after Iran rejects peace-talk proposal
Explosions on Qeshm Island and Iranian naval base attack
Tanker hit by explosive devices in Strait of Hormuz

summary.en: Iran is in an active standoff with the US: tankers were hit and Hormuz traffic halted, while a draft deal to transfer uranium and reopen Hormuz within 7 days is being mediated by Qatar. Diplomatic progress is offset by ongoing military incidents and a harsh judicial sentence against filmmaker Jafar Panahi.

en: Hormuz tanker attacks and halted shipping amid US-Iran tensions
Draft US-Iran deal on uranium transfer and Hormuz reopening
Panahi sentenced to over five years in prison

summary.en: Iran is in a tense standoff: renewed US and Israeli strike threats, a disputed incident off Qeshm Island, and Hormuz shipping still closed. Mediated diplomacy through Qatar and Oman-style channels is active but unresolved, which keeps the period in the serious-problems range.

en: Trump and Netanyahu threaten renewed strikes on Iranian nuclear sites
Strait of Hormuz reopening conditional on US concessions
Claimed US strike on fishing boats off Qeshm Island

summary.en: Iran is in an active military confrontation with the US, with recent US strikes, attacks on tankers near Hormuz, and renewed threats of further strikes. Qatar-mediated talks continue, but the headlines show no breakthrough, so the period is well below an ordinary day.

en: US strikes on Iran and renewed threats of further strikes
Tankers hit or mined near Hormuz; shipping under attack
Oil prices near $110 amid war and stalled talks

summary.en: Iran is in an active armed conflict with the United States, with fresh US strikes on Qeshm Island, explosions at Bandar Lengeh, a naval blockade and claims of mariners killed. Talks to end the war continue but have produced no deal, so the period is dominated by war and threats of further strikes.

en: US strikes on Qeshm Island and explosions reported in Iran
Naval blockade and drone shootdowns near Strait of Hormuz
Talks ended without deal; threats of renewed strikes continue

summary.en: Iran remains in an active standoff with the US: recent US strikes on Qeshm, mines and tanker losses in Hormuz, and executions and attacks inside Iran. Mediation via Qatar and a Trump pause on new strikes offer some de-escalation, which keeps the score above the war band.

en: US strike on Qeshm confirmed; Iran warns of retaliation
Tankers destroyed after hitting mines in Hormuz
Executions of January uprising prisoners in Isfahan

summary.en: Iran is in an ongoing confrontation with the US, with Washington threatening to 'finish the job' and Tehran warning of a strong response to further strikes. Domestic repression also continues, including student crackdowns, expulsions and executions, though markets and some US commentary point to possible de-escalation.

en: Iran warns of strong response to further US strikes
Crackdown on student protesters with expulsions and hearings
Executions of uprising prisoners continue in Isfahan

summary.en: Iran remains in an active war with the US and Israel, with tanker attacks in Hormuz, oil near $100, and renewed US strike threats. Diplomacy continues through a nuclear proposal sent via Qatar, and reports cite executions of protesters and arrests, which keeps the score in the crisis range.

en: Ongoing war with US-Israel and renewed strike threats
Tanker attacks in Hormuz and oil surging toward $100
Iran's nuclear proposal and seven conditions via Qatar and Russia

summary.en: Iran is in an active military confrontation with the US, with fresh strikes on air defences, drones shot down, and missiles reported over Qeshm. Qatari mediation and renewed diplomatic contacts offer some counterweight, but the period is dominated by war and escalation risk.

en: Fresh US strikes on Iran's air defences, described as 'minor' by Trump
Iran reports downing US drones over Qeshm Island and missile impacts there
Qatar-mediated nuclear proposals under review, a partial de-escalation signal

summary.en: The period is dominated by escalating naval confrontation with the US around the Strait of Hormuz, including a US blockade, disabled vessels, reported strikes on Qeshm Island, and tankers damaged by mines. Domestic and foreign media also report three executions linked to protests, which adds to the sense of severe pressure on the country.

en: Naval clashes and US blockade enforcement in Hormuz and Gulf of Oman
Explosions on Qeshm Island and tankers hit by mines
Executions of three men linked to protests

summary.en: The period is dominated by an active US-Iran conflict: strikes on Qeshm Island, mines hitting tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, a Houthi strike on Aramco, and fuel rationing blamed on military aggression. Talks and Trump's remarks that renewed attacks are 'highly unlikely' offer only a weak de-escalation signal.

en: Active US strikes on Qeshm Island and Hormuz tanker mine incidents
Iranian officials threatening 'collapse' and 'hell' if aggression continues
Fuel conservation appeals tied to military attacks on gas production

summary.en: Iran remains in an active, unresolved conflict with the US and Israel, marked by a blockade, threats of renewed strikes, and Iranian warnings of retaliation. Signals of possible de-escalation from Washington and Gulf diplomacy partly offset the serious security and economic strain.
summary.ja: イランは米国およびイスラエルとの間で、現在も解決していない紛争を続けている。封鎖、再度の空爆の脅し、そしてイランによる報復の警告が特徴である。ワシントンやガルフ諸国の外交による緊張緩和の兆しは、深刻な安全保障上および経済上の負担を一部和らげている。
summary.ko: 이란은 미국 및 이스라엘과의 해결되지 않은 분쟁 상태를 여전히 이어가고 있으며, 봉쇄, 재개될 수 있는 공습 위협, 이란의 보복 경고가 이어지고 있다. 워싱턴과 걸프 지역의 외교를 통한 긴장 완화 신호가 심각한 안보 및 경제적 부담을 일부 상쇄하고 있다.
summary.hi: ईरान अमेरिका और इज़राइल के साथ एक सक्रिय और अनसुलझे संघर्ष में बना हुआ है, जिसमें नाकेबंदी, नए हवाई हमलों की धमकियाँ और ईरान की जवाबी कार्रवाई की चेतावनियाँ शामिल हैं। वॉशिंगटन और खाड़ी देशों की कूटनीति से तनाव कम होने के संकेत गंभीर सुरक्षा और आर्थिक दबाव को कुछ हद तक संतुलित कर रहे हैं।

summary.it: L'Iran resta coinvolto in un conflitto attivo e non risolto con Stati Uniti e Israele, segnato da un blocco, minacce di nuovi attacchi e avvertimenti iraniani di ritorsione. I segnali di una possibile de-escalation da parte di Washington e della diplomazia del Golfo compensano in parte la grave pressione sul piano della sicurezza e dell'economia.

summary.es: Irán sigue inmerso en un conflicto activo y sin resolver con Estados Unidos e Israel, marcado por un bloqueo, amenazas de nuevos ataques y advertencias iraníes de represalias. summary.fr: L'Iran demeure engagé dans un conflit actif et non résolu avec les États-Unis et Israël, marqué par un blocus, des menaces de nouvelles frappes et des avertissements iraniens de représailles. summary.de: Iran befindet sich weiterhin in einem aktiven, ungelösten Konflikt mit den USA und Israel, der durch eine Blockade, Drohungen mit erneuten Angriffen und iranische Vergeltungswarnungen geprägt ist. summary.pt: O Irã permanece em um conflito ativo e não resolvido com os EUA e Israel, marcado por um bloqueio, ameaças de novos ataques e advertências iranianas de retaliação. summary.es: El periodo combina noticias rutinarias con varios avances institucionales positivos: un referéndum constitucional que, según se informa, cuenta con amplio apoyo, y la aprobación por parte de la SADC de una oficina de enlace en Antananarivo. Las noticias de delincuencia ordinaria y las tensiones de mítines previos a 2027 impiden que la puntuación suba más, y el tono de GDELT (+0,33, por encima de la media mundial) apunta en la misma dirección.
summary.fr: La période mêle des nouvelles courantes à plusieurs avancées institutionnelles positives : un référendum constitutionnel qui, selon les informations, recueille un large soutien, et l'approbation par la SADC d'un bureau de liaison à Antananarivo. Les faits divers ordinaires et les tensions liées aux meetings d'avant 2027 empêchent le score de monter davantage, et le ton GDELT (+0,33, au-dessus de la moyenne mondiale) va dans le même sens.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verbindet Routinemeldungen mit mehreren positiven institutionellen Entwicklungen: ein Verfassungsreferendum, über das mit breiter Unterstützung berichtet wird, und die Genehmigung eines Verbindungsbüros in Antananarivo durch die SADC. Gewöhnliche Kriminalmeldungen und Spannungen bei Kundgebungen vor 2027 verhindern einen weiteren Anstieg des Werts, und der GDELT-Ton (+0,33, über dem Weltdurchschnitt) weist in dieselbe Richtung.
summary.pt: O período combina notícias de rotina com vários avanços institucionais positivos: um referendo constitucional noticiado com amplo apoio e a aprovação, pela SADC, de um escritório de ligação em Antananarivo. Notícias de criminalidade comum e tensões em comícios anteriores a 2027 impedem que a pontuação suba mais, e o tom do GDELT (+0,33, acima da média mundial) aponta na mesma direção.
summary.it: Il periodo unisce notizie di routine ad alcuni sviluppi istituzionali positivi: un referendum costituzionale riportato con ampio sostegno e l'approvazione da parte della SADC di un ufficio di collegamento ad Antananarivo. Le ordinarie cronache di criminalità e le tensioni legate ai comizi in vista del 2027 impediscono un ulteriore aumento del punteggio, mentre il tono GDELT (+0,33, superiore alla media mondiale) va nella stessa direzione.
summary.ru: Период сочетает рутинные новости с несколькими институциональными позитивными событиями: конституционный референдум, о котором сообщается с широкой поддержкой, и одобрение САДК открытия отделения связи в Антананариву. Обычные криминальные сюжеты и напряжённость, связанная с митингами перед 2027 годом, не дают показателю расти дальше, а тональность GDELT (+0,33, выше среднемирового уровня) указывает в том же направлении.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين أخبار روتينية وعدد من الإيجابيات المؤسسية: استفتاء دستوري أُفيد بأنه حظي بتأييد واسع، وموافقة الجماعة الإنمائية للجنوب الأفريقي (SADC) على مكتب اتصال في أنتاناناريفو. وتحول قصص الجريمة العادية والتوترات المرتبطة بتجمعات ما قبل عام 2027 دون ارتفاع المؤشر أكثر، بينما تشير نبرة GDELT (+0.33، أعلى من المتوسط العالمي) إلى الاتجاه نفسه.
summary.fa: این دوره اخبار معمول را با چند رویداد مثبت نهادی ترکیب می‌کند: یک همه‌پرسی قانون اساسی که گزارش شده با حمایت گسترده همراه بوده، و تأیید دفتر ارتباطی جامعه توسعه آفریقای جنوبی (SADC) در آنتاناناریوو. داستان‌های جنایی عادی و تنش‌های تجمعات پیش از ۲۰۲۷ مانع از افزایش بیشتر امتیاز می‌شوند، و لحن GDELT (+۰٫۳۳، بالاتر از میانگین جهانی) در همین جهت است.
summary.zh: 该时期既有例行新闻，也有若干制度性积极进展：据报道，宪法公投获得广泛支持；南部非洲发展共同体（SADC）批准在塔那那利佛设立联络处。普通刑事案件报道以及2027年前集会引发的紧张局势使得评分未能进一步上升；GDELT语调（+0.33，高于全球平均水平）也指向同一方向。

summary.it: Il periodo appare ordinario: una fitta nebbia ha disturbato oltre 175 voli a Schiphol, e ci sono state proteste contro un accordo sulla produzione di armi israeliana e per dichiarazioni antisemite. Tra i segnali positivi moderati figurano il ripristino del collegamento ferroviario Groninga-Rotterdam, i piani abitativi e un lieve aumento delle iscrizioni universitarie, con l'AEX in rialzo dello 0,35% in giornata.
summary.ru: Период выглядит обычным: густой туман нарушил работу более 175 рейсов в Схипхольском аэропорту, прошли протесты против сделки о производстве израильского оружия и из-за антисемитских высказываний. Умеренно позитивные факторы включают восстановление железнодорожного сообщения Гронинген–Роттердам, жилищные планы и небольшой рост числа студентов, индекс AEX вырос на 0,35% за день.
summary.ar: تبدو الفترة اعتيادية: تسبب ضباب كثيف في اضطراب أكثر من 175 رحلة في مطار سخيبهول، وشهدت البلاد احتجاجات على صفقة لإنتاج أسلحة إسرائيلية وعلى تصريحات معادية للسامية. وتشمل الإيجابيات المعتدلة استعادة خط القطار المباشر بين خرونينغن وروتردام، وخطط الإسكان، وارتفاعاً طفيفاً في عدد الطلاب المسجلين، مع ارتفاع مؤشر AEX بنسبة 0.35% خلال اليوم.
summary.fa: به نظر می‌رسد این دوره عادی است: مه غلیظ بیش از ۱۷۵ پرواز در فرودگاه اسخیپول را مختل کرد و اعتراضاتی علیه توافق تولید تسلیحات اسرائیلی و اظهارات ضدیهودی برگزار شد. نکات مثبت محدود شامل بازگشت خط مستقیم قطار گرونینگن–روتردام، طرح‌های مسکن و افزایش اندک ثبت‌نام دانشجویان است، و شاخص AEX در همان روز ۰.۳۵٪ رشد کرد.
summary.zh: 局势看似平常：浓雾扰乱了史基浦机场175多个航班，并出现了针对以色列武器生产协议以及反犹言论的抗议。温和的积极因素包括格罗宁根至鹿特丹直达火车线路恢复运营、住房规划，以及学生入学人数小幅增长，当日AEX指数上涨0.35%。
summary.ja: 今回の期間は通常通りとみられる。濃霧によりスキポール空港の175便以上が乱れ、イスラエルの兵器生産契約や反ユダヤ主義的な発言に対する抗議活動も行われた。控えめな好材料として、フローニンゲン―ロッテルダム間の直通列車の再開、住宅計画、学生登録数のわずかな増加があり、AEX指数はこの日0.35%上昇した。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 평이한 것으로 보인다. 짙은 안개로 스히폴 공항 항공편 175편 이상이 차질을 빚었고, 이스라엘 무기 생산 계약과 반유대주의 발언에 항의하는 시위가 있었다. 완만한 긍정 요인으로는 흐로닝언-로테르담 열차 직통 노선의 복원, 주택 계획, 학생 등록 인원의 소폭 증가가 있었으며, AEX 지수는 당일 0.35% 상승했다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि सामान्य लगती है। घने कोहरे से स्किपोल हवाई अड्डे की 175 से अधिक उड़ानें बाधित हुईं, और इज़राइली हथियार उत्पादन सौदे तथा यहूदी-विरोधी टिप्पणियों के विरोध में प्रदर्शन हुए। मामूली सकारात्मक पहलुओं में ग्रोनिंगन-रॉटरडैम ट्रेन सेवा की बहाली, आवास योजनाएँ और छात्र नामांकन में हल्की वृद्धि शामिल हैं, जबकि AEX उस दिन 0.35% बढ़ा।
summary.el: Η περίοδος φαίνεται συνηθισμένη: πυκνή ομίχλη διατάραξε περισσότερες από 175 πτήσεις στο Σίπχολ, ενώ υπήρξαν διαμαρτυρίες για συμφωνία παραγωγής ισραηλινών όπλων και για αντισημιτικές δηλώσεις. Μέτριες θετικές εξελίξεις αποτελούν η αποκατάσταση της απευθείας σιδηροδρομικής σύνδεσης Γκρόνινγκεν-Ρότερνταμ, τα στεγαστικά σχέδια και μια μικρή αύξηση των εγγραφών φοιτητών, με τον δείκτη AEX να ανεβαίνει κατά 0,35% εντός της ημέρας.
summary.tr: Dönem olağan görünüyor: yoğun sis Schiphol'de 175'ten fazla uçuşu aksattı; bir İsrail silah üretim anlaşmasına ve antisemitizm açıklamalarına karşı protestolar yapıldı. Ölçülü olumlu gelişmeler arasında yeniden hizmete giren Groningen-Rotterdam tren bağlantısı, konut planları ve öğrenci kaydında hafif bir artış yer alıyor; AEX ise gün içinde %0,35 yükseldi.
summary.es: El periodo parece rutinario: una densa niebla afectó a más de 175 vuelos en Schiphol, y hubo protestas por un acuerdo de producción de armamento israelí y por declaraciones antisemitas. Entre los aspectos positivos moderados se incluyen el restablecimiento de la conexión ferroviaria Groninga-Róterdam, los planes de vivienda y un ligero aumento de la matrícula estudiantil, mientras que el AEX subió un 0,35 % en la jornada.
summary.fr: La période semble routinière : un brouillard dense a perturbé plus de 175 vols à Schiphol, et des manifestations ont eu lieu contre un accord de production d'armement israélien et des propos antisémites. Parmi les éléments positifs modestes figurent le rétablissement de la liaison ferroviaire Groningue-Rotterdam, des projets de logement et une légère hausse des inscriptions étudiantes, tandis que l'AEX a progressé de 0,35 % dans la journée.
summary.de: Die Lage wirkt routinemäßig: Dichter Nebel störte über 175 Flüge am Flughafen Schiphol, und es gab Proteste gegen einen israelischen Rüstungsproduktionsdeal sowie wegen antisemitischer Äußerungen. Moderate positive Entwicklungen sind die wiederhergestellte Zugverbindung Groningen–Rotterdam, Wohnungsbaupläne und ein leichter Anstieg der Studierendenzahlen, während der AEX an diesem Tag um 0,35 % stieg.
summary.pt: O período parece rotineiro: um nevoeiro denso perturbou mais de 175 voos em Schiphol, e houve protestos contra um acordo de produção de armamento israelense e declarações antissemitas. Entre os aspetos positivos moderados estão o restabelecimento da ligação ferroviária Groningen-Roterdão, planos habitacionais e um ligeiro aumento das matrículas estudantis, enquanto a AEX subiu 0,35% no dia.

summary.ja: 投資契約、観光プロジェクト、外交交流が中心の、概ね平常どおりの一日でした。2026年の成長率予測は4.5%で、前向きな見通しが示されています。先の紛争後、ホルムズ海峡の海上輸送は通常に向けて回復しつつあります。一方、オマーン湾でのタンカーによる油流出は小さなマイナス要因です。
summary.ko: 투자 계약, 관광 프로젝트, 외교 교류가 중심이 된 대체로 평이한 하루였습니다. 2026년 성장률 전망은 4.5%로 낙관적입니다. 앞선 분쟁 이후 호르무즈 해협의 해상 운송은 정상 수준으로 회복되고 있습니다. 반면 오만만에서 발생한 유조선 기름 유출은 사소한 부정적 요인입니다.
summary.hi: यह एक अधिकतर सामान्य दिन रहा, जिसमें निवेश समझौते, पर्यटन परियोजनाएँ और कूटनीतिक संवाद प्रमुख रहे। 2026 के लिए 4.5% की उत्साहजनक वृद्धि पूर्वानुमान रहा। पहले के संघर्ष के बाद होर्मुज़ से जहाज़ों की आवाजाही सामान्य स्थिति की ओर लौट रही है। ओमान की खाड़ी में एक टैंकर से तेल रिसाव एक मामूली नकारात्मक घटना है।
summary.el: Η ημέρα ήταν κυρίως συνηθισμένη, με κυρίαρχες τις επενδυτικές συμφωνίες, τα τουριστικά έργα και τη διπλωματική δραστηριότητα, καθώς και μια αισιόδοξη πρόβλεψη ανάπτυξης 4,5% για το 2026. Η ναυσιπλοΐα μέσω των Στενών του Ορμούζ επανέρχεται σταδιακά στα φυσιολογικά επίπεδα μετά την προηγούμενη σύγκρουση, ενώ η διαρροή πετρελαίου από δεξαμενόπλοιο στον κόλπο του Ομάν είναι μια μικρή αρνητική εξέλιξη.
summary.tr: Çoğunlukla rutin bir gün; yatırım anlaşmaları, turizm projeleri, diplomatik temaslar ve 2026 için yüzde 4,5 olarak öngörülen olumlu büyüme tahmini öne çıktı. Hürmüz üzerinden yapılan sevkiyatlar, daha önceki çatışmanın ardından normale doğru toparlanıyor; Umman Denizi'nde bir tanker petrol sızıntısı ise küçük bir olumsuz gelişme.
summary.es: Un día en su mayoría rutinario, dominado por acuerdos de inversión, proyectos turísticos, contactos diplomáticos y una previsión de crecimiento optimista del 4,5 % para 2026. El tránsito por Ormuz se recupera hacia la normalidad tras el conflicto anterior, mientras que un derrame de petróleo de un buque cisterna en el golfo de Omán es un factor negativo menor.
summary.fr: Journée majoritairement ordinaire, dominée par des accords d'investissement, des projets touristiques, des échanges diplomatiques et une prévision de croissance optimiste de 4,5 % pour 2026. Le trafic maritime à travers le détroit d'Ormuz se rétablit progressivement après le conflit précédent, tandis qu'une marée noire causée par un pétrolier dans le golfe d'Oman constitue un facteur négatif mineur.
summary.de: Ein überwiegend routinemäßiger Tag, geprägt von Investitionsvereinbarungen, Tourismusprojekten, diplomatischen Kontakten und einer optimistischen Wachstumsprognose von 4,5 % für 2026. Der Schiffsverkehr durch die Straße von Hormus erholt sich nach dem vorangegangenen Konflikt allmählich wieder; ein Öltankerunfall mit Ölverschmutzung im Golf von Oman ist ein geringfügiger negativer Faktor.
summary.pt: Um dia em grande parte rotineiro, dominado por acordos de investimento, projetos turísticos, engajamento diplomático e uma previsão de crescimento otimista de 4,5% para 2026. O transporte marítimo por Ormuz está se recuperando para a normalidade após o conflito anterior, enquanto um derramamento de óleo de um navio-tanque no golfo de Omã é um fator negativo menor.
summary.it: Una giornata per lo più ordinaria, dominata da accordi di investimento, progetti turistici, impegno diplomatico e una previsione di crescita positiva del 4,5% per il 2026. Il traffico marittimo nello Stretto di Hormuz sta tornando alla normalità dopo il precedente conflitto, mentre una fuoriuscita di petrolio da una petroliera nel Golfo di Oman rappresenta un lieve elemento negativo.
summary.ru: В целом обычный день, в котором преобладают инвестиционные сделки, туристические проекты, дипломатические контакты и оптимистичный прогноз роста на 4,5% в 2026 году. Судоходство через Ормузский пролив восстанавливается и приближается к нормальному после недавнего конфликта, а разлив нефти с танкера в Оманском заливе является незначительным негативным фактором.
summary.ar: يوم روتيني في معظمه تهيمن عليه صفقات الاستثمار ومشاريع السياحة والتفاعل الدبلوماسي، مع توقعات متفائلة للنمو بنسبة 4.5% لعام 2026. وتتعافى الملاحة عبر مضيق هرمز نحو وضعها الطبيعي بعد النزاع السابق، فيما يمثل تسرب النفط من ناقلة في خليج عُمان عاملاً سلبياً طفيفاً.
summary.fa: روزی عمدتاً عادی که در آن معاملات سرمایه‌گذاری، پروژه‌های گردشگری، تعامل دیپلماتیک و پیش‌بینی رشد خوشبینانه ۴٫۵ درصدی برای سال ۲۰۲۶ غالب است. ترافیک کشتیرانی در تنگه هرمز پس از درگیری قبلی به سمت عادی شدن می‌رود، در حالی که نشت نفت از یک نفتکش در خلیج عمان یک عامل منفی جزئی است.
summary.zh: 当天大体属于常规情况，主要内容包括投资协议、旅游项目、外交往来，以及对2026年增长4.5%的乐观预测。在此前冲突之后，霍尔木兹海峡的航运正逐步恢复正常；阿曼湾一艘油轮发生溢油，是一项轻微的负面因素。

Подписано несколько соглашений по инвестициям, цепочкам поставок и промышленным проектам
ar: تسارع توقعات النمو إلى 4.5% لعام 2026
عبور الغاز الطبيعي المسال عبر هرمز بأعلى مستوياته منذ النزاع؛ والملاحة في تعافٍ
توقيع عدة اتفاقيات لمشاريع استثمارية وسلاسل إمداد وصناعية

عبور محموله‌های گاز طبیعی مایع از هرمز در بالاترین سطح از زمان درگیری؛ کشتیرانی در حال بهبود است
امضای چندین توافق در زمینه سرمایه‌گذاری، زنجیره تأمین و پروژه‌های صنعتی

霍尔木兹海峡液化天然气通行量为冲突以来最高；航运正在恢复
签署多项投资、供应链和工业项目协议

summary.en: Forming a new government in Iraq, collecting weapons under state control, and debates over quota-sharing (power distribution) continue, but there is no major violence or crisis headline. Oil exports are approaching pre-war levels, and foreign oil companies and investors are showing interest, which paints a mildly positive economic picture. Concerns about a fiscal crisis, uncertainty over dinar devaluation, and tensions with armed groups limit the score.

en: Oil exports approaching pre-war levels at 3.4 million barrels/day
Interest from major oil companies and investors in Iraq
Decision to bring weapons under state control, with enforcement under the counterterrorism law
Fiscal crisis, dinar devaluation, and criticism of quota-sharing in the government
Regional diplomacy: hosting Iran–Gulf talks and security cooperation with the KRG

summary.en: The period mixes serious strains with some positive signals. Dinar devaluation, protest warnings, a deadly Daesh attack that killed dozens of security personnel, and a border closure with Iran under US pressure weigh heavily. Gains such as an improved hunger ranking, a returning container line and oil majors eyeing re-entry partly offset them.

en: Dinar devaluation and protest warnings hit household finances
Burial of dozens of security personnel killed by Daesh
Iraq threatens crackdown on opponents of disarmament plan

summary.en: The period mixes regional strain (closure of the al-Sheeb crossing with Iran amid reported US pressure, denial of Houthi bases, new security curbs on cross-border attacks) and economic pressure (dollar near 170,000 dinars, reserves down about $16bn in 2026). Positives include the resumption of commercial shipping after 50 years, oil majors investing, and routine anti-narcotics seizures, so the day sits modestly below an ordinary period.

en: Al-Sheeb border crossing with Iran closed amid reported US pressure
Dinar pressure: dollar near 170,000, reserves down $16bn in 2026
Commercial shipping resumes after 50 years, a positive development

summary.en: The period mixes a completed cabinet formation, new aviation certifications and Development Road talks with regional strain: an apparent US-Iran conflict, Iran cutting internet access, armed factions resisting disarmament and a hospital chemotherapy shortage. Net, it reads as an ordinary day with slightly more negative tone than average.

en: Cabinet formation completed, signalling institutional progress
Regional US-Iran conflict and Iran internet cut weigh on outlook
Armed factions reportedly refusing disarmament plan

summary.en: Iraq's news mix is largely routine, with sovereignty signals such as the announced exit of US forces and the government's pledge on arms control. Those are offset by fears that a renewed US-Iran conflict could drag in Iraq, airspace violation concerns, and a repelled ISIS attack in Kirkuk.

en: Fears of renewed US-Iran war and armed factions joining
Announced US troop withdrawal and government sovereignty claims
Airspace violation concerns and ISIS attack repelled in Kirkuk

summary.en: Iraq's day mixed routine governance (the 2027 budget with new jobs, the Faw port nearing trials, and a Turkey-Iraq deal ending a decade-long dispute over the Bashiqa camp) with serious regional risk. Reports of possible Israeli strikes on Chinese air defenses, US travel warnings, militia airspace accusations and renewed Tishreen protest fears, plus a markedly negative news tone, pull the score below an ordinary day.

en: Turkey-Iraq agreement to hand over Bashiqa camp ends long dispute
Reports of Israeli strike on Chinese air defenses in Iraq
US travel warning citing inability to guarantee citizens' safety

summary.en: A mixed day: Baghdad announced steps toward integrating Sinjar security forces into the national army, and reconstruction and cultural projects advanced. Against that, Maysan threatened civil disobedience over the Shib border closure, Iran struck a Kurdish opposition base with drones, and the 2027 budget faces austerity and a large borrowing operation.

en: Sinjar security forces to be integrated into the Iraqi army
Maysan civil disobedience threat over Shib crossing closure
Iranian drone strike on Kurdish opposition base in Iraq

summary.en: Iraq's day mixed institutional progress with internal friction: the Sinjar armed group's disarmament and integration into the army and the 2027 budget and Development Road plans point to stronger state control. Against that, a Maysan council chief faces an arrest warrant over civil-disobedience threats, a Shia faction is pushing back against the government, and the Iran border closure and Hormuz disruption are straining the economy.

en: Sinjar PKK-linked units disarming and integrating into Iraqi army
Arrest warrant for Maysan council chief after secession and civil-disobedience threats
Iran border crossing closure dispute and Shia faction pushback

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and diplomacy (Syria and Jordan ties, reserves recovering, salaries secured) with security strain: drones downed near the US Embassy in Baghdad and an Iran border closure amid regional war. Economic pressure from blocked Hormuz trade and dollar smuggling offsets the positives, so the day sits modestly below an ordinary one.

en: Drones shot down near US Embassy in Baghdad, raising security alerts
Iran border crossing closure and blocked goods via Hormuz strain trade
Central bank reports dollar reserves recovering; salary funding secured for 2027

summary.en: The period was mostly positive, led by the handover of Sinjar security posts to the Iraqi army and the integration of about 4,000 YBŞ members into the forces, with Turkey welcoming it. Economic news was mixed: the lifting of foreign ownership limits, an automotive hub and Syria oil-export talks were offset by budget-deficit worries, IMF conditions, goods stranded in Hormuz and a drone incident in Baghdad.

en: Sinjar security posts handed to the Iraqi army; PKK-linked YBŞ integrated
Turkey welcomes Baghdad's authority over Sinjar and Bashiqa base handover
Foreign ownership restrictions lifted; non-oil revenue and trade expansion

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: weather, sports, a court sentencing, and cultural and local news. Modest positives include the Central Bank reporting the exchange-rate gap narrowing to 9%, progress toward a Sinjar settlement, and corruption convictions, offset by a new IMF loan request and a very negative news tone.

en: Central Bank says exchange-rate gap narrowed to 9%
Sinjar settlement talks and Baghdad-Ankara understanding reported
Anti-corruption court convictions of two MPs and an oil official

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: sports, real estate, trade data and cultural news. Mild positives include the Sinjar integration of about 4,300 people and a literacy programme, offset by Kirkuk protests, drone tensions in Baghdad and a PM takeover of intelligence.

en: Baghdad integrates about 4,300 people in Sinjar, a reconciliation step
Kirkuk protests over 12 demands, with no crackdown reported
Armed faction warns US over Iraqi airspace; drone tensions in Baghdad

summary.en: The period was mostly routine: Development Road and a $210 million housing contract offset local protests in Maysan, a drone interception that prompted a security meeting, and a radioactive source found in Babylon. Overall tone is slightly more negative than the world average, but no clear crisis appears in the headlines.

en: Drone interception prompted the prime minister to convene security agencies
Maysan protests renewed over reopening the Shaib crossing
Development Road expected to cut Europe trade time by 11 days

summary.en: The period is mixed: a $3 billion US-backed dollar injection, an 85% drop in armed clashes, and anti-corruption operations are offset by a fiscal deficit above $22 billion, fears of a regional strike involving Iran, and a negative news tone. Overall this looks like a routine period with no clear crisis or clear breakthrough.

en: US-Iran war tensions and fears of a strike on Iraq
$3 billion dollar injection to support the currency
Reported 85% drop in armed clashes

summary.en: The period mixes clear positives, including higher oil exports via Turkey, a central bank reserve jump, and a PKK pullback from Karaçok, with serious risks: fears of regional war spillover, a renewed Hormuz closure threat, a Basra crude price drop, and an unresolved salary dispute with Erbil. Protests over Kirkuk generator fees were answered with a fee cut, and the overall tone is more negative than the world average, so the score sits modestly above a routine day.

en: Oil exports via Turkey rise to 500,000 barrels a day
Central bank reserves jump by over 12 trillion dinars
PKK withdraws from Karaçok; control passes to Iraqi army and Peshmerga

summary.en: The period mixes serious strains: a US warning over disarming factions, fears of armed groups spiralling amid a renewed regional war, border closures, protests over generator prices in Kirkuk, and salary delays across Kurdistan. Positives include rising oil exports, a Chevron deal, an EU business forum, and anti-corruption arrests, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: US warning to Baghdad over disarming factions and fears of war
Salary delays hitting 91% of Kurdistan employees
Kirkuk protests over generator pricing and electricity crisis

summary.en: The period mixes economic and diplomatic positives (rising October oil exports, Bahrain partnership talks, gas financing plans, a new Baghdad museum) with serious stresses: an 11% drop in Basra crude, Iranian attacks on Kurdish groups in the north, and armed factions resisting disarmament. Overall the news flow is more negative than a typical day, but there is no clear crisis.

en: Basra crude fell 11%, a sharp economic shock
Iranian attacks on Kurdish military base and opposition groups
Armed factions refuse to hand over weapons after coalition exit

summary.en: Iraq faces serious external pressure as regional war fears on Iran grow, with Baghdad pledging not to let its territory be used for attacks and issuing a NOTAM. Domestic strain is also visible in the Kurdistan power-sharing collapse, a weak parliament, and rising living costs, partly offset by routine economic and infrastructure news.

en: Baghdad seeks to avoid regional war involving Iran and its militias
Kurdish ruling coalition breakdown as a party quits Kurdistan government
Iraq issues NOTAM amid fears of military operations

summary.en: Iraq faces serious pressure: fears of a US-Iran war prompted emergency planning, the Kurdistan Regional Government is in a political crisis after the PUK withdrew and threatened a parallel administration, and the dinar's devaluation is freezing markets. Some diplomatic efforts, such as the prime minister's contacts with Washington and the refusal to allow its territory to be used for strikes, partly offset this.

en: Risk of US-Iran war with Iraqi emergency military and civilian plans
PUK exit from Kurdistan government and threat of parallel administration
Dinar devaluation freezing markets and straining living costs

summary.en: Iraq faces mounting pressure over a possible US military strike on Iran and US demands to close Iran border crossings, alongside a stalled 2027 budget, a widening fiscal deficit, and a dollar-market freeze. Flood deaths and Kurdish-Baghdad tensions add strain, though positives such as OPEC production talks, growing electronic payments and a free hospital project limit the downgrade.

en: Threat of US strikes on Iran and pressure to close border crossings
Two years without annual budgets; 2027 budget stalled, investment frozen
Fiscal deficit concerns and dollar market freeze

summary.en: A drone attack halted production at the Khor Mor gas field, cutting about 2,800 MW of Kurdistan's power, and US pressure over Iran border crossings and war-plan reports raised security fears. Partial positives, including the start of Turkey's Zelkan base handover, a Turkey-Iraq security committee and Bahrain restoring its envoy, do not offset the energy and security shock.

en: Khor Mor gas field drone attack cuts about 2,800 MW of power
US demands Iraq close most Iran border crossings; war-fear reports
Turkey begins Zelkan handover and Iraq-Turkey security committee activates

summary.en: The period mixes positive steps, including Turkish troop withdrawal, reopened Iran border crossings, and returns of displaced families, with serious strains: a drone strike that knocked out the Khor Mor gas field and cut 2.8 GW of power, a 7% oil price fall, a large budget deficit, and a Kurdish party feud. The net effect is a below-typical day, though not a crisis.
summary.it: Il periodo combina passi positivi, tra cui il ritiro delle truppe turche, la riapertura dei valichi di frontiera con l'Iran e il ritorno di famiglie sfollate, con tensioni serie: un attacco con droni che ha messo fuori uso il giacimento di gas di Khor Mor e ha interrotto 2,8 GW di energia elettrica, un calo del 7% del prezzo del petrolio, un ampio disavanzo di bilancio e una faida tra partiti curdi. L'effetto netto è una giornata al di sotto della norma, ma non una crisi.
summary.ru: Период сочетает позитивные шаги, включая вывод турецких войск, возобновление работы пограничных переходов с Ираном и возвращение перемещённых семей, с серьёзными напряжениями: удар беспилотника, который вывел из строя газовое месторождение Хор-Мор и отключил 2,8 ГВт электроэнергии, падение цены на нефть на 7%, большой бюджетный дефицит и конфликт внутри курдской партии. В целом день ниже обычного, но это не кризис.
summary.ar: تجمع الفترة بين خطوات إيجابية، منها انسحاب القوات التركية وإعادة فتح المعابر الحدودية مع إيران وعودة أسر نازحة، وبين ضغوط خطيرة: ضربة بطائرة مسيّرة أوقفت حقل خور مور للغاز وقطعت 2.8 غيغاواط من الكهرباء، وانخفاض أسعار النفط بنسبة 7%، وعجز كبير في الموازنة، وخلاف داخل حزب كردي. وصافي الأثر يجعل اليوم أدنى من المعتاد، لكنه ليس أزمة.
summary.fa: این دوره ترکیبی از گام‌های مثبت، از جمله خروج نیروهای ترکیه، بازگشایی گذرگاه‌های مرزی با ایران و بازگشت خانواده‌های آواره، و فشارهای جدی است: حمله پهپادی که میدان گاز خور مور را از کار انداخت و 2.8 گیگاوات برق را قطع کرد، کاهش 7 درصدی قیمت نفت، کسری بزرگ بودجه، و اختلاف در یک حزب کرد. در مجموع روزی کمتر از حد معمول است، اما بحران نیست.
summary.zh: 该时段既有积极进展，包括土耳其撤军、伊朗边境口岸重新开放以及流离失所家庭陆续返回，也存在严峻压力：无人机袭击导致霍尔莫尔气田停产，切断2.8吉瓦电力；油价下跌7%；预算赤字较大；库尔德政党内部争斗。综合来看，这一天低于常态，但并非危机。
summary.ja: この期間には、トルコ軍の撤退、イランとの国境検問所の再開、避難していた家族の帰還といった前向きな動きがある一方で、深刻な圧力もみられる。ドローン攻撃によりKhor Morガス田が停止して2.8GWの電力が失われ、石油価格は7%下落し、財政赤字も大きく、クルド系政党間の対立も続いている。全体としては平均的な水準を下回る一日だが、危機とまではいえない。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 튀르키예 군 철수, 이란 국경 검문소 재개, 실향 가족의 귀환 등 긍정적 조치가 있는 한편, 드론 공격으로 Khor Mor 가스전이 가동 중단되어 2.8GW의 전력이 끊기고, 유가가 7% 하락했으며, 재정 적자가 크고, 쿠르드계 정당 간 갈등이 있는 등 심각한 부담 요인도 존재한다. 종합하면 평소보다 낮은 날이지만 위기는 아니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में सकारात्मक कदम और गंभीर दबाव दोनों हैं। सकारात्मक कदमों में तुर्की की सैन्य वापसी, ईरान की सीमा चौकियों का फिर से खुलना और विस्थापित परिवारों की वापसी शामिल है। दूसरी ओर, एक ड्रोन हमले से Khor Mor गैस क्षेत्र ठप हो गया और 2.8 GW बिजली कट गई, तेल की कीमत 7% गिरी, बजट घाटा बड़ा है, और कुर्द पार्टी में आपसी विवाद है। कुल मिलाकर यह सामान्य से कमज़ोर दिन है, हालांकि यह कोई संकट नहीं है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος συνδυάζει θετικά βήματα, όπως την απόσυρση τουρκικών στρατευμάτων, το ξανάνοιγμα των συνοριακών διαβάσεων με το Ιράν και την επιστροφή εκτοπισμένων οικογενειών, με σοβαρές πιέσεις: μια επίθεση με drone που έθεσε εκτός λειτουργίας το κοίτασμα αερίου Khor Mor και διέκοψε 2,8 GW ηλεκτρικής ενέργειας, πτώση της τιμής του πετρελαίου κατά 7%, ένα μεγάλο δημοσιονομικό έλλειμμα και μια διαμάχη μεταξύ κουρδικών κομμάτων. Συνολικά, πρόκειται για μια ημέρα κάτω του συνηθισμένου, χωρίς ωστόσο να αποτελεί κρίση.
summary.tr: Dönem, Türk askerlerinin çekilmesi, İran sınır kapılarının yeniden açılması ve yerinden edilmiş ailelerin geri dönüşü gibi olumlu adımları, ayrıca ciddi gerginlikleri bir arada içeriyor: Khor Mor gaz sahasını devre dışı bırakan ve 2,8 GW elektrik üretimini kesen bir insansız hava aracı saldırısı, %7'lik bir petrol fiyatı düşüşü, büyük bir bütçe açığı ve bir Kürt parti çekişmesi. Genel etki, tipik olanın altında bir gün olmakla birlikte bir kriz değil.
summary.es: El período combina pasos positivos, como la retirada de tropas turcas, la reapertura de los cruces fronterizos con Irán y el regreso de familias desplazadas, con tensiones serias: un ataque con drones que dejó fuera de servicio el yacimiento de gas de Khor Mor y cortó 2,8 GW de electricidad, una caída del 7 % en el precio del petróleo, un gran déficit presupuestario y una disputa entre partidos kurdos. El efecto neto es un día por debajo de lo habitual, aunque no una crisis.
summary.fr: La période mêle des avancées positives, notamment le retrait des troupes turques, la réouverture des postes frontaliers avec l'Iran et le retour de familles déplacées, à de sérieuses tensions : une frappe de drone qui a mis hors service le champ gazier de Khor Mor et coupé 2,8 GW d'électricité, une baisse de 7 % du prix du pétrole, un important déficit budgétaire et une querelle entre partis kurdes. L'effet net est une journée en deçà de la normale, sans toutefois constituer une crise.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum vereint positive Schritte, darunter den Abzug türkischer Truppen, die Wiedereröffnung der Grenzübergänge zum Iran und die Rückkehr vertriebener Familien, mit ernsthaften Belastungen: ein Drohnenangriff, der das Gasfeld Khor Mor außer Betrieb setzte und 2,8 GW Strom abschaltete, ein Rückgang des Ölpreises um 7 %, ein großes Haushaltsdefizit und eine Fehde innerhalb kurdischer Parteien. Insgesamt ist es ein unterdurchschnittlicher Tag, aber keine Krise.
summary.pt: O período combina passos positivos, como a retirada de tropas turcas, a reabertura das passagens de fronteira com o Irã e o retorno de famílias deslocadas, com tensões sérias: um ataque de drone que deixou fora de operação o campo de gás de Khor Mor e cortou 2,8 GW de energia, uma queda de 7% no preço do petróleo, um grande déficit orçamentário e uma disputa entre partidos curdos. O efeito líquido é um dia abaixo do normal, embora não uma crise.

Turkish troop withdrawal and Iran border crossings reopened
Budget deficit above 36 trillion dinars and oil price falling 7%

summary.en: In the last 24 hours, 408 people fell ill from contaminated water in Tshwane/Bronkhorstspruit. The rising cost of living and fuel pressure, the debate over the Eskom tariff increase, and the warning of losing AGOA also came to the fore. On the other side, there are positive developments such as Glencore's mining investment, the Durban marina project and Vodacom's network investment, and the GNU also survived a revolt within the ANC. The stock market fell by about 3.6% in one month, but the overall picture is not at crisis level and is slightly below normal.

en: 408 people fell ill from contaminated water in Bronkhorstspruit, and Tshwane's warning and chlorination efforts failed
Pressure from the cost of living and fuel prices, and reaction to the Eskom tariff increase
Warning to prepare for the loss of AGOA and uncertainty in relations with the United States
Investment news such as Glencore, Vodacom and the Durban marina
A 3.6% monthly decline on the stock market, with the tone of the news below average

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with several concrete problems: about 408 people fell ill from contaminated tap water near Pretoria, a shark attack closed beaches, and the country faces a loss of US trade benefits. Offsetting positives include Durban's 2,500-job superyacht marina plan, the return of families to Bishopscourt, and Meta's free AI training launch. The market is roughly flat, so the day sits slightly below an ordinary baseline.

en: 408 illnesses from unchlorinated tap water near Pretoria
Loss of US trade benefits looming for South Africa
Durban superyacht marina targeting 2,500 jobs

summary.en: The period mixes a serious public-health crisis (a water contamination outbreak sickening over 500 people) and anti-migrant intimidation that has reportedly driven large numbers of Zimbabweans to flee, alongside a cut to the growth forecast and a stock market decline. Some positive items, such as fuel levy cuts and an offshore asset plan, partly offset these.

en: Bronkhorstspruit water outbreak sickens over 500 residents

Growth forecast cut; All Share down 4.58% over a month

summary.en: The period mixes serious problems, including a mob killing of a foreign national during anti-immigrant tensions and water contamination outbreaks in several towns, with mild positives such as a new China export opportunity under zero tariffs and a R500m steel expansion. Markets slipped slightly and GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Mob killing of foreign national amid anti-immigrant tensions
Water contamination outbreaks and Bronkhorstspruit water crisis
Zero-tariff China export opportunity and Coega Steels expansion

summary.en: The period is mixed: routine service-delivery and municipal failures, water and power outages, and a mob killing of a foreign national drew attention, alongside modest positives such as Blue Flag retention and expanded export access. The All Share Index slipped slightly and news tone is somewhat more negative than the world average, so the score sits below an ordinary day.

en: Mob beat foreigner to death; anti-migrant violence coverage
Municipal failures, water crisis and power outages fuel voter anger

summary.en: The period mixes routine news with notable strains: a Tshwane water contamination crisis that sickened hundreds, Rand Water supply cuts, and Ebola preparedness measures. Positives include the BRICS summit opening, a cricket series draw, and a pre-election institutional rebuff of a party plea, while the All Share Index slipped slightly.

en: Foreign citizen beaten to death during anti-immigrant march
Tshwane water crisis and damning report on mayor

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious service-delivery stress: water outages and restrictions in Tshwane and Johannesburg, a fatal water scuffle, and continuing Durban unrest with criticism of the army and police. Partial offsets include positive bond-investor sentiment, an S&P view favourable to Sanlam's Santam buyout, and a flat stock market.

en: Durban unrest with army and police criticised
Tshwane and Joburg water restrictions and outages
Fatal scuffle for water in a family's home area

summary.en: South Africa's last 24 hours mix routine governance with notable strain: the President deployed 510 soldiers to KwaZulu-Natal after violence linked to an asylum ruling, and protests and corruption allegations surfaced. Offsetting this, the Pretoria tap water ban was lifted and the stock index was stable, and the news tone is more negative than the global average.

en: Army deployed to KwaZulu-Natal after asylum ruling violence
Corruption allegations against senior police officials in affidavit
SAMWU protests and court cases over municipal labour action

summary.en: A mixed but mostly routine day: warnings about municipal decay and possible greylisting, anti-immigrant violence concerns and a legal case sit alongside a stable stock index, rising salaries and new mining funding. Press tone is less negative than the global average, so the score stays near an ordinary day.

en: Business warnings that municipal collapse could risk greylisting

GDELT tone is less negative than the world average, but the one-day stock drop of 2.20% tempers the picture.

Reported election violence and minibus taxi violence
Attacks on foreign nationals and farm-attack controversy

en: Local government elections on 4 November; routine campaign and voting coverage

en: US moves to exclude South Africa from AGOA trade benefits

Markets were broadly flat and the news tone was more negative than average, so the score sits in the serious-problems range without reaching crisis levels.

en: US removal from AGOA trade benefits, with a 1 January exit date
Gauteng water crisis and service-failure concerns ahead of the vote
Low turnout and coalition uncertainty expected after local elections

en: All Share Index up 5.22% in one day
Municipal elections held with high turnout and orderly voting
Loss of AGOA trade access weighs on outlook

summary.en: Local government elections produced large losses for the ANC, with coalition talks and disputed results (such as the MK Party's call to freeze eThekwini results) moving through normal institutional channels. Markets were up over the week and month, though trade costs after the AGOA exit and weak corporate results weigh on the outlook.

en: ANC losses and coalition realignments in local elections, handled through normal channels
All Share Index up 4.76% over the week and 5.26% over the month

summary.en: South Africa's local government elections produced a historic setback for the ANC, with coalition talks and IEC recounts and objections proceeding through institutional channels. Markets rose over the week and month, though tone is negative and the political realignment carries uncertainty.

en: Local elections processed through IEC recounts and objections, with institutions functioning
ANC historic electoral setback and coalition negotiations ahead

summary.en: The period is dominated by the 2026 local election outcome, with the ANC at its lowest-ever vote share and hung councils forcing coalition talks, but the process is proceeding through normal institutional channels. The stock market rose over the week and tone is less negative than the global average, offset by deadly taxi clashes, a political shooting and the Numsa leadership dispute.

en: ANC worst-ever local election result; coalition negotiations underway

summary.en: Local election fallout dominates: the ANC's worst-ever result, coalition talks, and a brief highway shutdown by Soweto residents, alongside storm outages and a rise in unemployment to 33.7%. Institutions are functioning (courts, arrests, coalition negotiations) and the stock market rose 5.3% over the week, so the day reads as broadly ordinary despite the negative tone.
summary.ja: 地方選挙の余波が報道の中心となっている。与党ANCは史上最悪の得票結果となり、連立協議が続いている。ソウェトの住民による高速道路の一時封鎖も起きたほか、暴風雨による停電や、失業率が33.7%に上昇したことも伝えられている。裁判所、逮捕、連立交渉といった制度は機能しており、株式市場は週間で5.3%上昇したため、否定的な論調があるものの、この日は全体として概ね平常どおりの一日と読み取れる。
summary.ko: 지방선거 여파가 보도의 중심을 차지하고 있다. 집권당 ANC는 사상 최악의 선거 결과를 기록했으며 연정 협상이 진행 중이다. 소웨토 주민들의 고속도로 단기 점거와 폭풍으로 인한 정전, 실업률의 33.7%로의 상승도 함께 보도되었다. 법원, 체포, 연정 협상 등 제도는 정상적으로 작동하고 있으며, 주식시장은 한 주 동안 5.3% 상승해 부정적인 어조에도 불구하고 이날은 전반적으로 평범한 하루로 읽힌다.
summary.hi: स्थानीय चुनावों के नतीजों का असर ख़बरों पर हावी है: ANC का अब तक का सबसे खराब चुनावी प्रदर्शन, गठबंधन की बातचीत, और सोवेटो के निवासियों द्वारा कुछ समय के लिए हाईवे बंद किया जाना, साथ ही तूफ़ान से बिजली कटौती और बेरोज़गारी दर 33.7% तक बढ़ना। अदालतें, गिरफ़्तारियाँ और गठबंधन वार्ता जैसी संस्थाएँ सामान्य रूप से काम कर रही हैं, और सप्ताह भर में शेयर बाज़ार 5.3% चढ़ा, इसलिए नकारात्मक लहजे के बावजूद यह दिन मोटे तौर पर सामान्य लगता है।
summary.el: Τα αποτελέσματα των τοπικών εκλογών κυριαρχούν στην επικαιρότητα: το χειρότερο αποτέλεσμα ποτέ του ANC, οι διαπραγματεύσεις για συνασπισμό και ένα σύντομο κλείσιμο αυτοκινητόδρομου από κατοίκους του Σοβέτο, παράλληλα με διακοπές ρεύματος λόγω καταιγίδας και αύξηση της ανεργίας στο 33,7%. Οι θεσμοί λειτουργούν (δικαστήρια, συλλήψεις, διαπραγματεύσεις συνασπισμού) και το χρηματιστήριο ανέβηκε 5,3% μέσα στην εβδομάδα, οπότε η ημέρα φαίνεται γενικά συνηθισμένη παρά τον αρνητικό τόνο.
summary.it: Le ricadute delle elezioni locali dominano la scena: il peggior risultato di sempre dell'ANC, i negoziati per la formazione di una coalizione e un breve blocco autostradale da parte dei residenti di Soweto, insieme a interruzioni di corrente dovute a tempeste e a un aumento della disoccupazione al 33,7%. Le istituzioni funzionano (tribunali, arresti, negoziati di coalizione) e il mercato azionario è salito del 5,3% nel corso della settimana, quindi la giornata appare nel complesso ordinaria, nonostante il tono negativo.
summary.ru: Доминируют последствия местных выборов: худший в истории результат АНК, переговоры о коалиции и кратковременная блокировка шоссе жителями Соуэто, а также отключения электроэнергии из-за штормов и рост безработицы до 33,7%. Институты функционируют (суды, аресты, переговоры о коалиции), а фондовый рынок вырос на 5,3% за неделю, так что день в целом выглядит обычным, несмотря на негативный тон.
summary.ar: تهيمن تداعيات الانتخابات المحلية على المشهد: أسوأ نتيجة للمؤتمر الوطني الأفريقي في تاريخه، ومفاوضات تشكيل التحالفات، وإغلاق قصير للطريق السريع من قبل سكان سويتو، إلى جانب انقطاعات الكهرباء بسبب العواصف وارتفاع البطالة إلى 33.7%. تعمل المؤسسات بشكل طبيعي (المحاكم، والاعتقالات، ومفاوضات التحالف)، وارتفع مؤشر سوق الأسهم بنسبة 5.3% خلال الأسبوع، لذا يبدو اليوم عادياً إلى حد كبير رغم النبرة السلبية.
summary.fa: پیامدهای انتخابات محلی در صدر اخبار است: بدترین نتیجه تاریخی کنگره ملی آفریقا (ANC)، مذاکرات ائتلافی، و بستن کوتاه‌مدت بزرگراه توسط ساکنان سووِتو، و همچنین قطعی برق ناشی از طوفان و افزایش نرخ بیکاری به ۳۳٫۷ درصد. نهادها به کار خود ادامه می‌دهند (دادگاه‌ها، بازداشت‌ها، مذاکرات ائتلاف) و شاخص بازار سهام در طول هفته ۵٫۳ درصد افزایش یافته است، بنابراین با وجود لحن منفی، این روز به‌طور کلی عادی به نظر می‌رسد.
summary.zh: 地方选举的余波占据主导：非国大（ANC）创下有史以来最差的选举成绩，联合组阁谈判正在进行，索韦托居民短暂封锁高速公路，同时风暴导致停电，失业率升至33.7%。各机构运作正常（法院、逮捕、联合执政谈判），股市一周内上涨5.3%，因此尽管基调负面，这一天总体上仍属平常。
summary.tr: Yerel seçimlerin etkileri gündemi domine ediyor: ANC'nin tarihindeki en kötü sonucu, koalisyon görüşmeleri ve Soweto sakinlerinin kısa süreli bir otoyolu kapatması; buna fırtına kaynaklı elektrik kesintileri ve işsizliğin %33,7'ye yükselmesi eşlik ediyor. Kurumlar işlemeye devam ediyor (mahkemeler, tutuklamalar, koalisyon müzakereleri) ve borsa hafta boyunca %5,3 yükseldi; olumsuz tonua rağmen gün genel olarak olağan görünüyor.
summary.es: Las secuelas de las elecciones locales dominan la actualidad: el peor resultado de la historia del ANC, las negociaciones de coalición y un breve corte de la autopista por parte de residentes de Soweto, junto con cortes de energía por tormentas y un aumento del desempleo hasta el 33,7 %. Las instituciones funcionan (tribunales, arrestos, negociaciones de coalición) y la bolsa subió un 5,3 % durante la semana, por lo que el día resulta en general normal a pesar del tono negativo.
summary.fr: Les retombées des élections locales dominent l'actualité : le pire résultat de l'histoire de l'ANC, les négociations de coalition et une brève fermeture d'autoroute par des habitants de Soweto, ainsi que des coupures de courant liées aux tempêtes et une hausse du chômage à 33,7 %. Les institutions fonctionnent (tribunaux, arrestations, négociations de coalition) et la Bourse a progressé de 5,3 % sur la semaine, si bien que la journée paraît globalement ordinaire malgré le ton négatif.
summary.de: Die Nachwirkungen der Kommunalwahlen dominieren die Nachrichten: das schlechteste Ergebnis der ANC aller Zeiten, Koalitionsgespräche und eine kurzzeitige Blockade einer Autobahn durch Einwohner von Soweto, dazu Stromausfälle durch Unwetter und ein Anstieg der Arbeitslosigkeit auf 33,7 %. Die Institutionen funktionieren (Gerichte, Festnahmen, Koalitionsverhandlungen), und der Aktienmarkt legte im Wochenverlauf um 5,3 % zu, sodass der Tag trotz des negativen Tons insgesamt gewöhnlich wirkt.
summary.pt: As repercussões das eleições locais dominam a agenda: o pior resultado da história do ANC, as negociações de coalizão e um breve bloqueio de rodovia por moradores de Soweto, somados a apagões causados por tempestades e a alta do desemprego para 33,7%. As instituições seguem funcionando (tribunais, prisões, negociações de coalizão) e a bolsa subiu 5,3% na semana, de modo que o dia parece amplamente normal apesar do tom negativo.

summary.ja: 今回の期間は概ね平常通りで、主な動きは、2度の延期を経て2027年2月7日に議会選挙および地方選挙を定める大統領令の発出である。これは予定された諸機関に向けた手続き上の一歩である。マイナス要因としては、北部での地域的な電力配給制、首長の殺害、支援を必要とする避難民が挙げられ、これらによりスコアはほぼ中立にとどまっている。

summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य रही है, जिसका मुख्य घटनाक्रम दो पूर्व स्थगनों के बाद राष्ट्रपति के आदेश द्वारा 7 फ़रवरी 2027 को विधायी और नगरपालिका चुनावों का निर्धारण है, जो निर्धारित संस्थाओं की दिशा में एक प्रक्रियात्मक कदम है। नकारात्मक पहलुओं में उत्तर में स्थानीय स्तर पर बिजली की राशनिंग, एक प्रमुख की हत्या, और सहायता की ज़रूरत वाले विस्थापित लोग शामिल हैं, जिनके कारण स्कोर लगभग तटस्थ बना हुआ है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτίνα, με τη βασική εξέλιξη να είναι το προεδρικό διάταγμα που ορίζει τις βουλευτικές και δημοτικές εκλογές για τις 7 Φεβρουαρίου 2027, μετά από δύο προηγούμενες αναβολές, ένα διαδικαστικό βήμα προς τους προγραμματισμένους θεσμούς. Τα αρνητικά περιλαμβάνουν τον τοπικό περιορισμό της ηλεκτροδότησης στο Βορρά, τη δολοφονία ενός αρχηγού και εκτοπισμένους πολίτες που χρειάζονται βοήθεια, γεγονός που κρατά τη βαθμολογία κοντά στο ουδέτερο.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine. Lo sviluppo principale è il decreto presidenziale che fissa le elezioni legislative e comunali per il 7 febbraio 2027, dopo due precedenti rinvii, un passo procedurale verso istituzioni già programmate. Gli aspetti negativi includono il razionamento localizzato dell'elettricità nel Nord, l'uccisione di un capo e le persone sfollate che necessitano di aiuti, che mantengono il punteggio vicino alla neutralità.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный. Главным событием стал президентский указ, назначающий законодательные и муниципальные выборы на 7 февраля 2027 года после двух предыдущих переносов, — процедурный шаг к запланированным институтам. Негативные факторы включают локальное нормирование электроэнергии на Севере, убийство вождя и перемещённых лиц, нуждающихся в помощи, из-за чего оценка остаётся близкой к нейтральной.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها. وكان التطور الرئيسي مرسوماً رئاسياً يحدد الانتخابات التشريعية والبلدية في 7 فبراير 2027 بعد تأجيلين سابقين، وهي خطوة إجرائية نحو مؤسسات مقررة. وتشمل السلبيات ترشيداً محلياً للكهرباء في الشمال، ومقتل زعيم، وحاجة النازحين إلى المساعدة، مما يُبقي التقييم قريباً من الحياد.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً روال‌مند است. مهم‌ترین تحول، فرمان ریاست‌جمهوری برای برگزاری انتخابات قانون‌گذاری و شهرداری‌ها در 7 فوریه 2027 پس از دو تأخیر پیشین است؛ گامی رویه‌ای به سوی نهادهای برنامه‌ریزی‌شده. موارد منفی شامل جیره‌بندی برق در شمال، قتل یک رهبر محلی و آوارگانی که به کمک نیاز دارند است که امتیاز را نزدیک به خنثی نگه می‌دارد.
summary.zh: 此期间大体属于常规情况。主要进展是总统令将立法和市政选举定于2027年2月7日举行，此前已两次推迟，这是迈向既定机构的程序性步骤。负面因素包括北部地区局部实施电力配给、一名首领被杀，以及需要援助的流离失所者，使评分接近中性。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin seyrediyor; ana gelişme, iki kez önceden ertelendikten sonra yasama ve belediye seçimlerini 7 Şubat 2027'ye belirleyen cumhurbaşkanlığı kararnamesi ve planlanmış kurumlara yönelik usuli bir adım. Olumsuz unsurlar arasında Kuzey'de yerel elektrik kesintisi uygulaması, bir şefin öldürülmesi ve yardıma ihtiyaç duyan yerinden edilmiş insanlar yer alıyor; bunlar puanı nötr seviyeye yakın tutuyor.
summary.es: El período es en su mayoría rutinario; el principal avance es el decreto presidencial que fija las elecciones legislativas y municipales para el 7 de febrero de 2027 tras dos aplazamientos anteriores, un paso de procedimiento hacia las instituciones previstas. Entre los aspectos negativos figuran el racionamiento localizado de electricidad en el Norte, el asesinato de un jefe y personas desplazadas que necesitan ayuda, lo que mantiene la puntuación cerca de neutral.
summary.fr: La période est pour l'essentiel routinière, le principal fait nouveau étant le décret présidentiel fixant les élections législatives et municipales au 7 février 2027, après deux reports antérieurs, une étape procédurale vers des institutions programmées. Les éléments négatifs comprennent le rationnement localisé de l'électricité dans le Nord, l'assassinat d'un chef et des personnes déplacées ayant besoin d'aide, ce qui maintient le score près de la neutralité.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft überwiegend routinemäßig; die wichtigste Entwicklung ist das Präsidialdekret, das nach zwei früheren Verschiebungen die Parlaments- und Kommunalwahlen auf den 7. Februar 2027 festlegt, ein verfahrenstechnischer Schritt hin zu planmäßigen Institutionen. Negative Faktoren sind die lokal begrenzte Stromrationierung im Norden, die Tötung eines Stammesführers und Vertriebene, die auf Hilfe angewiesen sind, wodurch die Bewertung nahe am neutralen Wert bleibt.
summary.pt: O período é em grande parte rotineiro, sendo o principal desenvolvimento o decreto presidencial que fixa as eleições legislativas e municipais para 7 de fevereiro de 2027, após dois adiamentos anteriores, um passo processual rumo às instituições previstas. Os aspetos negativos incluem o racionamento localizado de eletricidade no Norte, o assassinato de um chefe e pessoas deslocadas que necessitam de ajuda, o que mantém a pontuação próxima do neutro.

summary.hi: कनाडा के पिछले 24 घंटे मुख्यतः सामान्य रहे: बजट का कार्यान्वयन, चीन-कनाडा आर्थिक संवाद, कुशल श्रमिकों के लिए एक नया आप्रवासन मार्ग, और प्रस्तावित क्लास-एक्शन समझौता, साथ ही एक तूफ़ान और वेनराइट में आग। TSX में एक दिन में 1.84% की बढ़त हुई और GDELT का लहजा हल्का सकारात्मक रहा, जो एक मध्यम रूप से सकारात्मक अवधि का संकेत देता है।
summary.el: Οι τελευταίες 24 ώρες στον Καναδά ήταν σε μεγάλο βαθμό συνηθισμένες: εφαρμογή του προϋπολογισμού, οικονομικός διάλογος Κίνας-Καναδά, νέα οδός μετανάστευσης για ειδικευμένους εργαζομένους και προτεινόμενη συμφωνία ομαδικής αγωγής, μαζί με μια καταιγίδα και μια πυρκαγιά στο Wainwright. Ο δείκτης TSX αυξήθηκε 1,84% μέσα σε μία ημέρα και ο τόνος του GDELT ήταν ελαφρώς θετικός, υποδεικνύοντας μια μετρίως θετική περίοδο.
summary.tr: Kanada'nın son 24 saati büyük ölçüde rutin geçti: bütçe uygulaması, Çin-Kanada ekonomik diyaloğu, vasıflı işçiler için yeni bir göç yolu ve önerilen bir toplu dava uzlaşması; bunların yanında bir fırtına ve Wainwright yangını yaşandı. TSX bir günde %1,84 yükseldi ve GDELT tonu hafifçe olumluydu; bu da dönemin ölçülü biçimde olumlu olduğuna işaret ediyor.
summary.es: Las últimas 24 horas de Canadá fueron en gran medida rutinarias: la aplicación del presupuesto, un diálogo económico China-Canadá, una nueva vía de inmigración para trabajadores cualificados y un acuerdo propuesto en una demanda colectiva, junto con una tormenta y un incendio en Wainwright. El TSX subió un 1,84 % en un día y el tono de GDELT fue levemente positivo, lo que apunta a un periodo moderadamente positivo.
summary.fr: Les dernières 24 heures au Canada ont été largement routinières : mise en œuvre du budget, dialogue économique Chine-Canada, nouvelle voie d'immigration pour les travailleurs qualifiés et projet de règlement d'un recours collectif, outre une tempête et un incendie à Wainwright. Le TSX a progressé de 1,84 % en une journée et le ton de GDELT était légèrement positif, ce qui indique une période modérément positive.
summary.de: Die letzten 24 Stunden in Kanada verliefen weitgehend routinemäßig: Umsetzung des Haushalts, ein chinesisch-kanadischer Wirtschaftsdialog, ein neuer Einwanderungsweg für Fachkräfte und ein vorgeschlagener Vergleich in einer Sammelklage, dazu ein Sturm und ein Feuer in Wainwright. Der TSX stieg an einem Tag um 1,84 %, und der GDELT-Ton war leicht positiv, was auf eine maßvoll positive Phase hindeutet.
summary.pt: As últimas 24 horas no Canadá foram em grande parte rotineiras: implementação do orçamento, um diálogo econômico Canadá-China, uma nova via de imigração para trabalhadores qualificados e um acordo proposto em ação coletiva, além de uma tempestade e um incêndio em Wainwright. O TSX subiu 1,84% no dia e o tom do GDELT foi levemente positivo, indicando um período moderadamente positivo.
summary.it: Le ultime 24 ore in Canada sono state in gran parte di routine: l'attuazione del bilancio, un dialogo economico Cina-Canada, un nuovo percorso di immigrazione per lavoratori qualificati e una proposta di accordo in un'azione collettiva, oltre a una tempesta e a un incendio a Wainwright. Il TSX è salito dell'1,84% in una giornata e il tono di GDELT è leggermente positivo, indicando un periodo moderatamente positivo.
summary.ru: Последние 24 часа в Канаде прошли в основном в обычном режиме: реализация бюджета, экономический диалог Китая и Канады, новый путь иммиграции для квалифицированных работников и предложенное мировое соглашение по коллективному иску, а также шторм и пожар в Уэйнрайте. Индекс TSX вырос на 1,84% за день, а тон GDELT был слегка позитивным, что указывает на умеренно позитивный период.
summary.ar: كانت الساعات الـ24 الأخيرة في كندا روتينية إلى حد كبير: تنفيذ الميزانية، وحوار اقتصادي بين الصين وكندا، ومسار هجرة جديد للعمال المهرة، واقتراح تسوية دعوى جماعية، إلى جانب عاصفة وحريق في وينرايت. وارتفع مؤشر TSX بنسبة 1.84% خلال يوم، وكانت نبرة GDELT إيجابية بشكل طفيف، مما يشير إلى فترة إيجابية باعتدال.
summary.fa: این ۲۴ ساعت گذشته در کانادا عمدتاً عادی بود: اجرای بودجه، گفتگوی اقتصادی چین و کانادا، مسیر جدید مهاجرت برای نیروی کار ماهر، و پیشنهاد تسویه دعوای گروهی، همراه با طوفان و آتش‌سوزی در ونرایت. شاخص TSX در یک روز ۱٫۸۴٪ رشد کرد و لحن GDELT اندکی مثبت بود که نشان‌دهنده دوره‌ای با گرایش مثبت معتدل است.
summary.zh: 加拿大过去24小时大体属于例行事务：预算执行、中加经济对话、面向技术工人的新移民途径，以及拟议的集体诉讼和解，同时还有一场风暴和温赖特的一起火灾。多伦多证券交易所综合指数单日上涨1.84%，GDELT语气略为积极，表明这一时期整体温和偏正面。

summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً به اخبار تجاری، زیرساختی و سرمایه‌گذاری اختصاص داشت، از جمله یک منطقه اداری ۳٫۲۷ میلیارد دلاری از امارco‌ امار و سرمایه‌گذاری جدید در حوزه بهداشت و درمان و رشد قوی شرکت‌های خارجی. ابوظبی همچنین میزبان مذاکرات سه‌جانبه دیپلماتیک درباره اوکراین بود، در حالی که بسته شدن یک ساحل به دلیل نفت و تعلیق برخی پروازهای هوایی از جمله نکات منفی کم‌اهمیت بودند.
summary.zh: 本时期的新闻以商业、基础设施和投资为主，包括Emaar价值32.7亿美元的办公区项目、新的医疗投资以及外资企业的强劲增长。阿布扎比还主办了关于乌克兰问题的三方外交会谈，而因石油污染关闭的一处海滩和部分航空公司停飞则是较小的负面消息。
summary.ja: 今回の期間は、ビジネス、インフラ、投資に関するニュースが中心で、32億7,000万ドル規模のエマールのオフィス地区、新たな医療分野への投資、外国企業の力強い成長などが含まれた。アブダビでは、ウクライナ問題をめぐる三者間の外交協議も開催された。一方、石油流出による海岸の閉鎖や一部航空会社の運航停止は、小規模なマイナス材料であった。
summary.ko: 이번 기간에는 비즈니스, 인프라 및 투자 관련 뉴스가 주를 이루었으며, 32억 7,000만 달러 규모의 에마르 오피스 지구, 새로운 의료 분야 투자, 외국 기업의 강한 성장세 등이 포함되었습니다. 아부다비는 우크라이나 관련 3자 외교 회담도 개최했습니다. 반면 기름 유출로 인한 해변 폐쇄와 일부 항공사 운항 중단은 사소한 부정적 요인이었습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में व्यापार, बुनियादी ढांचे और निवेश से जुड़ी खबरें प्रमुख रहीं, जिनमें 3.27 अरब डॉलर का एमार कार्यालय जिला, नया स्वास्थ्य सेवा निवेश और विदेशी कंपनियों की मजबूत वृद्धि शामिल थी। अबू धाबी ने यूक्रेन पर त्रिपक्षीय कूटनीतिक वार्ता की मेज़बानी भी की। तेल रिसाव के कारण एक समुद्र तट का बंद होना और कुछ एयरलाइनों की सेवाएं निलंबित होना मामूली नकारात्मक बिंदु थे।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριάρχησε από ειδήσεις για επιχειρήσεις, υποδομές και επενδύσεις, μεταξύ των οποίων ένα γραφειακό κέντρο της Emaar αξίας 3,27 δισ. δολαρίων, νέες επενδύσεις στην υγειονομική περίθαλψη και ισχυρή ανάπτυξη ξένων εταιρειών. Το Αμπού Ντάμπι φιλοξένησε επίσης τριμερείς διπλωματικές συνομιλίες για την Ουκρανία. Αρνητικά, αλλά δευτερεύοντος χαρακτήρα, ήταν το κλείσιμο μιας παραλίας λόγω πετρελαιοκηλίδας και ορισμένες αναστολές πτήσεων αερομεταφορέων.
summary.tr: Dönem, 3,27 milyar dolarlık Emaar ofis bölgesi, yeni sağlık yatırımı ve yabancı şirketlerdeki güçlü büyüme dahil olmak üzere iş dünyası, altyapı ve yatırım haberleriyle öne çıktı. Abu Dhabi ayrıca Ukrayna konusunda üçlü diplomatik görüşmelere ev sahipliği yaptı; bir plajın petrol nedeniyle kapatılması ve bazı havayolu seferlerinin askıya alınması ise küçük olumsuz gelişmeler oldu.
summary.es: El periodo estuvo dominado por noticias de negocios, infraestructura e inversión, entre ellas un distrito de oficinas de Emaar por 3.270 millones de dólares, nueva inversión sanitaria y un fuerte crecimiento de empresas extranjeras. Abu Dabi también acogió conversaciones diplomáticas trilaterales sobre Ucrania, mientras que el cierre de una playa por petróleo y la suspensión de algunas aerolíneas fueron aspectos negativos menores.
summary.fr: La période a été marquée par des actualités liées aux affaires, aux infrastructures et aux investissements, notamment un quartier de bureaux d'Emaar de 3,27 milliards de dollars, un nouvel investissement dans la santé et une forte croissance des entreprises étrangères. Abou Dhabi a également accueilli des discussions diplomatiques trilatérales sur l'Ukraine, tandis que la fermeture d'une plage en raison du pétrole et la suspension de certaines compagnies aériennes constituaient des points négatifs mineurs.
summary.de: Der Berichtszeitraum war vor allem von Nachrichten zu Wirtschaft, Infrastruktur und Investitionen geprägt, darunter ein Bürodistrikt von Emaar im Wert von 3,27 Milliarden US-Dollar, neue Investitionen im Gesundheitswesen und starkes Wachstum ausländischer Unternehmen. Abu Dhabi war außerdem Gastgeber trilateraler diplomatischer Gespräche zur Ukraine, während die Sperrung eines Strandes wegen Öl und einige Flugstreichungen geringere negative Entwicklungen waren.
summary.pt: O período foi dominado por notícias de negócios, infraestrutura e investimentos, incluindo um distrito de escritórios da Emaar de US$ 3,27 bilhões, novo investimento em saúde e forte crescimento de empresas estrangeiras. Abu Dhabi também sediou conversas diplomáticas trilaterais sobre a Ucrânia, enquanto o fechamento de uma praia por causa de petróleo e algumas suspensões de companhias aéreas foram aspectos negativos menores.
