summary.en: A mass-casualty attack by an Islamic State-affiliated group in Ménaka killed at least 48 civilians, dominating foreign coverage, and an ICT report warns that Bamako is no longer safe. Domestic media otherwise show routine news, including university progress and a fall in meat prices, which keeps the score above the crisis band.

en: Attack in Ménaka killed at least 48 civilians, widely reported
Reports that JNIM is shifting scale and threatening Bamako
Ongoing FAMa strikes and displaced-persons night patrols signal insecurity

summary.en: Mali's period was dominated by serious violence: reports of around 40 and 48 civilians killed in separate attacks, alleged abuses by the army and Africa Corps, and displacement in the centre. Routine economic, cultural and diplomatic news and a Senegal-ECOWAS rapprochement partly offset this, but the security situation weighs heavily.

en: Around 40 civilians killed by armed men in Ménaka region
Reported IS attack killing 48 civilians
Alleged army and Africa Corps abuses reported by foreign media

summary.en: Mali's coverage is mostly routine: budget and infrastructure work, a justice protocol with Morocco, and cautious regional dialogue. Offsetting this, there is a Kidal military escalation, HRW reports of abuses by the army and Africa Corps, and new citizenship-stripping sanctions against people deemed hostile to the state.

en: Kidal military pressure and airstrikes escalate
HRW reports army and Africa Corps abuses
Citizenship-stripping sanctions for hostile acts validated

summary.en: Mali's period mixes security strain, including an extended curfew in Koulikoro, a widened nationality-stripping law, and allegations of army and Africa Corps civilian abuses. Routine positives include H1 gold output of 23.5 t, lithium sector news, and a budget revision passed by parliament. GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Koulikoro curfew extended to 20 November amid security concerns
Nationality-stripping law expanded to Malians of origin
Allegations of army and Africa Corps civilian killings and abuses

summary.en: A jihadist attack attributed to IS Sahel killed 54 civilians in Ménaka, a serious security shock, though government and army activity and routine economic and social news continued. The negative tone is consistent with the massacre, which outweighs the otherwise ordinary administrative news.

en: 54 civilians killed in Tagadayat (Ménaka) attack
Army airstrikes on militant positions in Ménaka, Mopti, Ségou
Budget settlement shows revenues above forecasts

summary.en: Mali's period is dominated by a deadly Islamic State attack on camps that left 54 dead, plus reports of a rebellion and the army's 'carnage' at Moura, which points to serious ongoing insecurity. Routine development news (solar plant, vaccination drive, Russia-Africa summit travel) and a GDELT tone less negative than the world average partly offset this.

en: IS attacks on camps over weekend, 54 dead
Rebellion and clashes reported at Moura
Routine development and solar-energy projects announced

summary.en: The period is dominated by serious violence: the discovery of 54 bodies after attacks in Ménaka, an army and Russian-linked strike reported to have killed at least 13 people, and a national rights commission condemning the killings. Partial positives such as a 30% rise in gold output, budget and electoral-list routine, and secured fuel convoys do not offset the security crisis, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: 54 bodies found after ISGS attacks in Ménaka
Reported army and Russian-linked attack killing at least 13
CNDH condemns killings and calls for investigations

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and development news, including a fuel convoy arriving in Bamako, a 100 MW solar project step, and ten laws adopted by the CNT, with some serious negatives. These include a drone strike reported to have killed 13 civilians in Timbuktu, school closures under armed threat in Banamba, and a ten-year sentence for the former Bamako mayor. The overall tone is slightly more negative than the world average.

en: Drone strike reported to have killed 13 civilians in Timbuktu region
Two schools closed in Banamba under armed threat
Fuel convoy of 1,107 tankers arrives in Bamako

summary.en: The period mixes routine economic and social news (a KAMAZ industrial contract, a Qatar education partnership, the 2027 budget) with a serious security picture: a reported drone strike that activists say killed 13 civilians, and a claimed army recapture of Kidal. Detained pro-democracy activists being brought to court after nearly six months and a university strike add to the strain on institutions, so the score sits below an ordinary day.

en: Activists say a drone strike killed 13 civilians
Reported army recapture of Kidal amid jihadist threat
Pro-democracy activists presented to court after six months' detention

summary.en: Mali's day mixes diplomatic and economic activity, including the Russia-Africa summit and mining and cartography agreements with Russia, with serious security and rights concerns. These include a reported forced disappearance of a junta critic, killings and disappearances in Bamako, clashes near Djenné, and a surge of displaced people in Macina.

en: Forced disappearance of junta critic reported by foreign media
Dozo-jihadist clashes near Djenné and displacement of 3,200 in Macina
Russia-Africa summit and new Russian mining agreements

summary.en: Mali's period is dominated by serious problems: a junta critic reported forcibly disappeared, a worsening humanitarian situation, a US entry ban, a higher-education strike, an extended curfew and reports of livestock killings. Positive items such as Russia-Africa and Russia-Mali economic cooperation, cybersecurity events and army strikes on militants are routine by comparison, and GDELT tone is slightly less negative than the world average.

en: Critic of junta reported forcibly disappeared for six months
Humanitarian situation worsening amid underfunding and US entry ban
Higher-education strike and curfew extension in Koutiala

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with a strategic Mali-Russia summit at the Kremlin, a secured fuel convoy of 596 tankers reaching Bamako, and new academic and youth-sport cooperation. GDELT tone (+0.31 against a world average of -0.84) supports a modestly positive reading, with no crisis or crackdown in the headlines.

en: Secured 596-tanker fuel convoy delivered to Bamako
Strategic Kremlin meeting between Goïta and Putin
Academic cooperation agreement with a Russian university

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: Mali's Russia-Africa summit diplomacy and Russia partnership news sit alongside ongoing counter-terror operations. Negatives include a series of Bamako killings, a deadly mining-site accident and an unresolved 2013 murder case, and the GDELT tone is more negative than the world average.

en: Russia-Africa summit and Goïta-Putin partnership coverage
FAMa counter-terror operation neutralising mobile cells
Series of murders reported in Bamako

summary.en: Domestic media report mostly routine development, social-cohesion and administrative news. Foreign coverage stresses the unresolved abduction of opposition figure Mountaga Tall, the murder of a nurse, and displacement strain in Macina, which keeps the score below a normal day.

en: Mountaga Tall abduction unresolved after six months, with NGO and rights criticism
Displaced people overwhelming Macina after an influx from Souleye
Routine development and social-stability news: hospital construction, social pact, Bamako Document

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: local development, health and solidarity initiatives, and police and gendarmerie arrests. Counterterrorism strikes continue, and NGOs press for information on the six-month abduction of opposition figure Mountaga Tall, so the score sits below a typical day.

en: Ongoing military strikes against militants in north and centre
NGOs demand answers on opposition figure Mountaga Tall's abduction
Routine development, health and solidarity initiatives and anti-crime arrests

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance and economic items (IMF technical assistance, ECOWAS electrification, mining results) with security operations and strain from thousands of returnees expelled from Guinea. The GDELT tone is mildly positive, but the missing-opposition-leader story and the migration pressure offset it, so the net picture is close to an ordinary day.

en: Thousands of returnees from Guinea strain Kouremalé and Bamako
Army strikes on terrorist bases reported near Koro and Gourma-Rharous
Pressure on Mali over missing opposition leader and son

summary.en: Coverage is mostly routine: state-media reports of donations, official visits, a forum and a corruption ruling with repayment ordered. Humanitarian strain from displacement in Macina and Ménaka and crop losses from uneven rains weigh slightly against these.

en: Court ruling in Sidi Sosso Diarra corruption case, with repayment ordered
Displacement and rising humanitarian needs in Macina and Ménaka
Influx of returning miners and repatriation arrangements with Guinea and Burkina Faso

summary.en: The period mixes routine governance, Sahel alliance meetings and security operations against armed groups with a humanitarian strain from roughly 80,000 people crossing from Guinea, including expelled miners. Overall the news reads as an ordinary day with some pressure, so the score sits near the baseline.

en: Roughly 80,000 people crossed from Guinea, straining humanitarian capacity
FAMa operations destroyed terrorist bases in Koro, Sandaré and Sofara

summary.en: Mali's period is mostly routine government business, including budget increases for hospitals and a fuel convoy reaching Bamako. The main strain is the humanitarian response to mass expulsions of gold miners from Guinea, which foreign outlets describe as a catastrophe with six reported deaths, though the government is mobilising transport and aid.

en: Mass expulsion of gold miners from Guinea, with reported deaths
Government mobilising trucks, buses and aid for returnees
Budget increase of 125 billion FCFA for hospitals

summary.en: Mali faces a large humanitarian strain from the forced return of roughly 160,000 people from Guinea, with around 17,000 moved to Burkina Faso and shelter needs in Bamako. Partly offset by organised state and civil response, Algerian reconciliation diplomacy and AES cooperation, but military operations and detention-abuse allegations weigh on the score.

en: Mass expulsion of about 160,000 people from Guinea strains border and shelters
Allegations of deaths and abuse in Sébénicoro detention reported by former detainee
Organised state and civil relief response to returnees in Kouremalé and Bamako

summary.en: Mali's period mixes routine diplomacy, defence and development news with a serious humanitarian strain: roughly 160,000 people expelled from Guinea, several deaths among returnees, and a suicide attack. Ongoing military operations in Ménaka and Kidal add security pressure, though no institutional breakdown appears in the headlines.
summary.it: Il quadro del Mali unisce notizie di routine su diplomazia, difesa e sviluppo a una grave emergenza umanitaria: circa 160.000 persone espulse dalla Guinea, diversi decessi tra i rimpatriati e un attentato suicida. Le operazioni militari in corso a Ménaka e Kidal aumentano la pressione sul fronte della sicurezza, anche se nei titoli non compaiono segnali di crollo istituzionale.
summary.ru: Период в Мали сочетает рутинные новости о дипломатии, обороне и развитии с серьёзным гуманитарным кризисом: около 160 000 человек выдворены из Гвинеи, несколько человек погибли среди возвращающихся, произошёл теракт-самоубийство. Продолжающиеся военные операции в Менаке и Кидале усиливают давление в сфере безопасности, однако в заголовках не видно признаков институционального краха.
summary.ar: تجمع فترة مالي بين أخبار روتينية عن الدبلوماسية والدفاع والتنمية، وأزمة إنسانية خطيرة: طرد نحو 160,000 شخص من غينيا، ووفاة عدة أشخاص بين العائدين، وهجوم انتحاري. وتزيد العمليات العسكرية الجارية في منكا وكيدال الضغط الأمني، رغم أن العناوين لا تشير إلى انهيار مؤسسي.
summary.fa: دورهٔ اخیر مالی ترکیبی از اخبار معمول دیپلماسی، دفاع و توسعه با یک بحران انسانی جدی است: اخراج حدود ۱۶۰٬۰۰۰ نفر از گینه، مرگ چند نفر در میان بازگشتگان و یک حملهٔ انتحاری. عملیات نظامی جاری در منکا و کیدال فشار امنیتی را افزایش می‌دهد، هرچند در تیترها نشانه‌ای از فروپاشی نهادی دیده نمی‌شود.
summary.zh: 马里近期局势既有外交、国防和发展方面的例行新闻，也面临严峻的人道主义压力：约16万人被驱逐出几内亚，返回者中有数人死亡，并发生一起自杀式袭击。梅纳卡和基达尔正在进行的军事行动加剧了安全压力，但标题中并未出现体制崩溃的迹象。
summary.tr: Mali'nin bu dönemi, rutin diplomasi, savunma ve kalkınma haberleriyle birlikte ciddi bir insani baskıyı bir arada barındırıyor: Gine'den sınır dışı edilen yaklaşık 160.000 kişi, geri dönenler arasında birkaç ölüm ve bir intihar saldırısı. Ménaka ve Kidal'de süren askeri operasyonlar güvenlik baskısını artırıyor, ancak manşetlerde herhangi bir kurumsal çöküş görünmüyor.
summary.es: El periodo de Malí combina noticias habituales de diplomacia, defensa y desarrollo con una grave presión humanitaria: unas 160.000 personas expulsadas de Guinea, varias muertes entre los repatriados y un atentado suicida. Las operaciones militares en curso en Ménaka y Kidal aumentan la presión de seguridad, aunque los titulares no reflejan ninguna quiebra institucional.
summary.fr: La période au Mali mêle actualités courantes de diplomatie, de défense et de développement à une grave pression humanitaire : quelque 160 000 personnes expulsées de Guinée, plusieurs décès parmi les rapatriés et un attentat suicide. Les opérations militaires en cours à Ménaka et à Kidal ajoutent une pression sécuritaire, bien que les gros titres ne fassent état d'aucune rupture institutionnelle.
summary.de: Die Berichterstattung über Mali in diesem Zeitraum umfasst routinemäßige Nachrichten zu Diplomatie, Verteidigung und Entwicklung, verbunden mit einer ernsten humanitären Belastung: rund 160.000 aus Guinea ausgewiesene Menschen, mehrere Todesfälle unter Rückkehrern und ein Selbstmordanschlag. Laufende Militäroperationen in Ménaka und Kidal erhöhen den Sicherheitsdruck, doch in den Schlagzeilen zeigt sich kein institutioneller Zusammenbruch.
summary.pt: O período do Mali combina notícias rotineiras de diplomacia, defesa e desenvolvimento com uma grave pressão humanitária: cerca de 160.000 pessoas expulsas da Guiné, várias mortes entre os repatriados e um ataque suicida. As operações militares em curso em Ménaka e Kidal acrescentam pressão à segurança, embora as manchetes não indiquem qualquer colapso institucional.
summary.ja: マリの情勢は、外交、国防、開発に関する通常のニュースと、深刻な人道的圧迫が入り混じっています。ギニアから約16万人が追放され、帰還者の間で複数の死者が出ているほか、自爆攻撃も発生しました。メナカとキダルでは軍事作戦が続いており治安上の圧力が加わっていますが、見出しからは制度的な機能不全は見られません。
summary.ko: 마리의 최근 상황은 일상적인 외교, 국방, 개발 관련 뉴스와 심각한 인도적 부담이 뒤섞여 있습니다. 기니에서 약 16만 명이 추방되었고 귀환자 중 여러 명이 사망했으며 자살 공격도 발생했습니다. 메나카와 키달에서는 군사 작전이 계속되면서 안보 압박이 더해지고 있으나, 헤드라인에서는 제도적 붕괴의 징후는 나타나지 않습니다.
summary.hi: माली की स्थिति में नियमित कूटनीति, रक्षा और विकास से जुड़ी खबरों के साथ गंभीर मानवीय दबाव भी शामिल है: गिनी से लगभग 1,60,000 लोगों को निष्कासित किया गया, लौटने वालों में कई मौतें हुईं और एक आत्मघाती हमला हुआ। मेनाका और किदाल में जारी सैन्य अभियानों से सुरक्षा दबाव बना हुआ है, हालांकि सुर्खियों में किसी संस्थागत विघटन का संकेत नहीं मिलता।
summary.el: Η περίοδος του Μάλι συνδυάζει συνηθισμένα νέα διπλωματίας, άμυνας και ανάπτυξης με σοβαρή ανθρωπιστική πίεση: περίπου 160.000 άνθρωποι εκδιώχθηκαν από τη Γουινέα, σημειώθηκαν αρκετοί θάνατοι μεταξύ των επιστρεφόντων και ένα επίθεση αυτοκτονίας. Οι συνεχιζόμενες στρατιωτικές επιχειρήσεις στο Μενάκα και στο Κιντάλ προσθέτουν πίεση στην ασφάλεια, ωστόσο από τα επικεφαλίδες δεν προκύπτει κάποια θεσμική κατάρρευση.

summary.fa: روزی عمدتاً معمولی: پارلمان با 145 رأی به دولت اعتماد داد و موریتانی با عربستان سعودی توافقنامه‌ای برای سازماندهی حج امضا کرد؛ همچنین اخباری درباره توسعه و تأمین مالی منتشر شد. از موارد منفی می‌توان به استعفای یک نماینده با ادعای فساد، آتش‌سوزی در سوموئیل و تنش با الجزایر اشاره کرد، اما این‌ها بحران مشخصی نیستند.
summary.zh: 总体上属于平常的一天：议会以145票通过对政府的信任投票，毛里塔尼亚与沙特阿拉伯签署了朝觐组织协议，同时还有发展和融资方面的消息。负面消息包括一名议员以腐败指控辞职、Somoil公司发生火灾，以及与阿尔及利亚的紧张关系，但这些并不构成明显的危机。

Artículos de opinión locales plantean preocupaciones por tensiones democráticas antes de una elección presidencial, y una investigación sobre drogas que llevó a 11 detenciones mantiene la puntuación solo ligeramente por encima de un día ordinario.
summary.fr: La période au Cap-Vert est en grande partie routinière, avec une déclaration du FMI sur la stabilité économique et un ton positif selon GDELT. Des articles d'opinion locaux soulèvent des inquiétudes quant aux tensions démocratiques à l'approche d'une élection présidentielle, et une enquête sur le trafic de drogue ayant conduit à 11 arrestations maintient le score seulement légèrement au-dessus d'une journée ordinaire.
summary.de: Die Lage in Kap Verde verläuft größtenteils routinemäßig: Der IWF hat sich zur wirtschaftlichen Stabilität geäußert, und der GDELT-Tonwert ist positiv. Lokale Meinungsbeiträge äußern vor einer Präsidentschaftswahl Bedenken wegen demokratischer Spannungen, und eine Drogenermittlung mit 11 Festnahmen hält den Wert nur leicht über dem eines gewöhnlichen Tages.
summary.pt: O período em Cabo Verde é, em grande parte, rotineiro, com uma declaração do FMI sobre a estabilidade económica e um tom positivo no GDELT. Artigos de opinião locais levantam preocupações com tensões democráticas antes de uma eleição presidencial, e uma investigação sobre drogas que resultou em 11 detenções mantém a pontuação apenas ligeiramente acima de um dia comum.
summary.it: Il periodo di Capo Verde è per lo più di routine, con una dichiarazione del FMI sulla stabilità economica e un tono positivo di GDELT. Alcuni articoli d'opinione locali sollevano preoccupazioni sulle tensioni democratiche in vista di un voto presidenziale, e un'indagine sul traffico di droga ha portato a 11 arresti, il che mantiene il punteggio solo moderatamente superiore a quello di una giornata ordinaria.
summary.ru: Период на Кабо-Верде в основном рутинный: заявление МВФ о стабильности экономики и позитивный тон по данным GDELT. Местные аналитические материалы поднимают вопросы о напряжённости в сфере демократии накануне президентских выборов, а расследование в отношении наркотиков привело к 11 арестам, что делает показатель лишь немного выше обычного дня.
summary.ar: تتسم الفترة في الرأس الأخضر بطابع روتيني في معظمها، مع بيان من صندوق النقد الدولي بشأن الاستقرار الاقتصادي ونبرة إيجابية وفق بيانات GDELT. وتثير مقالات رأي محلية مخاوف بشأن التوترات الديمقراطية قبيل الانتخابات الرئاسية، كما أدى تحقيق في قضايا المخدرات إلى 11 حالة اعتقال، ما يجعل الدرجة أعلى قليلاً فقط من يوم عادي.

summary.zh: 佛得角此期间大多属于例行情况：国际货币基金组织发表了关于经济稳定的声明，GDELT情感倾向为正面。当地评论文章在总统选举前提出了民主紧张局势的担忧，一起毒品调查导致11人被捕，因此评分仅略高于普通日子。
summary.ja: カーボベルデのこの期間は概ね平常通りで、経済の安定についての IMF の声明があり、GDELT のトーンはポジティブです。地元の論説は大統領選挙を前に民主主義の緊張への懸念を提起しており、麻薬捜査で11人が逮捕されたことから、スコアは通常の一日よりわずかに高い程度にとどまっています。
summary.ko: 카보베르데의 이 기간은 대체로 일상적인 흐름이며, 경제 안정에 관한 IMF 성명이 있고 GDELT 어조는 긍정적입니다. 현지 오피니언 기사들은 대통령 선거를 앞두고 민주주의 긴장에 대한 우려를 제기하고 있으며, 마약 수사로 11명이 체포되어 점수는 평범한 하루보다 조금 높은 수준에 머물러 있습니다.
summary.hi: केप वर्डे की यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य है, जिसमें आर्थिक स्थिरता पर आईएमएफ़ का बयान है और GDELT का स्वर सकारात्मक है। स्थानीय विचार-लेखों में राष्ट्रपति चुनाव से पहले लोकतांत्रिक तनाव को लेकर चिंताएँ उठाई गई हैं, और एक नशीली दवाओं की जाँच में 11 गिरफ़्तारियाँ हुई हैं, जिससे स्कोर एक सामान्य दिन से केवल थोड़ा ही ऊपर रहता है।

Τοπικά άρθρα γνώμης εγείρουν ανησυχίες για δημοκρατικές εντάσεις ενόψει των προεδρικών εκλογών, ενώ έρευνα για ναρκωτικά οδήγησε σε 11 συλλήψεις, γεγονός που διατηρεί τη βαθμολογία μόνο ελαφρώς πάνω από μια συνηθισμένη ημέρα.

summary.en: The Houthis are carrying out missile and similar attacks against Saudi Arabia. Regional tensions are keeping oil prices near a five-month high, while economic investment news and diplomatic initiatives continue. Nevertheless, attacks targeting the capital, the postponement of the Future Investment Initiative, and the execution of two Bangladeshi nationals are significantly lowering the diplomatic tension score.

summary.ja: 期間中はリヤドとアラムコの施設、東西パイプラインに対するフーシ派のミサイルおよびドローン攻撃が中心となり、首都では爆発音が聞かれた。背景には地域のイラン紛争がある。防空システムにより大半の飛翔体は迎撃されたほか、経済指標(工業生産の回復、アラムコの売上増、建設業の成長)は引き続きプラスであったため、スコアは戦争区分ではなく深刻な問題区分にとどまる。
summary.ko: 이 기간에는 리야드, 아람코 시설 및 동서 송유관을 겨냥한 후티 반군의 미사일 및 드론 공격이 주를 이루었으며, 수도에서 폭발음이 들렸다. 배경에는 지역적인 이란 분쟁이 있었다. 방공망이 대부분의 발사체를 요격했고, 경제 지표(산업 생산 반등, 아람코 매출 증가, 건설 성장)는 여전히 긍정적이어서 점수는 전쟁 구간이 아닌 심각한 문제 구간에 머물렀다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में रियाद, एक अरामको सुविधा और एक पूर्व-पश्चिम पाइपलाइन पर हूती मिसाइल और ड्रोन हमले प्रमुख रहे, और राजधानी में विस्फोट सुने गए। पृष्ठभूमि में एक क्षेत्रीय ईरान संघर्ष है। वायु रक्षा प्रणालियों ने अधिकांश प्रक्षेप्यों को रोक दिया, और आर्थिक आँकड़े (औद्योगिक उत्पादन में सुधार, अरामको राजस्व वृद्धि, निर्माण वृद्धि) सकारात्मक बने रहे, इसलिए स्कोर युद्ध श्रेणी के बजाय गंभीर समस्याओं की श्रेणी में रहता है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από πυραυλικές και drone επιθέσεις των Χούθι κατά του Ριάντ, μιας εγκατάστασης της Aramco και ενός αγωγού ανατολής-δύσης, με εκρήξεις να ακούγονται στην πρωτεύουσα και μια περιφερειακή σύγκρουση με το Ιράν στο παρασκήνιο. Τα αντιαεροπορικά συστήματα αναχαίτισαν τα περισσότερα βλήματα, ενώ τα οικονομικά στοιχεία (ανάκαμψη της βιομηχανικής παραγωγής, αύξηση των εσόδων της Aramco, ανάπτυξη των κατασκευών) παρέμειναν θετικά, γι' αυτό η βαθμολογία βρίσκεται στη ζώνη σοβαρών προβλημάτων και όχι στη ζώνη πολέμου.
summary.tr: Husi füzе ve insansız hava aracı saldırıları Riyad, bir Aramco tesisi ve doğu-batı boru hattı etrafında bu dönemi belirlerken, başkentte patlamalar duyulmuş ve arka planda bölgesel bir İran çatışması sürmektedir. Hava savunma sistemleri mermilerin çoğunu önlemiş; ekonomik veriler (sanayi üretiminde toparlanma, Aramco gelirlerinde artış, inşaat büyümesi) pozitif kalmıştır, bu nedenle puan savaş kategorisi yerine ciddi sorunlar kategorisinde yer almaktadır.
summary.es: Los ataques con misiles y drones de los hutíes contra Riad, una instalación de Aramco y un oleoducto este-oeste dominan el periodo, con explosiones oídas en la capital y un conflicto regional con Irán de fondo. Las defensas aéreas interceptaron la mayoría de los proyectiles, y los datos económicos (repunte de la producción industrial, crecimiento de los ingresos de Aramco, crecimiento de la construcción) siguieron siendo positivos, por lo que la puntuación se sitúa en la franja de problemas graves y no en la de guerra.
summary.fr: Les attaques de missiles et de drones houthis contre Riyad, une installation d'Aramco et un oléoduc est-ouest dominent la période, des explosions ayant été entendues dans la capitale sur fond de conflit régional avec l'Iran. Les défenses aériennes ont intercepté la plupart des projectiles, et les données économiques (reprise de la production industrielle, croissance des revenus d'Aramco, croissance de la construction) sont restées positives ; le score se situe donc dans la tranche des problèmes graves et non dans celle de la guerre.
summary.de: Raketen- und Drohnenangriffe der Huthi auf Riad, eine Anlage von Aramco und eine Ost-West-Pipeline prägen den Zeitraum; in der Hauptstadt waren Explosionen zu hören, im Hintergrund steht ein regionaler Konflikt mit dem Iran. Die Luftverteidigung fing die meisten Geschosse ab, und die Wirtschaftsdaten (Erholung der Industrieproduktion, Umsatzwachstum bei Aramco, Wachstum im Bau) blieben positiv, weshalb der Wert eher in das Band ernster Probleme als in das Kriegsband fällt.
summary.pt: Ataques com mísseis e drones dos houthis contra Riad, uma instalação da Aramco e um oleoduto leste-oeste dominam o período, com explosões ouvidas na capital e um conflito regional com o Irã ao fundo. As defesas aéreas interceptaram a maioria dos projéteis, e os dados econômicos (recuperação da produção industrial, crescimento da receita da Aramco, crescimento da construção) permaneceram positivos, por isso a pontuação situa-se na faixa de problemas graves e não na de guerra.
summary.it: Attacchi di missili e droni Houthi contro Riyadh, un impianto di Aramco e un oleodotto est-ovest dominano il periodo, con esplosioni udite nella capitale e un conflitto regionale con l'Iran sullo sfondo. Le difese aeree hanno intercettato la maggior parte dei proiettili e i dati economici (ripresa della produzione industriale, crescita dei ricavi di Aramco, crescita delle costruzioni) sono rimasti positivi, quindi il punteggio si colloca nella fascia dei problemi gravi piuttosto che in quella di guerra.
summary.ru: Ракетные и беспилотные атаки хуситов на Эр-Рияд, объект Aramco и трубопровод «восток–запад» доминируют в этот период, при этом взрывы были слышны в столице на фоне регионального конфликта с Ираном. Системы ПВО перехватили большую часть снарядов, а экономические данные (восстановление промышленного производства, рост выручки Aramco, рост строительства) оставались положительными, поэтому оценка находится в диапазоне серьёзных проблем, а не войны.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة هجمات بالصواريخ والطائرات المسيّرة من الحوثيين على الرياض ومنشأة تابعة لأرامكو وخط أنابيب شرق-غرب، مع سماع انفجارات في العاصمة وخلفية من الصراع الإقليمي مع إيران. اعترضت الدفاعات الجوية معظم المقذوفات، وظلت المؤشرات الاقتصادية (انتعاش الإنتاج الصناعي، ونمو إيرادات أرامكو، ونمو قطاع البناء) إيجابية، لذا يقع التقييم ضمن نطاق المشكلات الخطيرة لا نطاق الحرب.
summary.fa: حملات موشکی و پهپادی حوثی‌ها به ریاض، یک تأسیسات آرامکو و خط لوله شرق‌به‌غرب، بر این دوره سایه افکنده و صداهای انفجار در پایتخت شنیده شده است و درگیری منطقه‌ای با ایران در پس‌زمینه قرار دارد. سامانه‌های پدافند هوایی بیشتر پرتابه‌ها را رهگیری کرده‌اند و داده‌های اقتصادی (بهبود تولید صنعتی، رشد درآمد آرامکو، رشد ساختمان‌سازی) مثبت باقی مانده‌اند، از این رو امتیاز در محدوده مشکلات جدی قرار می‌گیرد نه محدوده جنگ.
summary.zh: 胡塞武装对利雅得、一处阿美石油设施及东西向输油管道发动的导弹和无人机袭击主导了这一时期，首都有爆炸声传出，背景是地区性的伊朗冲突。防空系统拦截了大部分来袭弹药，经济数据（工业产出回升、沙特阿美收入增长、建筑业增长）保持正向，因此评分处于严重问题区间而非战争区间。

summary.ko: 이번 기간 시에라리온의 뉴스는 일상적인 협력 및 개발 관련 사안이 주를 이루고 있습니다. 2027년까지 생체인식 신원확인 수용을 약속한 ECOWAS 프리타운 선언, EU와 세계식량계획(WFP)의 학교 급식 데이터 시스템 지원, 중국 의료진의 보건 활동, 그리고 모로코, 인도, 부르키나파소와의 양자 간 협의가 보도되었습니다. 국내 마찰은 학생들이 반발하고 있는 국회의 출국 금지 조치 정도의 경미한 수준에 그쳤으며, 위기 상황은 보고되지 않아 다소 긍정적인 평가를 뒷받침합니다.

summary.el: Τα νέα της Σιέρα Λεόνε κατά την περίοδο αυτή κυριαρχούνται από ρουτινικές συνεργασίες και θέματα ανάπτυξης: η δήλωση του Φρίταουν της ECOWAS για την αποδοχή βιομετρικής ταυτότητας έως το 2027, η στήριξη της ΕΕ και του WFP στα συστήματα δεδομένων για το σχολικό γεύμα, η ιατρική δράση κινεζικής αποστολής και διμερείς επαφές με το Μαρόκο, την Ινδία και το Μπουρκίνα Φάσο. Εμφανίζονται μόνο μικρές εσωτερικές τριβές (απαγόρευση εξόδου από το κοινοβούλιο που αμφισβητείται από φοιτητές) και δεν αναφέρεται καμία κρίση, γεγονός που στηρίζει μια μετρίως θετική βαθμολογία.
summary.it: Le notizie sulla Sierra Leone nel periodo sono dominate da iniziative ordinarie di cooperazione e sviluppo: una dichiarazione della CEDEAO sull'identificazione biometrica, il sostegno di UE e PAM ai sistemi di dati per i pasti scolastici, un'iniziativa sanitaria di una squadra medica cinese e incontri bilaterali con Marocco, India e Burkina Faso. Compaiono solo lievi attriti interni (un divieto parlamentare di uscita disputato dagli studenti) e non viene segnalata alcuna crisi, il che giustifica un punteggio moderatamente positivo.
summary.ru: Новости Сьерра-Леоне за указанный период в основном связаны с текущим сотрудничеством и развитием: декларация ЭКОВАС о принятии биометрических удостоверений личности, поддержка ЕС и ВПП систем данных для школьного питания, медицинская помощь китайской бригады и двусторонние контакты с Марокко, Индией и Буркина-Фасо. Внутренние трения незначительны (запрет парламента на выезд, оспариваемый студентами), кризисов не сообщается, что соответствует умеренно положительной оценке.
summary.ar: تهيمن على أخبار سيراليون خلال الفترة بنود روتينية للتعاون والتنمية: إعلان للإيكواس بشأن الهوية البيومترية، ودعم الاتحاد الأوروبي وبرنامج الأغذية العالمي لأنظمة بيانات التغذية المدرسية، وبرنامج صحي لفريق طبي صيني، ومشاركات ثنائية مع المغرب والهند وبوركينا فاسو. لا تظهر سوى احتكاكات داخلية طفيفة (حظر برلماني على السفر تعترض عليه الطلاب)، ولا تُسجَّل أي أزمة، مما يدعم تقييماً إيجابياً معتدلاً.
summary.fa: اخبار سیرالئون در این دوره بیشتر به موضوعات روتین همکاری و توسعه اختصاص دارد: بیانیه اکوواس درباره شناسنامه بیومتریک، حمایت اتحادیه اروپا و برنامه جهانی غذا از سامانه‌های داده تغذیه مدرسه، برنامه سلامت یک تیم پزشکی چینی و مذاکرات دوجانبه با مراکش، هند و بورکینافاسو. تنها تنش داخلی جزئی دیده می‌شود (ممنوعیت خروج از کشور توسط پارلمان که دانشجویان به آن اعتراض دارند) و هیچ بحرانی گزارش نشده است، که از امتیاز نسبتاً مثبت پشتیبانی می‌کند.
summary.zh: 塞拉利昂在此期间的新闻以常规合作与发展事项为主：西非国家经济共同体关于生物识别身份证件的宣言、欧盟与世界粮食计划署对学校供餐数据系统的支持、中国医疗队的健康服务活动，以及与摩洛哥、印度和布基纳法索的双边互动。国内仅有轻微摩擦（议会的出境禁令遭学生质疑），未报道任何危机，因此评分中等偏正面。
summary.tr: Sierra Leone'nin bu dönemdeki haberleri, rutin işbirliği ve kalkınma gündemlerine hakim: bir ECOWAS biyometrik kimlik bildirgesi, AB-WFP okul beslenme veri desteği, Çin tıbbi yardım ekibinin sağlık çalışmaları ve Fas, Hindistan ile Burkina Faso ile ikili görüşmeler. Yalnızca küçük ölçekli iç sürtünmeler görülüyor (öğrencilerin itiraz ettiği bir parlamento çıkış yasağı) ve hiçbir kriz bildirilmemiş, bu da orta düzeyde olumlu bir puanı destekliyor.
summary.es: Las noticias de Sierra Leona en este periodo están dominadas por asuntos rutinarios de cooperación y desarrollo: una declaración de la CEDEAO sobre identificación biométrica, el apoyo de datos de la UE y el PMA para la alimentación escolar, actividades médicas de China y contactos bilaterales con Marruecos, India y Burkina Faso. summary.it: Il periodo è dominato da una narrativa economica chiaramente positiva: il governo prevede di aumentare la propria quota in De Beers al 30% nell'ambito della vendita di Anglo American, riportata da numerose testate. Per il resto la copertura è di routine (finanziamento climatico, nomine diplomatiche, un'elezione suppletiva), con alcune notizie negative, come le accuse di stupro ancora in corso e una critica alla burocrazia.
summary.ru: Период определяется явно позитивной экономической историей: правительство планирует увеличить свою долю в De Beers до 30% в рамках продажи Anglo American, о чём сообщили многие издания. В остальном освещение рутинное (климатическое финансирование, дипломатические назначения, дополнительные выборы), есть и некоторые негативные материалы, например продолжающиеся обвинения в изнасиловании и критика бюрократии.
summary.ar: تهيمن على الفترة قصة اقتصادية إيجابية بوضوح: تخطط الحكومة لرفع حصتها في شركة دي بيرز إلى 30% ضمن صفقة بيع أنجلو أمريكان، وقد تناولتها وسائل إعلام عديدة. أما بقية التغطية فروتينية (تمويل المناخ، والتعيينات الدبلوماسية، والانتخابات الفرعية)، مع بعض الأخبار السلبية مثل تهم الاغتصاب المستمرة وانتقاد للبيروقراطية.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً تحت تأثیر یک روایت اقتصادی مثبت است: دولت قصد دارد در جریان فروش آنگلو آمریکن، سهم خود در دی بیرز را به ۳۰ درصد افزایش دهد؛ موضوعی که رسانه‌های متعددی آن را گزارش کرده‌اند. در غیر این صورت، پوشش خبری معمولی است (تأمین مالی اقلیمی، انتصابات دیپلماتیک، یک انتخابات میان‌دوره‌ای)، با برخی موارد منفی مانند اتهامات تجاوز جنسی در جریان و انتقاد از بوروکراسی.
summary.zh: 本时段以明显正面的经济新闻为主：政府计划在英美资源集团出售资产的交易中，将其在戴比尔斯（De Beers）的持股提高至30%，多家媒体均有报道。其余报道多属常规内容（气候融资、外交任命、补选），也有一些负面消息，如持续中的强奸指控和对官僚主义的批评。
summary.ja: この期間は明確に前向きな経済ニュースが中心です。政府はアングロ・アメリカン社による売却の一環として、デビアスにおける国の持ち分を30%に引き上げる計画で、これは複数の媒体で報じられています。その他の報道は定型的なもの（気候資金、外交人事、補欠選挙など）で、継続中の強姦罪の起訴や官僚制への批判といった否定的な話題も一部あります。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 명확히 긍정적인 경제 뉴스가 지배적입니다. 정부는 앵글로 아메리칸 매각의 일환으로 디비어스에 대한 지분을 30%로 높일 계획이며, 여러 매체가 이를 보도했습니다. 그 밖의 보도는 기후 금융, 외교 임명, 보궐선거 등 일상적인 내용이며, 진행 중인 강간 혐의와 관료제 비판 같은 일부 부정적 사안도 있습니다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में स्पष्ट रूप से सकारात्मक आर्थिक खबर छाई हुई है: एंग्लो अमेरिकन की बिक्री के हिस्से के रूप में सरकार डी बीयर्स में अपनी हिस्सेदारी बढ़ाकर 30% करने की योजना बना रही है, जिसकी खबर कई समाचार स्रोतों में आई है। अन्यथा कवरेज नियमित है (जलवायु वित्त, राजनयिक नियुक्तियाँ, उपचुनाव), और कुछ नकारात्मक खबरें भी हैं, जैसे चल रहे बलात्कार के आरोप और नौकरशाही की आलोचना।
summary.el: Η περίοδος κυριαρχείται από μια σαφώς θετική οικονομική εξέλιξη: η κυβέρνηση σχεδιάζει να αυξήσει το ποσοστό της στη De Beers στο 30%, στο πλαίσιο της πώλησης της Anglo American, όπως αναφέρουν πολλά μέσα ενημέρωσης. Κατά τα άλλα, η κάλυψη είναι συνηθισμένη (χρηματοδότηση για το κλίμα, διπλωματικοί διορισμοί, αναπληρωματική εκλογή), με ορισμένα αρνητικά θέματα, όπως οι εν εξελίξει κατηγορίες για βιασμό και η κριτική για τη γραφειοκρατία.
summary.tr: Dönem, açıkça olumlu bir ekonomik gelişmeyle öne çıkıyor: hükümet, Anglo American'ın satışı kapsamında De Beers'teki payını %30'a çıkarmayı planlıyor; haber birçok kaynakta yer aldı. Bunun dışında haberler rutin nitelikte (iklim finansmanı, diplomatik atamalar, ara seçim), bazı olumsuz haberler de var; örneğin devam eden tecavüz suçlamaları ve bürokrasiye yönelik eleştiri.
summary.es: El período está dominado por una noticia económica claramente positiva: el gobierno planea elevar su participación en De Beers al 30 % como parte de la venta de Anglo American, informada por numerosos medios. Por lo demás, la cobertura es rutinaria (financiación climática, nombramientos diplomáticos, una elección parcial), con algunos asuntos negativos, como los cargos continuos por violación y una crítica a la burocracia.
summary.fr: La période est dominée par un récit économique clairement positif : le gouvernement prévoit de porter sa participation dans De Beers à 30 % dans le cadre de la cession d'Anglo American, information relayée par de nombreux médias. Par ailleurs, la couverture est de routine (financement climatique, nominations diplomatiques, élection partielle), avec quelques éléments négatifs, comme les accusations de viol toujours en cours et une critique de la bureaucratie.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum wird von einer klar positiven Wirtschaftsmeldung dominiert: Die Regierung plant, ihren Anteil an De Beers im Rahmen des Verkaufs durch Anglo American auf 30 % zu erhöhen, worüber zahlreiche Medien berichteten. Ansonsten ist die Berichterstattung routinemäßig (Klimafinanzierung, diplomatische Ernennungen, eine Nachwahl), mit einigen negativen Meldungen wie laufenden Vergewaltigungsanklagen und einer Kritik an der Bürokratie.
summary.pt: O período é dominado por uma história econômica claramente positiva: o governo planeja elevar sua participação na De Beers para 30% como parte da venda da Anglo American, noticiada por vários veículos. No mais, a cobertura é rotineira (financiamento climático, nomeações diplomáticas, uma eleição suplementar), com alguns itens negativos, como as acusações de estupro em andamento e uma crítica à burocracia.

Consortium moving to finalise De Beers acquisition from Anglo American
Routine diplomacy, climate-funding and by-election coverage

summary.en: A routine day in Namibia: no major crisis is apparent. Rising tourism occupancy, dialogue with Angola, the upcoming ILO regional meeting in Windhoek, and energy cooperation are positive. A slowdown in mining (diamond stagnation, inflation and high interest rates), corruption and judicial controversies, and allegations of harsh intervention by an anti-poaching unit offset this positive effect.

en: Tourism occupancy rising to 66.5%
Bilateral talks with Angola and the ILO Africa regional meeting
Pressure on the mining sector from the diamond decline, inflation and high interest rates
Trust in the Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) and calls for the Finestar investigation
Allegations of harsh intervention by the anti-poaching unit and debate over violence

summary.en: The period is mostly routine but leans positive, with Namibia and Angola signing seven agreements and pledging deeper economic cooperation, plus progress on a manganese refinery and approval of a lithium project sale. Offsetting concerns include a reported diamond output slump, rising fuel costs, reliance on electricity imports and fears of illegal sand mining.

en: Namibia-Angola signed seven agreements at first bilateral commission
Manganese refinery plans advance in Walvis Bay
Karibib lithium project sale receives greenlight

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with mildly positive economic and diplomatic news: growth projected to outpace South Africa, US investor outreach, a Namibia-Angola cooperation pledge, and new export access for grapes to China. Negatives were limited to a heatwave warning and ongoing Fishrot and anti-corruption proceedings, with no crisis reported.

en: Economy projected to grow faster than South Africa's
US ambassador pitching Namibia to American investors
Namibia-Angola pledge deeper bilateral cooperation

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news: a cut in the 2026 growth forecast to 2.3% and a drought threatening around 400,000 people weigh against a surge in uranium exports and new sustainable-finance lending. A contested petroleum bill and a minor 4.9 earthquake add tension without signalling a crisis.

en: Growth forecast cut to 2.3% as mining revenue drops
Uranium exports surge while diamond production falls
Drought threatens nearly 400,000 people

summary.en: The period is largely routine, with a clear positive economic development: the N$5.8bn Etango uranium mine received its final investment decision and moves to full-scale construction, with officials citing jobs and output gains. Other headlines are ordinary business, social and sports news, and the GDELT tone is mildly positive.

en: Etango uranium mine final investment decision and construction start
Minister says Etango will boost output and create jobs
Bannerman commits $353M to uranium mine, backing investment outlook

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: debate over mining contracts, youth council appointments, and diplomatic and energy talks. The main negative is wildfires affecting about 16% of Etosha National Park during extreme heat, and GDELT tone is less negative than the world average.

en: Wildfires affecting 16% of Etosha National Park amid extreme heat
Routine debate over short-term contracts in mining operations
Energy and technology cooperation talks with Russia

summary.en: The period mixes positive economic news, notably approval of a US$353M uranium mine and a final permit for a Kayelekera shipment, with setbacks including a rate hike, livestock disease losses, Etosha fires and a salary-records dispute. Most headlines are routine, so the score sits near the ordinary baseline, slightly lowered by the negative tone.

en: Bannerman uranium mine approval and Kayelekera shipment permit
Standard Bank rate hike and FNB bond deadline
FMD could cost livestock industry N$2.4bn

summary.en: A mixed, mostly routine news day: agricultural stress from a foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) outbreak and a South African feedlot ban, plus a cash crunch delaying pay, sit alongside positive developments like the Norasa environmental renewal, a proposed climate-action law and completed road projects. The GDELT tone is more negative than the world average, which pulls the score slightly below neutral.

en: FMD restrictions and South African feedlot ban hitting farmers
Cash crunch delaying pay in Rundu
Norasa environmental clearance renewal and wind-farm hopes

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news: sports wins, a state funeral, a presidential visit to Moscow and community income projects. Negatives are modest, including a health recruitment freeze, foot-and-mouth restrictions hurting vendors and farmers, and 900 pupils dropping out, so the score sits slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Namibia's sports wins and national championship results
Health Ministry halts recruitment of new staff
Foot-and-mouth restrictions hitting marketing and vendors

summary.en: Namibia's news over the period is mostly routine, with a mix of positive investment and infrastructure items (a N$1.6bn wind farm, a $140m Green Climate Fund approval, expanded vocational training). Offsetting concerns include a foot-and-mouth outbreak with 131 cases, a central bank rate hike to 7%, and a missed land resettlement target.

en: N$1.6bn Lüderitz wind farm supports energy supply
Green Climate Fund approves $140m for decarbonisation
Foot-and-mouth cases reach 131 with movement restrictions

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: diplomatic engagement with Russia, a bank-backed water project and economic and cybersecurity commentary, alongside ordinary crime and a hospital over capacity. Precautionary Ebola preparedness and a fatal grazing-land dispute are minor negatives, so the score sits slightly above an ordinary day.

en: Putin meets Namibian president; trade and joint ventures discussed
NBL backs Swakop water project
Ebola preparedness ramped up at entry points

summary.en: The period is largely routine: infrastructure expansion (Paratus fibre), preparations for the Dakar Youth Olympics, and diplomatic contact with Russia sit alongside health-sector disputes, delayed municipal salaries and a foot-and-mouth disease containment effort. Mild negative tone from GDELT is offset by these constructive stories, so the day is close to an ordinary baseline.

en: Paratus adds 600km to fibre network
Nurses and doctors protest recruitment freeze and tariffs
Rundu Town Council October salaries delayed

summary.en: The period is largely routine, with several positive economic signals: the Etango uranium mine was approved for full-scale construction, a new egg export market opened in Botswana, and the stock market rose. Offsetting these are foot-and-mouth disease containment pressures, underfunding concerns, and a fatal land dispute.

en: Etango uranium mine approved for full-scale construction
Market report shows stock market gains led by MTC
Egg export market access expanded to Botswana

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with a historic maiden ODI series win over Ireland and approval of the Leonardville uranium project as the main positives. Negatives include a seven-fatality road crash, violent and sexual crime reports, and rate hikes raising mortgage costs; GDELT tone (-0.09) is less negative than the world average.

en: Historic maiden ODI series win over Ireland
Leonardville uranium project approved
Rate hikes add N$4,000 a year to mortgages

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: cultural, sports and community news, plus development approvals such as a uranium project and green funding. A road accident that killed a musician and seven others and a looming fisheries strike are the main negatives, and the tone signal is mildly positive.

en: Leonardville uranium project approved
Green funding spotlight on Erongo industrial projects
Road accident killed musician and seven others

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: business investment, sports sponsorship, international cooperation deals and a positive GDELT tone (+1.72 against a world average of -0.50). Negative items such as crime reports, child abuse cases and aquifer concerns are ordinary and do not amount to a crisis.

en: Namibia and China sign Olympic cooperation agreement
Eagles win Ireland series, FNB sponsors Women's Super League
Breweries and Andrada announce water project and economic contributions

summary.en: The period is dominated by a major positive economic development: a $2.5 billion Dangote fuel storage and pipeline investment, widely covered in foreign and domestic media. Offsetting this are foot-and-mouth losses, a Grade 11 exam leak, utility cuts and budget criticism, which keep the score below the top of the positive range.

en: $2.5bn Dangote fuel hub launch, widely reported as a major investment
Namibia–South Korea Olympic MoU and first state-owned air ambulances
FMD restrictions projected to cost N$2.4bn in value-chain losses

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with positive signals from the foot-and-mouth outbreak being contained, a large Dangote fuel storage and pipeline investment, and a first dividend from NAC. These are offset by rising inflation to 5.6% and a N$11 diesel price surge that threatens mining jobs and tax revenue.

en: FMD outbreak contained with no new cases recorded
Dangote announces $2.5bn tank farm and pipeline investment
Inflation climbs to 5.6% in October

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: culture, sport and business coverage, with several investment announcements, including a US$2.5 billion fuel pipeline, a Coca-Cola water project and a new airline. Negatives are limited to rising fuel costs, a contained foot-and-mouth outbreak and union frustration over labour reform delays.

en: Large fuel pipeline and tank farm project launched with regional reach
Coca-Cola and CPBN health infrastructure investments announced
Rising fuel costs and labour reform delays weigh modestly

summary.en: The period is mostly routine but tilts negative, with cost-of-living pressure from a 34% fuel price rise and rising food prices, plus job risks from a cut in the hake catch and foot-and-mouth disease hitting farmers. A magnitude-5.1 earthquake and a murder arrest add to the negative tone, though no damage or casualties are reported, and the national team's win is a minor positive.

en: Fuel costs up 34% year on year, pressuring households
Hake catch cut puts about 1,500 jobs at risk
Economic task force urges deal with South Africa for FMD-hit farmers

summary.en: The period was mostly routine, with clear positives from QatarEnergy taking a 25% stake in an offshore exploration licence and a new listing on the Namibia Securities Exchange. Negatives were minor: a small earthquake, crime and road-crash costs, and debt disputes. GDELT tone was positive relative to the world average.

en: QatarEnergy acquires 25% stake in offshore exploration licence
Tharisa listing on Namibian exchange
Investment Promotion and Facilitation Bill reaches Parliament

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with clearly positive economic news: an oil-block farm-down to BP was completed, QatarEnergy agreed to buy a 25% stake, and the NAC declared its first dividend in 20 years. Offsetting these are a second earthquake near Kamanjab, municipal debt disputes and a court freeze on Trustco shares.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine, con notizie economiche chiaramente positive: è stata completata la cessione di una quota di un blocco petrolifero a BP, QatarEnergy ha accettato di acquistare una partecipazione del 25% e la NAC ha dichiarato il suo primo dividendo in 20 anni. A controbilanciare ci sono una seconda scossa di terremoto vicino a Kamanjab, controversie sul debito dei comuni e un congelamento giudiziario delle azioni di Trustco.
summary.ru: Период в основном рутинный, с явно позитивными экономическими новостями: завершена передача доли в нефтяном блоке компании BP, QatarEnergy согласилась приобрести 25%-ную долю, а NAC объявила первые за 20 лет дивиденды. Этому противостоят второе землетрясение вблизи Каманджаба, споры о муниципальных долгах и судебная заморозка акций Trustco.
summary.ar: الفترة روتينية في معظمها، مع أخبار اقتصادية إيجابية واضحة: اكتمل نقل حصة في كتلة نفطية إلى شركة BP، ووافقت QatarEnergy على شراء حصة بنسبة 25%، وأعلنت NAC أول توزيع أرباح لها منذ 20 عامًا. في المقابل، وقع زلزال ثانٍ قرب كامانجاب، وبرزت نزاعات حول ديون البلديات، وفرضت محكمة تجميدًا على أسهم Trustco.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً روال‌معمول است، با اخبار اقتصادی مثبت آشکار: واگذاری سهم یک بلوک نفتی به BP تکمیل شد، QatarEnergy توافق کرد سهم ۲۵ درصدی خریداری کند و NAC نخستین سود سهام خود را طی ۲۰ سال اعلام کرد. در مقابل، زمین‌لرزه دوم در نزدیکی Kamanjab، اختلافات بدهی شهرداری‌ها و توقیف قضایی سهام Trustco قرار دارد.
summary.zh: 该时期总体属于常规情况，经济新闻明显偏正面：一处石油区块的权益已完成向BP转让，卡塔尔能源公司同意收购25%股权，NAC宣布20年来首次派息。与之相抵的是Kamanjab附近再次发生地震、市政债务争议以及法院冻结Trustco股票。
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin seyrediyor; ancak ekonomiye ilişkin haberler açıkça olumlu: bir petrol bloğunun BP'ye devri tamamlandı, QatarEnergy yüzde 25'lik bir hisse satın almayı kabul etti ve NAC 20 yılın ardından ilk temettüsünü açıkladı. Bunları dengeleyen gelişmeler arasında Kamanjab yakınlarında ikinci bir deprem, belediye borcuna ilişkin anlaşmazlıklar ve Trustco hisselerine mahkeme tarafından getirilen dondurma kararı yer alıyor.
summary.es: El periodo es en gran medida rutinario, con noticias económicas claramente positivas: se completó la cesión parcial del bloque petrolero a BP, QatarEnergy acordó comprar una participación del 25 % y NAC anunció su primer dividendo en 20 años. Contrarrestan estos hechos un segundo terremoto cerca de Kamanjab, disputas sobre la deuda municipal y una orden judicial que congela las acciones de Trustco.
summary.fr: La période est en grande partie routinière, avec des nouvelles économiques nettement positives : la cession partielle du bloc pétrolier à BP a été finalisée, QatarEnergy a accepté d'acquérir une participation de 25 %, et la NAC a annoncé son premier dividende depuis 20 ans. Contrebalancent ces éléments un second séisme près de Kamanjab, des litiges sur la dette municipale et un gel judiciaire des actions de Trustco.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verläuft größtenteils routinemäßig, mit eindeutig positiven Wirtschaftsnachrichten: Die Abgabe eines Ölblocks an BP wurde abgeschlossen, QatarEnergy vereinbarte den Kauf eines 25-%-Anteils, und die NAC kündigte nach 20 Jahren erstmals wieder eine Dividende an. Dem stehen ein zweites Erdbeben nahe Kamanjab, Streitigkeiten über Kommunalschulden und ein gerichtlicher Handelsstopp für Trustco-Aktien gegenüber.
summary.pt: O período é em grande parte rotineiro, com notícias económicas claramente positivas: foi concluída a cedência de participação do bloco petrolífero à BP, a QatarEnergy acordou adquirir uma participação de 25% e a NAC anunciou o seu primeiro dividendo em 20 anos. Contrabalançam estes factos um segundo sismo perto de Kamanjab, litígios sobre a dívida municipal e um congelamento judicial das ações da Trustco.
summary.ja: 今回の期間は概ね平常通りで、経済面では明確に前向きなニュースがありました。石油鉱区についてBPへの持分一部譲渡が完了し、QatarEnergyが25%の株式取得で合意し、NACは20年ぶりに初めての配当を宣言しました。一方で、Kamanjab近郊での2回目の地震、地方自治体の債務をめぐる争い、そしてTrustco株に対する裁判所による凍結命令といった要素が、これらを相殺しています。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 평이했으며, 경제 소식은 분명히 긍정적이었습니다. 석유 광구의 BP 지분 일부 양도가 완료되었고, QatarEnergy는 25% 지분 인수에 합의했으며, NAC는 20년 만에 처음으로 배당을 선언했습니다. 반면 Kamanjab 인근에서 두 번째 지진이 발생했고, 지방자치단체 채무 분쟁과 법원의 Trustco 주식 동결 명령이 이러한 긍정 요인을 상쇄했습니다.
summary.hi: यह अवधि ज़्यादातर सामान्य रही, जिसमें आर्थिक समाचार स्पष्ट रूप से सकारात्मक थे: एक तेल ब्लॉक में BP को हिस्सेदारी के हस्तांतरण का काम पूरा हुआ, QatarEnergy ने 25% हिस्सेदारी खरीदने पर सहमति दी, और NAC ने 20 वर्षों में अपना पहला लाभांश घोषित किया। इनके मुकाबले Kamanjab के पास दूसरा भूकंप, नगरपालिका ऋण विवाद और Trustco शेयरों पर अदालती रोक जैसी बातें हैं।
summary.el: Η περίοδος ήταν κατά το μεγαλύτερο μέρος ρουτινική, με σαφώς θετικά οικονομικά νέα: ολοκληρώθηκε η μεταβίβαση μέρους του οικοπέδου πετρελαίου στην BP, η QatarEnergy συμφώνησε να αγοράσει ποσοστό 25% και η NAC ανακοίνωσε το πρώτο της μέρισμα μετά από 20 χρόνια. Αντίβαρο αποτελούν ένας δεύτερος σεισμός κοντά στο Kamanjab, διαφορές για το δημοτικό χρέος και δικαστική δέσμευση των μετοχών της Trustco.

summary.en: Protests continue in Portugal over the housing crisis and rent reform. A tent camp in Lisbon and Porto was cleared by police, more than 50 people were detained, and a strike was called across the Iberian Peninsula. In contrast, economic and tourism news is positive, the stock market is moving sideways, and no severe crisis is apparent. The score is therefore slightly below the usual level.

en: Police clearance of housing protest tents in Lisbon and Porto, more than 50 detentions
Social backlash against rent and eviction reform, strike call across the Iberian Peninsula
Tourism awards and Lisbon being named one of Europe's best destinations
Limited stock market movement (daily +0.13%, monthly -1.43%)
GDELT tone markedly negative compared with the world average

summary.en: Housing and cost-of-living protests spread across Portugal, with police clearing tent camps in Lisbon, 55 arrests, and disputed claims of excessive force. Most other coverage is routine, and the PSI is roughly flat on the day, so the score sits just above the serious-problems band.

en: Police cleared Rossio and other protest camps; 55 arrested
Thousands protest housing crisis; foreign media coverage widespread
Disputed claims of excessive police force at Lisbon camp

summary.en: Housing protests in Lisbon and Porto drew thousands, with police clearing encampments, clashes and 55 reported detentions, and foreign coverage frames it as part of a wider European wave. Offsetting positives include a rise in the WJP Rule of Law Index, lynx population growth, and routine economic and institutional news, while the PSI fell modestly.

en: Police clearing housing protest camps in Lisbon, with clashes and 55 detentions
Protests spreading and vowing to continue, with a wider European protest wave
Portugal rising in WJP Rule of Law Index to 27th place

summary.en: The period is mostly routine news, with housing-crisis protests in Lisbon (around 200 people camping overnight, some arrests) and talk of a possible Iberian general strike on 11 November. The PSI rose 0.77% on the day, though it is down over the week and month, and M&A fell 37%, so the overall picture is mildly negative.

en: Lisbon housing protests with overnight camping and some arrests
Unions discussing a possible Iberian general strike on 11 November
M&A activity down 37% in the first half

summary.en: Portugal's last 24 hours mix routine news (scheduled power cuts, clock change, tourism concerns) with recurring, largely peaceful housing protests and a student climate strike in Lisbon. Markets were flat and press tone was slightly above average, so the day is close to an ordinary period with mild social strain.

en: Housing protests returning to Lisbon and Porto with tent camps
Ongoing housing crisis expected to take a decade to resolve
Student climate strike blocking Lisbon schools

summary.en: Large housing-cost protests spread across Lisbon, Porto and other cities over the period, with police clearing a protest camp in Lisbon, using batons and tasers, and making arrests, and seven protesters reported injured. A Gen Z general strike is being organised, and the stock index is modestly down over the week and month.

en: Police clear Lisbon housing protest camp, arrests and injuries reported
Mass housing protests in multiple Portuguese cities against high prices
Planned Gen Z general strike amid rising social discontent

summary.en: Police cleared housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto, with reports of 25 to 31 arrests and 27 injured, and protests have resumed with calls for a general strike. This is a serious domestic tension with a harsh crackdown, though the market dip is modest and most other news is routine.

en: Police clear housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto, mass arrests
Reported 27 injured and 31 detained; criticism of disproportionate force
Protests resume and general strike called over housing crisis

summary.en: Housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto were dismantled by police with batons and dogs, leaving 27 injured and 31 detained, and the protests are drawing pressure on the government and president. The rest of the day is routine: the 2027 budget debate starts and TAP resumes Caracas flights, but the stock index is down over the month.

en: Police dismantle housing protest camps; 27 injured, 31 detained
Government and president pressed to respond to housing protests
2027 budget debate begins in parliament

summary.en: Thousands protested outside Parliament over the housing crisis after police cleared encampments in Lisbon and Porto, with reports of 11 injured and detained protesters. Markets were roughly flat to slightly down, and the GDELT tone is milder than the world average, so the overall picture is serious social tension rather than a broader crisis.

en: Police clearing of housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto
Thousands rally outside Parliament over housing crisis
11 injured in encampment incident; protesters detained

summary.en: Portugal's last 24 hours mix routine and mildly positive news (a new Coloplast factory, a Lisbon housing land agreement, a slight stock gain, a notably positive news tone) with active tensions: thousands protested over housing outside parliament and police and GNR officers protested over pay. No crackdown or crisis is reported, so the period sits modestly above an ordinary day.

Lisbon secures land reserve for housing in agreement with SGAL
Thousands protest housing outside Parliament; no harsh crackdown reported

summary.en: Portugal's news over the period is largely routine, with business and institutional items such as a Bank of Portugal office deal saving €35 million and a new Coloplast factory. Housing protests in Lisbon and a planned cost-of-living march add some social tension, but there is no clear crisis, and the stock index is roughly flat over the week.

en: Housing protests in Lisbon with police preparing for further demonstrations
Bank of Portugal new headquarters deal saving €35 million
Coloplast opens new factory in Portugal

summary.en: An ordinary day in Portugal with routine politics (Chega leadership vote), a government update that oil reserves were released as committed in March, and a cost-of-living and housing protest reported by a leftist outlet. Positive items include the Dakar 2027 start in Portugal and GDELT tone above the world average, offset by a 4% monthly stock decline and a fatal road accident in Spain involving a Portuguese citizen.

Youth and workers mobilise over cost of living and housing
Dakar 2027 to start in Algarve, Portugal

en: Police evacuated housing protest camps in Lisbon, with arrests and injuries
Thousands rallied nationwide against rents and housing costs
Further strikes and protests scheduled for November

13 arrests and reports of over 100 injured in protest violence
Journalists' union complaint against PSP and Council of State meeting called

Otherwise the day was routine, with flat markets, a Constitutional Court review of protest rules, and ordinary business and diplomacy news.

en: Riot police cleared housing protest camps; 13 arrested, dozens hurt
Protest-law review reaches Constitutional Court; demonstrations continue
Routine economic and diplomatic news; stock index essentially flat

summary.en: The period is mostly routine, with a signed TAP privatisation deal with Lufthansa and a 2.55% rise in the PSI index pointing to clearly positive economic signals. Housing protests, with police clearing camps and rights complaints to the UN, plus high fuel prices, temper the score.

en: TAP sale contract signed with Lufthansa, minority stake
PSI index up 2.55% in one day
Police clearing housing protest camps in Lisbon and Porto

summary.en: Portugal's day mixed routine economic and political news with social strain: housing protests with police removals, a reported elderly death after a 12-hour emergency wait, and energy costs eroding purchasing power for about 70% of people. The PSI20 gained 1.22% and the fintech sector reported growth, which offsets some of the negatives.

en: Housing protests in Lisbon and Porto, with repeated police removals
Energy cost rise cutting purchasing power for ~70% of Portuguese
Elderly patient death after 12-hour emergency wait; IGAS inquiry opened

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: sports coverage dominated by Ronaldo's international retirement, a housing debate, and rain warnings from IPMA. The main negative is the detention of 86 protesters at the Lisbon encampment, while the PSI fell 1.27% on the day but rose over the week.

en: 86 protesters detained at Lisbon housing encampment, now before prosecutors
Housing policy debate and encampment refusing to leave Rossio
Ronaldo retirement dominates coverage, with no direct national impact

summary.en: The period looks routine for Portugal: most coverage is sports (Ronaldo's international retirement), with a weather alert from storm Bruna, a bomb threat on a Rome-Lisbon flight and ordinary housing and budget debates. Positive signals include 18% growth in canned-fish exports and a slightly firmer PSI over the week, so the score sits near the ordinary baseline.

en: Storm Bruna weather alert with intense rain and waves
Canned-fish exports up 18%
Bomb threat on Rome-Lisbon flight, handled by police

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: storm Bruna caused damage and flight cancellations in Madeira, and there are reports of strained household budgets, housing criticism and a Lisbon protest encampment. The PSI rose modestly over the week and the national news shows no clear crisis, so the score sits slightly below an ordinary day.

en: Storm Bruna damage and flight cancellations in Madeira
Immigrant families relying on food aid amid tight budgets
Housing policy criticism and Lisbon encampment continuing

summary.en: A routine news day in Portugal, with the Web Summit opening in Lisbon, fuel prices starting to fall, and the PSI20 up 1.36% on the day and 3.82% on the week. Housing and healthcare access concerns and minor weather warnings are ordinary problems, with no crisis.

en: PSI20 gains on the day and the week
Fuel prices starting to fall
Web Summit opens with record Chinese presence

summary.en: Storm Charles brought red wind warnings to eight districts, a state of alert, and school and public-service closures, with many emergency call-outs in Lisbon. Housing protests and Volkswagen/Autoeuropa worries add strain, though the stock index rose and the Web Summit went ahead.
summary.it: La tempesta Charles ha portato allerte rosse per il vento in otto distretti, lo stato di allerta e la chiusura di scuole e servizi pubblici, con numerosi interventi di emergenza a Lisbona. Le proteste per la casa e le preoccupazioni per Volkswagen/Autoeuropa aggiungono tensione, anche se l'indice di borsa è salito e il Web Summit si è svolto regolarmente.
summary.ru: Шторм «Чарльз» вызвал красные предупреждения о сильном ветре в восьми округах, режим повышенной готовности, закрытие школ и государственных служб, а в Лиссабоне — многочисленные экстренные вызовы. Протесты из-за жилья и опасения за Volkswagen/Autoeuropa добавляют напряжённости, однако фондовый индекс вырос, а Web Summit прошёл по плану.
summary.ar: أدت العاصفة تشارلز إلى إصدار تحذيرات حمراء من الرياح القوية في ثماني مناطق، وإعلان حالة التأهب، وإغلاق المدارس والخدمات العامة، مع تلقي عدد كبير من نداءات الطوارئ في لشبونة. وتزيد احتجاجات الإسكان والقلق بشأن شركة فولكسفاغن/أوتوأوروبا من الضغوط، رغم ارتفاع مؤشر الأسهم وانعقاد مؤتمر Web Summit كما هو مخطط.
summary.fa: طوفان «چارلز» هشدارهای قرمز باد را برای هشت منطقه، وضعیت آماده‌باش، و تعطیلی مدارس و خدمات عمومی به همراه آورد و در لیسبون درخواست‌های اضطراری فراوانی ثبت شد. اعتراضات مربوط به مسکن و نگرانی درباره فولکس‌واگن/آوتواروپا بر فشارها افزوده است، هرچند شاخص بورس بالا رفت و کنفرانس Web Summit برگزار شد.
summary.zh: 风暴“查尔斯”在八个地区引发强风红色预警，葡萄牙进入警戒状态，学校和公共服务停止运行，里斯本出现大量紧急出警。住房抗议和大众汽车/Autoeuropa的担忧加剧了压力，但股指上涨，Web Summit如期举行。
summary.tr: Charles fırtınası sekiz ilçede kırmızı rüzgar uyarılarına, alarm durumuna ve okul ile kamu hizmetlerinin kapanmasına yol açtı; Lizbon'da çok sayıda acil durum çağrısı yapıldı. Konut protestoları ve Volkswagen/Autoeuropa'ya ilişkin kaygılar baskıyı artırırken, borsa endeksi yükseldi ve Web Summit planlandığı gibi gerçekleşti.
summary.es: La tormenta Charles provocó alertas rojas por viento en ocho distritos, un estado de alerta y el cierre de colegios y servicios públicos, con numerosas llamadas de emergencia en Lisboa. Las protestas por la vivienda y las preocupaciones por Volkswagen/Autoeuropa aumentan la presión, aunque el índice bursátil subió y la Web Summit se celebró según lo previsto.
summary.fr: La tempête Charles a entraîné des alertes rouges au vent dans huit districts, un état d'alerte et la fermeture des écoles et des services publics, ainsi que de nombreuses interventions d'urgence à Lisbonne. Les manifestations pour le logement et les inquiétudes concernant Volkswagen/Autoeuropa ajoutent des tensions, bien que l'indice boursier ait progressé et que le Web Summit ait eu lieu comme prévu.
summary.de: Der Sturm Charles löste in acht Distrikten rote Windwarnungen, einen Alarmzustand sowie Schul- und Behördenschließungen aus; in Lissabon gab es zahlreiche Notrufeinsätze. Wohnungsproteste und Sorgen um Volkswagen/Autoeuropa erhöhen den Druck, während der Aktienindex stieg und der Web Summit wie geplant stattfand.
summary.pt: A tempestade Charles trouxe alertas vermelhos de vento a oito distritos, um estado de alerta e o encerramento de escolas e serviços públicos, com muitas chamadas de emergência em Lisboa. Os protestos pela habitação e as preocupações com a Volkswagen/Autoeuropa aumentam a pressão, embora o índice bolsista tenha subido e a Web Summit tenha avançado como previsto.
summary.ja: 暴風雨「チャールズ」により、8つの県で赤色の強風警報が出され、非常事態宣言が発令されたほか、学校と公共サービスが休業となり、リスボンでは緊急出動が多数発生した。住宅問題への抗議活動やフォルクスワーゲン/オートユーロパを巡る懸念も負担となっているが、株価指数は上昇し、Web Summitは予定通り開催された。
summary.ko: 폭풍 찰스로 8개 구(district)에 적색 강풍 경보가 발령되고 비상사태가 선포되었으며, 학교와 공공 서비스가 중단되었고 리스본에서는 긴급 출동이 많았다. 주택 시위와 폭스바겐/아우토유로파에 대한 우려도 부담을 더하고 있지만, 주가지수는 상승했고 Web Summit은 予定대로 진행되었다.
summary.hi: तूफ़ान चार्ल्स के कारण आठ ज़िलों में लाल रंग की तेज़ हवा की चेतावनी जारी की गई, आपातकाल की स्थिति घोषित की गई, और स्कूल व सार्वजनिक सेवाएँ बंद कर दी गईं; लिस्बन में कई आपातकालीन कॉल आईं। आवास विरोध प्रदर्शन और वोक्सवैगन/ऑटोयूरोपा से जुड़ी चिंताएँ दबाव बढ़ा रही हैं, फिर भी शेयर सूचकांक बढ़ा और वेब समिट आयोजित हुआ।
summary.el: Η κακοκαιρία Charles έφερε κόκκινα δελτία θυελλωδών ανέμων σε οκτώ περιφέρειες, κατάσταση συναγερμού και κλείσιμο σχολείων και δημόσιων υπηρεσιών, με πολλές επείγουσες κλήσεις στη Λισαβόνα. summary.en: Ebola cases in Kenya rose to eight, and the US raised its travel advisory. At least 17 people died in a road accident, and violent incidents occurred at political events. The conviction of the Shakahola cult leader for 191 murders is an important step for justice, but the case itself is a major humanitarian tragedy. Mashujaa Day celebrations, housing projects and economic agreements provide some balance, but the overall picture is slightly below average.

en: Ebola outbreak: eight cases, US travel advisory raised
Conviction in the Shakahola cult murders (justice served, but a severe humanitarian tragedy)
Political violence: attack on an event attended by Wetangula and Kibet, opposition warnings of violence
At least 17 dead in a road accident
Positive developments such as Mashujaa Day celebrations and the handover of a housing project

summary.en: The period is mostly routine: pre-2027 political sparring, administrative appointments, and infrastructure and public-service news. Negatives include an armed ambush in Mandera that killed eight people and water rationing in Nairobi, partly offset by Kenya nearing Ebola-free status and state compensation to Samburu residents.
summary.it: Il periodo è per lo più di routine: scontri politici in vista del 2027, nomine amministrative e notizie su infrastrutture e servizi pubblici. Tra gli aspetti negativi, un'imboscata armata a Mandera che ha ucciso otto persone e il razionamento dell'acqua a Nairobi, in parte compensati dal fatto che il Kenya si avvicina allo status di Paese libero da Ebola e dal risarcimento statale ai residenti Samburu.
summary.ru: Период в целом рутинный: политическая борьба накануне 2027 года, административные назначения и новости об инфраструктуре и государственных услугах. Негативные моменты включают вооружённую засаду в Мандере, в которой погибли восемь человек, и нормирование воды в Найроби, отчасти уравновешенные тем, что Кения приближается к статусу страны, свободной от Эболы, и государственной компенсацией жителям самбуру.
summary.ar: تسير الفترة في معظمها على نحو روتيني: مناوشات سياسية قبل عام 2027، وتعيينات إدارية، وأخبار عن البنية التحتية والخدمات العامة. ومن السلبيات كمين مسلح في منديرا أودى بحياة ثمانية أشخاص، وترشيد المياه في نيروبي، ويخفف من ذلك جزئياً اقتراب كينيا من إعلان خلوها من فيروس إيبولا، وتعويض الدولة لسكان سامبورو.
summary.fa: این دوره عمدتاً روال‌مند است: رقابت‌های سیاسی پیش از 2027، انتصابات اداری و اخبار زیرساخت و خدمات عمومی. نکات منفی شامل کمین مسلحانه در مندرا که هشت نفر را کشت و جیره‌بندی آب در نایروبی است که تا حدی با نزدیک شدن کنیا به وضعیت عاری از ابولا و غرامت دولتی به ساکنان سامبورو جبران می‌شود.
summary.zh: 本时段总体属于常规新闻：2027年前的政治交锋、行政任命以及基础设施和公共服务动态。负面消息包括曼德拉县（Mandera）一起武装伏击造成8人死亡，以及内罗毕供水限量配给；所幸肯尼亚接近埃博拉零病例状态，且政府向桑布鲁（Samburu）居民提供了补偿，部分抵消了上述负面影响。
summary.ja: 今回の期間は概ね日常的な出来事が中心である。2027年に向けた政治的な論争、行政人事、インフラおよび公共サービスに関するニュースが含まれる。マンデラでの武装集団による待ち伏せ攻撃で8人が死亡し、ナイロビでは水の配給制限が行われるなど否定的な出来事もあった。一方で、ケニアはエボラ出血熱の終息に近づいており、サンブル住民への国家補償も行われた。
summary.ko: 이번 기간은 대체로 일상적인 사건들이 중심을 이룬다. 2027년 이전의 정치적 공방, 행정 인사, 인프라 및 공공서비스 관련 소식이 포함된다. 부정적인 사건으로는 만데라에서 무장 괴한의 매복 공격으로 8명이 사망한 사건과 나이로비의 물 배급 제한이 있었다. 이를 어느 정도 상쇄하는 소식으로, 케이냐가 에볼라 종식 상태에 가까워졌고 삼부루 주민들에게 국가 보상이 이루어졌다.
summary.hi: इस अवधि में अधिकतर सामान्य घटनाएँ रहीं: 2027 से पहले की राजनीतिक नोकझोंक, प्रशासनिक नियुक्तियाँ, और बुनियादी ढाँचे तथा सार्वजनिक सेवाओं से जुड़े समाचार। नकारात्मक घटनाओं में मंदेरा में सशस्त्र हमले में आठ लोगों की मौत और नैरोबी में पानी की राशनिंग शामिल हैं। इन्हें आंशिक रूप से संतुलित करते हुए, केन्या इबोला-मुक्त स्थिति के करीब पहुँच रहा है और सम्बुरु निवासियों को राज्य द्वारा मुआवज़ा दिया गया है।
summary.el: Η περίοδος είναι κυρίως ρουτίνα: πολιτικές αντεγκλήσεις πριν από το 2027, διοικητικοί διορισμοί και ειδήσεις για υποδομές και δημόσιες υπηρεσίες. Τα αρνητικά περιλαμβάνουν μια ένοπλη ενέδρα στη Μάντερα που σκότωσε οκτώ άτομα και τον περιορισμό της παροχής νερού στο Ναϊρόμπι, εν μέρει αντισταθμισμένα από το γεγονός ότι η Κένυα πλησιάζει στην κατάσταση χωρίς Έμπολα και από την κρατική αποζημίωση προς τους κατοίκους του Σαμπούρου.
summary.tr: Dönem büyük ölçüde rutin: 2027 öncesi siyasi çekişmeler, idari atamalar ve altyapı ile kamu hizmetleri haberleri. Olumsuz gelişmeler arasında Mandera'da 8 kişinin öldüğü silahlı bir pusu ve Nairobi'de su kısıtlaması yer alıyor; bunları kısmen, Kenya'nın Ebola'dan arınmış statüye yaklaşması ve Samburu sakinlerine devlet tazminatı dengeliyor.
summary.es: El período es en su mayoría rutinario: enfrentamientos políticos previos a 2027, nombramientos administrativos y noticias sobre infraestructura y servicios públicos. Entre los aspectos negativos figuran una emboscada armada en Mandera que causó ocho muertos y el racionamiento de agua en Nairobi, compensados en parte por el hecho de que Kenia se acerca a la condición de libre de ébola y por la compensación estatal a los residentes de Samburu.
summary.fr: La période est majoritairement routinière : joutes politiques avant 2027, nominations administratives et actualités sur les infrastructures et les services publics. Parmi les éléments négatifs figurent une embuscade armée à Mandera qui a fait huit morts et le rationnement de l'eau à Nairobi, en partie compensés par la quasi-élimination de l'Ebola au Kenya et par l'indemnisation des habitants de Samburu par l'État.
summary.de: Der Zeitraum verlief größtenteils routinemäßig: politische Auseinandersetzungen vor 2027, Verwaltungsernennungen sowie Nachrichten zu Infrastruktur und öffentlichen Dienstleistungen. Zu den negativen Ereignissen zählen ein bewaffneter Hinterhalt in Mandera mit acht Todesopfern und die Wasserrationierung in Nairobi, die teilweise durch die bevorstehende Ebola-Freiheit Kenias und staatliche Entschädigungen für Einwohner von Samburu ausgeglichen werden.
summary.pt: O período é em grande parte rotineiro: embates políticos antes de 2027, nomeações administrativas e notícias sobre infraestrutura e serviços públicos. Entre os aspectos negativos estão uma emboscada armada em Mandera que deixou oito mortos e o racionamento de água em Nairóbi, em parte compensados pela aproximação do Quênia da condição de livre de ebola e pela indenização estatal aos moradores de Samburu.

en: Gunmen ambush kills 8 road workers in Mandera
Kenya nears Ebola-free status after 42-day countdown
Nairobi Water cuts production 35%, extends rationing
